# Helper self-test

Proof-of-concept page for the Phase 4.1A doc infrastructure helpers.
It exercises `source_extract`, `krk_download`, and `api_extract`
end-to-end during the Documenter build. Not listed in the public nav.

Load the helpers into this Literate sandbox module.

````julia
helpers_dir = @__DIR__
include(joinpath(helpers_dir, "source_extract.jl"))
include(joinpath(helpers_dir, "krk_download.jl"))
include(joinpath(helpers_dir, "api_extract.jl"))
````


````
"```julia\n\"\"\"\n    run_cavity_2d(config::LBMConfig{D2Q9}; backend=CPU(), T=Float64)\n\nRun a 2D lid-driven cavity simulation using D2Q9 BGK-LBM.\n\nReturns a NamedTuple with final fields (ρ, ux, uy) on CPU.\n\"\"\"\nfunction run_cavity_2d(config::LBMConfig{D2Q9};\n                        backend=KernelAbstractions.CPU(), T=Float64)\n    state = initialize_2d(config, T; backend=backend)\n    f_in, f_out = state.f_in, state.f_out\n    ρ, ux, uy = state.ρ, state.ux, state.uy\n    is_solid = state.is_solid\n    Nx, Ny = config.Nx, config.Ny\n    ω = T(omega(config))\n\n    for step in 1:config.max_steps\n        # 1. Stream (pull scheme, bounce-back at domain edges)\n        stream_2d!(f_out, f_in, Nx, Ny)\n\n        # 2. Apply Zou-He velocity BC on lid (post-stream, pre-collision)\n        apply_zou_he_north_2d!(f_out, config.u_lid, Nx, Ny)\n\n        # 3. BGK collision (in-place on f_out)\n        collide_2d!(f_out, is_solid, ω)\n\n        # 4. Compute macroscopic fields\n        compute_macroscopic_2d!(ρ, ux, uy, f_out)\n\n        # 5. Swap populations\n        f_in, f_out = f_out, f_in\n    end\n\n    # Copy results to CPU\n    ρ_cpu  = Array(ρ)\n    ux_cpu = Array(ux)\n    uy_cpu = Array(uy)\n\n    return (ρ=ρ_cpu, ux=ux_cpu, uy=uy_cpu, config=config)\nend\n```"
````

haskey(p, :E_a)\n        ArrheniusCoupling(g(:T_ref, 1.0), g(:E_a, 0.0))\n    elseif haskey(p, :C1)\n        WLFCoupling(g(:T_ref, 1.0), g(:C1, 8.86), g(:C2, 101.6))\n    else\n 1.0);\n                     thermal=thermal)\n    elseif rs.model == :bingham\n        return Bingham(g(:tau_y, 0.1), g(:mu_p, 0.05);\n                       m_reg=g(:m_reg, 1000.0), thermal=thermal)\n    elseif rs.model == :herschel_bulkley\n        return HerschelBulkley(g(:tau_y, 0.1), g(:K, 0.1), g(:n, 0.5);\n                               m_reg=g(:m_reg, 1000.0), thermal=thermal)\n    elseif rs.model == :oldroyd_b\n        form = haskey(p, :formulation) && p[:formulation] == 0.0 ? StressFormulation() : LogConfFormulation()\n        return FENEP(g(:nu_s, 0.1), g(:nu_p, 0.05), g(:lambda, 1.0), g(:L_max, 100.0);\n                     formulation=form, thermal=thermal)\n    elseif rs.model == :saramito\n        form = haskey(p, :formulation) && p[:formulation] == 0.0 ? StressFormulation() : LogConfFormulation()\n        return Saramito(g(:nu_s, 0.1), g(:nu_p, 0.05), g(:lambda, 1.0), g(:tau_y, 0.01);\n                        n=g(:n, 1.0), m_reg=g(:m_reg, 1000.0),\n                        formulation=form, thermal=thermal)\n    else\n        throw(ArgumentError(\"Unimplemented rheology model: \$(rs.model)\"))\n    end\nend\n```"), (name = :parse_kraken_sweep, signature = "function parse_kraken_sweep(text::String; kwargs...)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    parse_kraken_sweep(text::String; kwargs...) -> Vector{SimulationSetup}\n\nParse a .krk file containing zero or more `Sweep param = [a, b, c]` directives\nand return one `SimulationSetup` per combination of sweep values. verbose=true) -> Vector{SanityIssue}\n\nValidate LBM parameters for a parsed setup.\n\nRuns 7 families of checks:\n1. **Relaxation** — τ too low (unstable) or too high (diffusion-dominated)\n2. **Compressibility** — Mach number / CFL bounds\n3. **Resolution** — grid points vs Reynolds number\n4. **Thermal** — thermal τ and Prandtl range (if `:thermal` module)\n5. **Two-phase** — viscosity/density ratios (if `:twophase_vof` module)\n6. **Rheology** — local τ bounds from non-Newtonian models\n7. **Refinement** — fine-grid τ after Filippova-Hanel rescaling\n\nReturns a `Vector{SanityIssue}` for programmatic inspection.\nEmits `@warn` for soft issues, throws `ErrorException` for critical ones,\nand prints a parameter summary when `verbose=true`.\n\"\"\"\nfunction sanity_check(setup::SimulationSetup; scale=1.0, translate=(0,0,0)) -> STLMesh{T}\n\nApply scale and translation to an STL mesh.\nScaling is applied first (around origin), then translation.\n\"\"\"\nfunction transform_mesh(mesh::STLMesh{T};\n                        scale::Real=1.0,\n                        translate::NTuple{3,<:Real}=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)) where T\n    s = T(scale)\n    tx, ty, tz = T(translate[1]), T(translate[2]), T(translate[3])\n\n    _tr(v) = (v[1] * s + tx, v[2] * s + ty, v[3] * s + tz)\n\n    new_tris = [STLTriangle{T}(tri.normal, _tr(tri.v1), _tr(tri.v2), _tr(tri.v3))\n                for tri in mesh.triangles]\n\n    new_min = _tr(mesh.bbox_min)\n    new_max = _tr(mesh.bbox_max)\n\n    return STLMesh{T}(new_tris, new_min, new_max)\nend\n```"), (name = :voxelize_2d, signature = "function voxelize_2d(mesh::STLMesh{T}, Nx::Int, Ny::Int,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    voxelize_2d(mesh::STLMesh{T}, Nx, Ny, dx, dy; z_slice=0.0) -> Matrix{Bool}\n\nConvert an STL mesh to a 2D boolean solid mask by:\n1. Slicing the mesh at `z = z_slice` to extract a 2D contour\n2. Using 2D ray casting (along +x) for point-in-polygon classification\n\nEach grid node at `(x, y) = ((i-0.5)*dx, (j-0.5)*dy)` is tested.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    voxelize_2d(mesh::STLMesh{T}, Nx, Ny, dx, dy; z_slice=0.0) -> Matrix{Bool}\n\nConvert an STL mesh to a 2D boolean solid mask by:\n1. Slicing the mesh at `z = z_slice` to extract a 2D contour\n2. Using 2D ray casting (along +x) for point-in-polygon classification\n\nEach grid node at `(x, y) = ((i-0.5)*dx, (j-0.5)*dy)` is tested.\n\"\"\"\nfunction voxelize_2d(mesh::STLMesh{T}, Nx::Int, Ny::Int,\n                     dx::Real, dy::Real;\n                     z_slice::Real=0.0) where T\n    # Step 1: Extract 2D segments from z-plane intersection\n    segments = _slice_mesh_z(mesh, T(z_slice))\n\n    isempty(segments) && return zeros(Bool, Nx, Ny)\n\n    # Step 2: Ray casting in 2D for each grid point\n    is_solid = zeros(Bool, Nx, Ny)\n\n    for j in 1:Ny\n        y = T((j - 0.5) * dy)\n        for i in 1:Nx\n            x = T((i - 0.5) * dx)\n            # Cast ray from (x, y) along +x, count intersections with segments\n            crossings = 0\n            for (p1, p2) in segments\n                if _ray_crosses_segment_x(x, y, p1, p2)\n                    crossings += 1\n                end\n            end\n            is_solid[i, j] = isodd(crossings)\n        end\n    end\n\n    return is_solid\nend\n```"), (name = :voxelize_3d, signature = "function voxelize_3d(mesh::STLMesh{T}, Nx::Int, Ny::Int, Nz::Int,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    voxelize_3d(mesh::STLMesh{T}, Nx, Ny, Nz, dx, dy, dz) -> Array{Bool, 3}\n\nConvert an STL mesh to a 3D boolean solid mask using ray casting along the\nz-axis (Möller–Trumbore algorithm).\n\nEach grid node at cell-center `(x, y, z) = ((i-0.5)*dx, (j-0.5)*dy, (k-0.5)*dz)`\nis classified as inside (true) or outside (false) the closed surface.\n\nThe mesh must be a closed (watertight) surface for correct results.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    voxelize_3d(mesh::STLMesh{T}, Nx, Ny, Nz, dx, dy, dz) -> Array{Bool, 3}\n\nConvert an STL mesh to a 3D boolean solid mask using ray casting along the\nz-axis (Möller–Trumbore algorithm).\n\nEach grid node at cell-center `(x, y, z) = ((i-0.5)*dx, (j-0.5)*dy, (k-0.5)*dz)`\nis classified as inside (true) or outside (false) the closed surface.\n\nThe mesh must be a closed (watertight) surface for correct results.\n\"\"\"\nfunction voxelize_3d(mesh::STLMesh{T}, Nx::Int, Ny::Int, Nz::Int,\n                     dx::Real, dy::Real, dz::Real) where T\n    is_solid = zeros(Bool, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n\n    for j in 1:Ny\n        y = T((j - 0.5) * dy)\n        for i in 1:Nx\n            x = T((i - 0.5) * dx)\n\n            # Cast ray from (x, y, -∞) along +z, count intersections\n            z_hits = T[]\n            for tri in mesh.triangles\n                t_hit = _ray_triangle_z(x, y, tri)\n                t_hit !== nothing && push!(z_hits, t_hit)\n            end\n\n            # Sort and deduplicate close hits (shared edges cause double-counting)\n            sort!(z_hits)\n            _deduplicate_hits!(z_hits)\n            inside = false\n            hit_idx = 1\n            for k in 1:Nz\n                z = T((k - 0.5) * dz)\n                # Advance through hits below this z\n                while hit_idx <= length(z_hits) && z_hits[hit_idx] < z\n                    inside = !inside\n                    hit_idx += 1\n                end\n                is_solid[i, j, k] = inside\n            end\n        end\n    end\n\n    return is_solid\nend\n```")]

create_thermal_patch_arrays(patch, omega_T_parent; backend)\n\nAllocate thermal arrays matching an existing RefinementPatch.\nInitializes g to equilibrium at T=0.5 (mid-range).\n\"\"\"\nfunction create_thermal_patch_arrays(patch::RefinementPatch{T},\n                                      omega_T_parent::Real;\n                                      T_init::Real=0.5,\n                                      backend=KernelAbstractions.CPU()) where T\n    Nx, Ny = patch.Nx, patch.Ny\n\n    # Rescale thermal omega the same way as flow omega\n    omega_T_fine = T(rescaled_omega(omega_T_parent, patch.ratio))\n\n    g_in  = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    g_out = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    Temp  = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, Nx, Ny)\n\n    # Initialize g to equilibrium at T_init\n    w = weights(D2Q9())\n    g_cpu = zeros(T, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    for q in 1:9\n        g_cpu[:, :, q] .= T(w[q]) * T(T_init)\n    end\n    copyto!(g_in, g_cpu)\n    copyto!(g_out, g_cpu)\n\n    # Temporal interpolation buffers (same parent-region size as patch)\n    n_parent_i = size(patch.rho_prev, 1)\n    n_parent_j = size(patch.rho_prev, 2)\n    Temp_prev = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, n_parent_i, n_parent_j)\n    g_prev    = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, n_parent_i, n_parent_j, 9)\n\n    return ThermalPatchArrays{T}(g_in, advance_thermal_refined_step!(domain::RefinedDomain{T},", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    advance_thermal_refined_step!(domain, thermals,\n        f_in, f_out, g_in, g_out, rho, ux, uy, Temp, is_solid;\n        fused_step_fn, bc_thermal_patch_fns)\n\nAdvance one coarse timestep for natural convection with thermal refinement.\nUses the fused kernel on the base grid and sub-cycles both f and g on patches.\n\n# Arguments\n- `thermals`: Vector{ThermalPatchArrays} matching domain.patches\n- `fused_step_fn`: closure `(f_out, f_in, g_out, g_in, Temp, Nx, Ny) -> ...` for base grid\n- `bc_thermal_patch_fns`: Dict{Int, Function} for patch thermal BCs\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    advance_thermal_refined_step!(domain, thermals,\n        f_in, f_out, g_in, g_out, rho, ux, uy, Temp, is_solid;\n        fused_step_fn, bc_thermal_patch_fns)\n\nAdvance one coarse timestep for natural convection with thermal refinement.\nUses the fused kernel on the base grid and sub-cycles both f and g on patches.\n\n# Arguments\n- `thermals`: Vector{ThermalPatchArrays} matching domain.patches\n- `fused_step_fn`: closure `(f_out, f_in, g_out, g_in, Temp, Nx, Ny) -> ...` for base grid\n- `bc_thermal_patch_fns`: Dict{Int, Function} for patch thermal BCs\n\"\"\"\nfunction advance_thermal_refined_step!(domain::RefinedDomain{T},\n                                        thermals::Vector{ThermalPatchArrays{T}},\n                                        f_in, f_out, g_in, g_out,\n                                        rho, ux, uy, Temp, is_solid;\n                                        fused_step_fn,\n                                        omega_T_coarse::Real,\n                                        β_g::Real=zero(T),\n                                        T_ref_buoy::Real=zero(T),\n                                        bc_thermal_patch_fns=nothing,\n                                        bc_flow_patch_fns=nothing,\n                                        bc_coarse_fn=nothing) where T\n    Nx = domain.base_Nx\n    Ny = domain.base_Ny\n\n    # 1. Save coarse state at time n for all patches (f + g)\n    for (pidx, patch) in enumerate(domain.patches)\n        save_coarse_state!(patch, f_in, rho, ux, uy)\n        save_thermal_coarse_state!(patch, thermals[pidx], g_in, Temp)\n    end\n\n    # 2. Advance coarse grid one step (fused kernel)\n    fused_step_fn(f_out, f_in, g_out, g_in, Temp, Nx, Ny)\n    f_in, f_out = f_out, f_in\n    g_in, g_out = g_out, g_in\n\n    # Restore patch-covered cells from saved state (the coarse step\n    # should not modify these — only the patch sub-cycling + restriction\n    # should update them). Without this, the fused step pollutes the\n    # overlap zone and the restriction sees inconsistent populations.\n    for (pidx, patch) in enumerate(domain.patches)\n        thermal = thermals[pidx]\n        _restore_coarse_overlap!(f_in, g_in, patch, thermal)\n    end\n\n    # Recover macroscopic on coarse for ghost fill\n    compute_macroscopic_2d!(rho, ux, uy, f_in)\n    compute_temperature_2d!(Temp, g_in)\n\n    # 3. Sub-cycle each patch\n    for (pidx, patch) in enumerate(domain.patches)\n        thermal = thermals[pidx]\n        ratio = patch.ratio\n\n        for sub_step in 1:ratio\n            t_frac = T((sub_step - 1) / ratio)\n\n            # Flow ghost fill: temporal interpolation between *_prev (n) and f_in (n+1)\n            fill_ghost_temporal!(patch, f_in, rho, ux, uy,\n                                Float64(domain.base_omega), Nx, Ny, t_frac)\n            # Thermal ghost: temporal + FH-rescaled (requires coarse u for g_eq)\n            fill_thermal_ghost!(patch, thermal, g_in, ux, uy, Nx, Ny;\n                                t_frac=t_frac)\n\n            # Stream both f and g on patch\n            stream_2d!(patch.f_out, patch.f_in, patch.Nx, patch.Ny)\n            stream_2d!(thermal.g_out, thermal.g_in, patch.Nx, patch.Ny)\n\n            # Flow BCs on patch (if patch edge touches a domain wall)\n            if bc_flow_patch_fns !== nothing\n                bc_f_fn = get(bc_flow_patch_fns, pidx, nothing)\n                if bc_f_fn !== nothing\n                    bc_f_fn(patch.f_out, patch.Nx, patch.Ny)\n                end\n            end\n\n            # Thermal BCs on patch (if patch edge touches domain wall)\n            if bc_thermal_patch_fns !== nothing\n                bc_fn = get(bc_thermal_patch_fns, pidx, nothing)\n                if bc_fn !== nothing\n                    bc_fn(thermal.g_out, patch.Nx, patch.Ny)\n                end\n            end\n\n            compute_temperature_2d!(thermal.Temp, thermal.g_out)\n            compute_macroscopic_2d!(patch.rho, patch.ux, patch.uy, patch.f_out)\n            collide_thermal_2d!(thermal.g_out, patch.ux, patch.uy, thermal.omega_T)\n            # Body force scales with local dx: a_fine = a_coarse/ratio (acoustic).\n            collide_boussinesq_2d!(patch.f_out, thermal.Temp, patch.is_solid,\n                                    patch.omega, T(β_g) / T(patch.ratio),\n                                    T(T_ref_buoy))\n\n            # Swap for next sub-step\n            copyto!(patch.f_in, patch.f_out)\n            copyto!(thermal.g_in, thermal.g_out)\n        end\n    end\n\n    # 4. Restrict fine results back to coarse\n    for (pidx, patch) in enumerate(domain.patches)\n        thermal = thermals[pidx]\n        restrict_to_coarse!(patch, f_in, rho, ux, uy,\n                           Float64(domain.base_omega))\n        restrict_thermal_to_coarse!(patch, thermal, g_in, Temp)\n    end\n\n    # 5. Re-apply coarse BCs (restriction may overwrite wall values)\n    if bc_coarse_fn !== nothing\n        bc_coarse_fn(f_in, g_in, Temp, Nx, Ny)\n    end\n    compute_macroscopic_2d!(rho, ux, uy, f_in)\n    compute_temperature_2d!(Temp, g_in)\n\n    return f_in, f_out, g_in, g_out\nend\n```"), (name = :RefinementPatch, signature = "struct RefinementPatch{T}", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    RefinementPatch{T}\n\nA rectangular sub-domain at a given refinement level. Existing kernels operate on patches without\nany modification.\n\n# Fields\n- `name`: human-readable label (matches .krk `Refine` block name)\n- `level`: refinement level (0 = base, 1 = first refinement, ...)\n- `ratio`: refinement ratio relative to parent (typically 2)\n- `Nx, Ny`: lattice dimensions including ghost cells\n- `Nx_inner, Ny_inner`: lattice dimensions excluding ghost Ny]\n- `omega`: relaxation parameter (rescaled from parent)\n\"\"\"\nstruct RefinementPatch{T}\n    name::String\n    level::Int\n    ratio::Int\n    Nx::Int\n    Ny::Int\n    Nx_inner::Int\n                     parent_omega::Real,\n                      ::Type{T}=Float64;\n                      n_ghost::Int=2,\n                      backend=KernelAbstractions.CPU()) where T\n    x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max = region\n\n    # Map physical region to parent grid indices (cell-center convention)\n    i_start = max(1, floor(Int, x_min / parent_dx) + 1)\n    j_start = max(1, floor(Int, y_min / parent_dx) + 1)\n    i_end = min(parent_Nx, ceil(Int, x_max / parent_dx))\n    j_end = min(parent_Ny, ceil(Int, y_max / parent_dx))\n\n    parent_i_range = i_start:i_end\n    parent_j_range = j_start:j_end\n\n    # Fine grid dimensions (inner = ratio * parent cells covered)\n    Nx_inner = (i_end - i_start + 1) * ratio\n    Ny_inner = (j_end - j_start + 1) * ratio\n    Nx = Nx_inner + 2 * n_ghost\n    Ny = Ny_inner + 2 * n_ghost\n\n    dx_fine = T(parent_dx / ratio)\n    omega_fine = T(rescaled_omega(parent_omega, ratio))\n\n    # Snap physical extent to parent cell boundaries\n    x_min_snap = T((i_start - 1) * parent_dx)\n    y_min_snap = T((j_start - 1) * parent_dx)\n    x_max_snap = T(i_end * parent_dx)\n    y_max_snap = T(j_end * parent_dx)\n\n    # Allocate GPU arrays\n    f_in  = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    f_out = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    rho   = KernelAbstractions.ones(backend, T, Nx, Ny)\n    ux    = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, Nx, Ny)\n    uy    = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, Nx, Ny)\n    is_solid = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, Bool, Nx, Ny)\n\n    # Initialize f to equilibrium (rho=1, u=0)\n    w = weights(D2Q9())\n    f_cpu = zeros(T, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    for q in 1:9\n        f_cpu[:, :, q] .= T(w[q])\n    end\n    copyto!(f_in, f_cpu)\n    copyto!(f_out, f_cpu)\n\n    # Temporal interpolation buffers (parent-size region + halo for interpolation)\n    n_parent_i = length(parent_i_range) + 2  # +2 for bilinear stencil margin\n    n_parent_j = length(parent_j_range) + 2\n    rho_prev = KernelAbstractions.ones(backend, T, n_parent_i, n_parent_j)\n    ux_prev  = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, n_parent_i, n_parent_j)\n    uy_prev  = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, n_parent_i, n_parent_j)\n    f_prev   = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, n_parent_i, n_parent_j, 9)\n\n    return RefinementPatch{T}(\n        name, level, ratio, Nx, Ny, Nx_inner, Ny_inner,\n        dx_fine, x_min_snap, y_min_snap, x_max_snap, y_max_snap,\n        parent_i_range, parent_j_range, n_ghost,\n        f_in, f_out, rho, ux, uy, is_solid, omega_fine,\n        rho_prev, ux_prev, uy_prev, f_prev\n    )\nend\n```"), (name = :create_refined_domain, signature = "function create_refined_domain(base_Nx::Int, base_Ny::Int, base_dx::Real,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    create_refined_domain(base_Nx, base_Ny, base_dx, base_omega, patches) -> RefinedDomain\n\nBuild a RefinedDomain from a base grid specification and a list of patches.\nPatches must be ordered by level (level 1 first, then level 2, etc.).\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    create_refined_domain(base_Nx, base_Ny, base_dx, base_omega, patches) -> RefinedDomain\n\nBuild a RefinedDomain from a base grid specification and a list of patches.\nPatches must be ordered by level (level 1 first, then level 2, etc.).\n\"\"\"\nfunction create_refined_domain(base_Nx::Int, base_Ny::Int, base_dx::Real,\n                               base_omega::Real,\n                               patches::Vector{RefinementPatch{T}};\n                               parent_map::Dict{Int, Int}=Dict{Int, Int}()) where T\n    # Default: all patches have the base grid as parent\n    parent_of = copy(parent_map)\n    for (idx, _) in enumerate(patches)\n        if !haskey(parent_of, idx)\n            parent_of[idx] = 0\n        end\n    end\n\n    # Build reverse mapping\n    children_of = Dict{Int, Vector{Int}}()\n    for (child, parent) in parent_of\n        if !haskey(children_of, parent)\n            children_of[parent] = Int[]\n        end\n        push!(children_of[parent], child)\n    end\n\n    return RefinedDomain{T}(\n        base_Nx, base_Ny, T(base_dx), T(base_omega),\n        patches, parent_of, children_of\n    )\nend\n```"), (name = :rescaled_omega, signature = "function rescaled_omega(omega_parent::Real, 2).\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    rescaling_factor_c2f(omega_coarse, omega_fine, ratio) -> Float64\n\nNon-equilibrium rescaling factor for coarse-to-fine ghost fill advance_refined_step!(domain, f_in, f_out, rho, ux, uy, is_solid;\n                          stream_fn, collide_fn, macro_fn, bc_base_fn,\n                          bc_patch_fns, patch_collide_fns, patch_macro_fn)\n\nAdvance the full refined domain by one coarse timestep with sub-cycling.\n\n# Algorithm\n1. Save coarse state at time n for all patches\n2. Advance coarse grid one step\n3. For each patch, sub-cycle `ratio` fine steps with temporal interpolation\n4. Restrict fine results back to coarse overlap\n\n# Keywords\n- `patch_collide_fns`: optional `Dict{Int, Function}` mapping patch index to a\n  custom `(f, is_solid) -> ...` collision closure. Useful for body-force scaling\n  (`F/ratio` on fine grids). When absent, defaults to `collide_2d!(f, is_s, patch.omega)`.\n- `patch_macro_fn`: optional macroscopic function for patches (e.g.\n  `compute_macroscopic_forced_2d!`). Defaults to `compute_macroscopic_2d!`.\n\nReturns updated (f_in, f_out) for the base grid (swapped).\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    advance_refined_step!(domain, f_in, f_out, rho, ux, uy, is_solid;\n                          stream_fn, collide_fn, macro_fn, bc_base_fn,\n                          bc_patch_fns, patch_collide_fns, patch_macro_fn)\n\nAdvance the full refined domain by one coarse timestep with sub-cycling.\n\n# Algorithm\n1. Save coarse state at time n for all patches\n2. Advance coarse grid one step\n3. For each patch, sub-cycle `ratio` fine steps with temporal interpolation\n4. Restrict fine results back to coarse overlap\n\n# Keywords\n- `patch_collide_fns`: optional `Dict{Int, Function}` mapping patch index to a\n  custom `(f, is_solid) -> ...` collision closure. Useful for body-force scaling\n  (`F/ratio` on fine grids). When absent, defaults to `collide_2d!(f, is_s, patch.omega)`.\n- `patch_macro_fn`: optional macroscopic function for patches (e.g.\n  `compute_macroscopic_forced_2d!`). Defaults to `compute_macroscopic_2d!`.\n\nReturns updated (f_in, f_out) for the base grid (swapped).\n\"\"\"\nfunction advance_refined_step!(domain::RefinedDomain{T},\n                               f_in, f_out, rho, ux, uy, is_solid;\n                               stream_fn,\n                               collide_fn,\n                               macro_fn,\n                               bc_base_fn=nothing,\n                               bc_patch_fns=nothing,\n                               patch_collide_fns=nothing,\n                               patch_macro_fn=nothing,\n                               patch_diag_fns=nothing,\n                               coarse_diag_fn=nothing) where T\n    Nx = domain.base_Nx\n    Ny = domain.base_Ny\n\n    # 1. Save coarse state at time n for all patches\n    for patch in domain.patches\n        save_coarse_state!(patch, f_in, rho, ux, uy)\n    end\n\n    # 2. Advance coarse grid one step\n    stream_fn(f_out, f_in, Nx, Ny)\n    if bc_base_fn !== nothing\n        bc_base_fn(f_out)\n    end\n    # Coarse diagnostic between post-stream+BC and pre-collide.\n    # Restriction (step 4 of the previous call) has already pushed fine\n    # patch data back into f_in over the cylinder region, so a coarse\n    # MEA here reflects the refined physics without FH force rescaling.\n    if coarse_diag_fn !== nothing\n        coarse_diag_fn(f_in, f_out, is_solid, Nx, Ny)\n    end\n    collide_fn(f_out, is_solid)\n    macro_fn(rho, ux, uy, f_out)\n    f_in, f_out = f_out, f_in\n\n    # 3. Sub-cycle each patch\n    for (pidx, patch) in enumerate(domain.patches)\n        ratio = patch.ratio\n\n        for sub_step in 1:ratio\n            # Temporal interpolation: sub_step=1 -> t_frac=0, sub_step=ratio -> (ratio-1)/ratio\n            t_frac = T((sub_step - 1) / ratio)\n\n            # Temporal ghost fill: at t_frac=0 reads from *_prev (time n),\n            # at t_frac>0 blends toward current f_in (time n+1).\n            fill_ghost_temporal!(patch, f_in, rho, ux, uy,\n                                Float64(domain.base_omega), Nx, Ny, t_frac)\n\n            # Advance patch one fine step\n            bc_fn = bc_patch_fns !== nothing ? get(bc_patch_fns, pidx, nothing) : nothing\n            pcf = patch_collide_fns !== nothing ? get(patch_collide_fns, pidx, nothing) : nothing\n            pmf = patch_macro_fn !== nothing ? patch_macro_fn : compute_macroscopic_2d!\n            pdf = patch_diag_fns !== nothing ? get(patch_diag_fns, pidx, nothing) : nothing\n            advance_patch!(patch;\n                          stream_fn=stream_fn,\n                          collide_fn=pcf !== nothing ? pcf : (f, is_s) -> collide_2d!(f, is_s, patch.omega),\n                          macro_fn=pmf,\n                          bc_fn=bc_fn,\n                          diagnostic_fn=pdf)\n\n            # Copy f_out -> f_in for next sub-step\n            copyto!(patch.f_in, patch.f_out)\n        end\n    end\n\n    # 4. Restrict fine results back to coarse\n    for patch in domain.patches\n        restrict_to_coarse!(patch, f_in, rho, ux, uy,\n                           Float64(domain.base_omega))\n    end\n\n    return f_in, f_out\nend\n```")]

fields\n\"\"\"\nfunction write_snapshot_3d!(output_dir::String, step::Int, Nx::Int, Ny::Int, Nz::Int, dx,\n                            fields::Dict;\n                            pvd=nothing, time::Float64=0.0)\n    tag = lpad(step, 7, '0')\n    filename = joinpath(output_dir, \"snapshot_\$tag\")\n    dx_f = Float64(dx)\n\n    xs = collect(range(0.0, step=dx_f, length=Nx + 1))\n    ys = collect(range(0.0, step=dx_f, length=Ny + 1))\n    zs = collect(range(0.0, step=dx_f, length=Nz + 1))\n\n    vtk_grid(filename, xs, ys, zs) do vtk\n        for (name, data) in fields\n            if data isa Tuple{AbstractArray, AbstractArray, AbstractArray}\n                ux_cpu = Array(data[1])\n                uy_cpu = Array(data[2])\n                uz_cpu = Array(data[3])\n                vtk[name] = (ux_cpu, uy_cpu, uz_cpu)\n            else\n                vtk[name] = Array(data)\n            end\n        end\n        if pvd !== nothing\n            pvd[time] = vtk\n        end\n    end\nend\n```"), (name = :write_vtk_multiblock, signature = "function write_vtk_multiblock(filename::String,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    write_vtk_multiblock(filename, blocks::Vector{<:NamedTuple})\n\nWrite a multi-block VTK `.vtm` file. Each block is a NamedTuple with:\n- `name::String`\n- `Nx::Int, Ny::Int`\n- `dx::Float64`\n- `x_min::Float64, y_min::Float64`\n- `fields::Dict{String, <:AbstractMatrix}`\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    write_vtk_multiblock(filename, blocks::Vector{<:NamedTuple})\n\nWrite a multi-block VTK `.vtm` file. Each block is a NamedTuple with:\n- `name::String`\n- `Nx::Int, Ny::Int`\n- `dx::Float64`\n- `x_min::Float64, y_min::Float64`\n- `fields::Dict{String, <:AbstractMatrix}`\n\"\"\"\nfunction write_vtk_multiblock(filename::String,\n                               blocks::Vector{<:NamedTuple})\n    vtk_multiblock(filename) do vtm\n        for blk in blocks\n            xs = collect(range(blk.x_min, step=blk.dx, length=blk.Nx + 1))\n            ys = collect(range(blk.y_min, step=blk.dx, length=blk.Ny + 1))\n            vtk_grid(vtm, xs, ys) do vtk\n                for (fname, data) in blk.fields\n                    vtk[fname] = Array(data)\n                end\n            end\n        end\n    end\nend\n```"), (name = :write_snapshot_refined_2d!, signature = "function write_snapshot_refined_2d!(output_dir::String, step::Int,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    write_snapshot_refined_2d!(output_dir, step, domain, rho, ux, uy;\n                               pvd=nothing, time=0.0)\n\nWrite a multi-block VTK snapshot for a refined domain.\nIncludes the base grid and all refinement patches.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    write_snapshot_refined_2d!(output_dir, step, domain, rho, ux, uy;\n                               pvd=nothing, time=0.0)\n\nWrite a multi-block VTK snapshot for a refined domain.\nIncludes the base grid and all refinement patches.\n\"\"\"\nfunction write_snapshot_refined_2d!(output_dir::String, step::Int,\n                                    domain::RefinedDomain{T},\n                                    rho, ux, uy;\n                                    pvd=nothing, time::Float64=0.0) where T\n    blocks = NamedTuple[]\n\n    # Base grid block\n    push!(blocks, (\n        name=\"base\",\n        Nx=domain.base_Nx, Ny=domain.base_Ny,\n        dx=Float64(domain.base_dx),\n        x_min=0.0, y_min=0.0,\n        fields=Dict(\"rho\" => rho, \"ux\" => ux, \"uy\" => uy)\n    ))\n\n    # Patch blocks (inner region only, skip ghost cells)\n    for patch in domain.patches\n        ng = patch.n_ghost\n        inner_rho = @view patch.rho[ng+1:ng+patch.Nx_inner, ng+1:ng+patch.Ny_inner]\n        inner_ux  = @view patch.ux[ng+1:ng+patch.Nx_inner, ng+1:ng+patch.Ny_inner]\n        inner_uy  = @view patch.uy[ng+1:ng+patch.Nx_inner, ng+1:ng+patch.Ny_inner]\n        push!(blocks, (\n            name=patch.name,\n            Nx=patch.Nx_inner, Ny=patch.Ny_inner,\n            dx=Float64(patch.dx),\n            x_min=Float64(patch.x_min), y_min=Float64(patch.y_min),\n            fields=Dict(\"rho\" => inner_rho, \"ux\" => inner_ux, \"uy\" => inner_uy)\n        ))\n    end\n\n    tag = lpad(step, 7, '0')\n    filename = joinpath(output_dir, \"snapshot_\$tag\")\n    if pvd !== nothing\n        write_vtk_multiblock_to_pvd(pvd, filename, blocks, Float64(time))\n    else\n        write_vtk_multiblock(filename, blocks)\n    end\nend\n```"), (name = :DiagnosticsLogger, signature length(logger.columns)\n    nval = length(values)\n    nval == ncol || error(\"Expected \$ncol values, got \$nval\")\n    println(logger.io, join(string.(values), \",\"))\n    flush(logger.io)\n Fin[i, j, 3] : Fin[i, j+1, 5]\n            Fout[i, j, 6] = Fin[i, j, 8]\n            Fout[i, j, 7] = Fin[i, j, 9]\n            Fout[i, j, 8] = ny == 1 ? Fin[i, j, 6] : Fin[ip, j+1, 8]\n            Fout[i, j, 9] = ny == 1 ? Fin[i, j, 7] : Fin[im, j+1, 9]\n        elseif j == ny\n            Fout[i, j, 3] = Fin[i, j-1, 3]\n            Fout[i, j, 5] = Fin[i, j, 3]\n            Fout[i, j, 6] = Fin[im, j-1, 6]\n            Fout[i, j, 7] = Fin[ip, j-1, 7]\n            Fout[i, j, 8] = Fin[i, j, 6]\n            Fout[i, j, 9] = Fin[i, j, 7]\n        else\n            Fout[i, j, 3] = Fin[i, j-1, 3]\n            Fout[i, j, 5] = Fin[i, j+1, 5]\n            Fout[i, j, 6] = Fin[im, j-1, 6]\n            Fout[i, j, 7] = Fin[ip, j-1, 7]\n            Fout[i, j, 8] = Fin[ip, j+1, 8]\n            Fout[i, j, 9] = Fin[im, j+1, 9]\n        end\n    end\n    return Fout\nend\n```"), (name = :stream_periodic_x_moving_wall_y_F_2d!, signature = "function stream_periodic_x_moving_wall_y_F_2d!(Fout::AbstractArray{<:Any,3},", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    stream_periodic_x_moving_wall_y_F_2d!(Fout, Fin; u_south=0, u_north=0,\n                                          rho_wall=1, volume=1)\n\nPure pull streaming for a leaf grid with periodic `x` and bounce-back walls at\nthe south/north `y` boundaries. Fin[i, j, 6] : Fin[ip, j+1, 8]\n            Fout[i, j, 9] = ny == 1 ? Fin[i, j, 7] : Fin[im, j+1, 9]\n        elseif j == ny\n            Fout[i, j, 3] = Fin[i, j-1, 3]\n            Fout[i, j, 5] = Fin[i, j, 3]\n            Fout[i, j, 6] = Fin[im, j-1, 6]\n            Fout[i, j, 7] = Fin[ip, j-1, 7]\n            Fout[i, j, 8] = Fin[i, j, 6] + _moving_wall_delta(volume, rho_wall, u_north, 8)\n            Fout[i, j, 9] = Fin[i, j, 7] + _moving_wall_delta(volume, rho_wall, u_north, 9)\n        else\n            Fout[i, j, 3] = Fin[i, j-1, 3]\n            Fout[i, j, 5] = Fin[i, j+1, 5]\n            Fout[i, j, 6] = Fin[im, j-1, 6]\n            Fout[i, j, 7] = Fin[ip, j-1, 7]\n            Fout[i, j, 8] = Fin[ip, j+1, 8]\n            Fout[i, j, 9] = Fin[im, j+1, 9]\n        end\n    end\n    return Fout\nend\n```"), (name = :stream_periodic_x_wall_y_solid_F_2d!, signature = "function stream_periodic_x_wall_y_solid_F_2d!(Fout::AbstractArray{<:Any,3},", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    stream_periodic_x_wall_y_solid_F_2d!(Fout, Fin, is_solid)\n\nPull streaming on a leaf grid with periodic x, channel walls in y, and\nhalfway bounce-back on solid links. Solid destination cells are filled with\ntheir previous values and are ignored by the solid-aware collision routines.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    stream_periodic_x_wall_y_solid_F_2d!(Fout, Fin, is_solid)\n\nPull streaming on a leaf grid with periodic x, channel walls in y, and\nhalfway bounce-back on solid links. Solid destination cells are filled with\ntheir previous values and are ignored by the solid-aware collision routines.\n\"\"\"\nfunction stream_periodic_x_wall_y_solid_F_2d!(Fout::AbstractArray{<:Any,3},\n                                              Fin::AbstractArray{<:Any,3},\n                                              is_solid::AbstractArray{Bool,2})\n    Fout === Fin && throw(ArgumentError(\"Fout and Fin must be distinct arrays\"))\n    _check_d2q9_grid_pair(Fout, Fin)\n    _check_solid_mask_layout(Fin, is_solid)\n\n    nx = size(Fin, 1)\n    ny = size(Fin, 2)\n    @inbounds for j in 1:ny, i in 1:nx\n        if is_solid[i, j]\n            for q in 1:9\n                Fout[i, j, q] = Fin[i, j, q]\n            end\n            continue\n        end\n\n        for q in 1:9\n            cx = d2q9_cx(q)\n            cy = d2q9_cy(q)\n            if cx == 0 && cy == 0\n                Fout[i, j, q] = Fin[i, j, q]\n                continue\n            end\n\n            isrc = mod1(i - cx, nx)\n            jsrc = j - cy\n            if jsrc < 1 || jsrc > ny\n                Fout[i, j, q] = Fin[i, j, d2q9_opposite(q)]\n            elseif is_solid[isrc, jsrc]\n                Fout[i, j, q] = Fin[i, j, d2q9_opposite(q)]\n            else\n                Fout[i, j, q] = Fin[isrc, jsrc, q]\n            end\n        end\n    end\n    return Fout\nend\n```"), (name = :stream_bounceback_xy_solid_F_2d!, signature = "function stream_bounceback_xy_solid_F_2d!(Fout::AbstractArray{<:Any,3},", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    stream_bounceback_xy_solid_F_2d!(Fout::AbstractArray{<:Any,3},\n\nPublic function in the grid-refinement and conservative-tree AMR API.\nSee the method definition below for argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations. The bang suffix indicates that one or more array arguments are updated in-place.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.stream_bounceback_xy_solid_F_2d!)\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction stream_bounceback_xy_solid_F_2d!(Fout::AbstractArray{<:Any,3},\n                                          Fin::AbstractArray{<:Any,3},\n                                          is_solid::AbstractArray{Bool,2})\n    Fout === Fin && throw(ArgumentError(\"Fout and Fin must be distinct arrays\"))\n    _check_d2q9_grid_pair(Fout, Fin)\n    _check_solid_mask_layout(Fin, is_solid)\n\n    nx = size(Fin, 1)\n    ny = size(Fin, 2)\n    @inbounds for j in 1:ny, i in 1:nx\n        if is_solid[i, j]\n            for q in 1:9\n                Fout[i, j, q] = Fin[i, j, q]\n            end\n            continue\n        end\n\n        for q in 1:9\n            cx = d2q9_cx(q)\n            cy = d2q9_cy(q)\n            if cx == 0 && cy == 0\n                Fout[i, j, q] = Fin[i, j, q]\n                continue\n            end\n\n            isrc = i - cx\n            jsrc = j - cy\n            if isrc < 1 || isrc > nx || jsrc < 1 || jsrc > ny\n                Fout[i, j, q] = Fin[i, j, d2q9_opposite(q)]\n            elseif is_solid[isrc, jsrc]\n                Fout[i, j, q] = Fin[i, j, d2q9_opposite(q)]\n            else\n                Fout[i, j, q] = Fin[isrc, jsrc, q]\n            end\n        end\n    end\n    return Fout\nend\n```"), (name = :stream_conservative_tree_routes_F_2d!, signature = "function stream_conservative_tree_routes_F_2d!(", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    stream_conservative_tree_routes_F_2d!(Fout, Fin, spec, table;\n                                          boundary=:skip, u_south=0,\n                                          u_north=0, rho_wall=1)\n\nScatter integrated D2Q9 populations through a static multilevel route table.\n`Fout` is zeroed before scattering. Boundary routes are explicit:\n\n- `boundary = :skip` drops boundary packets for packet-level route tests;\n- `boundary = :bounceback` reflects boundary packets to `opposite(q)` in the\n  source cell, useful for closed rest-state canaries.\n- `boundary = :periodic_x_wall_y` is the same reflection contract for route\n  tables built with `periodic_x=true`;\n- `boundary = :periodic_x_moving_wall_y` adds the standard tangential moving\n  wall correction on y-boundary packets.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    stream_conservative_tree_routes_F_2d!(Fout, Fin, spec, table;\n                                          boundary=:skip, u_south=0,\n                                          u_north=0, rho_wall=1)\n\nScatter integrated D2Q9 populations through a static multilevel route table.\n`Fout` is zeroed before scattering. Boundary routes are explicit:\n\n- `boundary = :skip` drops boundary packets for packet-level route tests;\n- `boundary = :bounceback` reflects boundary packets to `opposite(q)` in the\n  source cell, useful for closed rest-state canaries.\n- `boundary = :periodic_x_wall_y` is the same reflection contract for route\n  tables built with `periodic_x=true`;\n- `boundary = :periodic_x_moving_wall_y` adds the standard tangential moving\n  wall correction on y-boundary packets.\n\"\"\"\nfunction stream_conservative_tree_routes_F_2d!(\n        Fout::AbstractMatrix,\n        Fin::AbstractMatrix,\n        spec::ConservativeTreeSpec2D,\n        table::ConservativeTreeRouteTable2D;\n        boundary::Symbol=:skip,\n        u_south=0,\n        u_north=0,\n        rho_wall=1)\n    _check_conservative_tree_stream_args_2d(Fout, Fin, spec)\n    policy = _check_conservative_tree_boundary_policy_2d(boundary)\n    fill!(Fout, zero(eltype(Fout)))\n\n    @inbounds for route in table.routes\n        packet = route.weight * Fin[route.src, route.q]\n        if route.dst == 0\n            if policy != :skip\n                reflected = policy == :bounceback ? packet :\n                    _conservative_tree_boundary_reflection_packet_2d(\n                        Fin, spec, route, policy; u_south=u_south,\n                        u_north=u_north, rho_wall=rho_wall)\n                Fout[route.src, d2q9_opposite(route.q)] += reflected\n            end\n        else\n            Fout[route.dst, route.q] += packet\n        end\n    end\n    return Fout\nend\n```"), (name = :stream_composite_fully_periodic_leaf_F_2d!, signature = "function stream_composite_fully_periodic_leaf_F_2d!(", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    stream_composite_fully_periodic_leaf_F_2d!(coarse_out, patch_out,\n                                               coarse_in, patch_in)\n\nConservative prototype stream step for a fixed-tree composite state. The bang suffix indicates that one or more array arguments are updated in-place.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.stream_conservative_tree_gpu_pack_interior_F_2d!)\n```\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    stream_conservative_tree_gpu_pack_interior_F_2d!(\n\nPublic function in the grid-refinement and conservative-tree AMR API.\nSee the method definition below for argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations. The bang suffix indicates that one or more array arguments are updated in-place.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.stream_conservative_tree_gpu_pack_interior_F_2d!)\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction stream_conservative_tree_gpu_pack_interior_F_2d!(\n        coarse_out::AbstractArray{<:Any,3},\n        patch_out::ConservativeTreePatch2D,\n        coarse_in::AbstractArray{<:Any,3},\n        patch_in::ConservativeTreePatch2D,\n        pack::ConservativeTreeGPURoutePack2D)\n    _check_composite_coarse_layout(coarse_in, patch_in)\n    _check_composite_coarse_layout(coarse_out, patch_out)\n    size(coarse_out) == size(coarse_in) ||\n        throw(ArgumentError(\"coarse_out and coarse_in must have the same size\"))\n    patch_out.parent_i_range == patch_in.parent_i_range &&\n        patch_out.parent_j_range == patch_in.parent_j_range ||\n        throw(ArgumentError(\"patch_out and patch_in must cover the same parent range\"))\n\n    coarse_out .= 0\n    patch_out.fine_F .= 0\n    patch_out.coarse_shadow_F .= 0\n\n    boundary_kind = UInt8(ROUTE_BOUNDARY)\n    @inbounds for route_index in eachindex(pack.route_src)\n        pack.route_kind[route_index] == boundary_kind && continue\n        src = Int(pack.route_src[route_index])\n        dst = Int(pack.route_dst[route_index])\n        dst > 0 || throw(ArgumentError(\"non-boundary packed route has zero destination\"))\n        q = Int(pack.route_q[route_index])\n        packet = _gpu_pack_cell_Fq_2d(coarse_in, patch_in, pack, src, q)\n        _gpu_pack_add_cell_Fq_2d!(\n            coarse_out, patch_out, pack, dst, q,\n            pack.route_weight[route_index] * packet)\n    end\n    coalesce_patch_to_shadow_F_2d!(patch_out)\n    return coarse_out, patch_out\nend\n```")]

Nx, Ny, Nz)\n\nApply bounce-back on bottom, south, north, west, east faces.\nTop face (k=Nz) is handled by Zou-He.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    apply_bounce_back_walls_3d!(f, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n\nApply bounce-back on bottom, south, north, west, east faces.\nTop face (k=Nz) is handled by Zou-He.\n\"\"\"\nfunction apply_bounce_back_walls_3d!(f, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n    backend = KernelAbstractions.get_backend(f)\n    kernel! = bounce_back_face_3d_kernel!(backend)\n\n    # Bottom (k=1): ndrange = (Nx, Ny)\n    kernel!(f, Nx, Ny, Nx, Int32(1); ndrange=(Nx, Ny))\n    # South (j=1): ndrange = (Nx, Nz)\n    kernel!(f, Ny, Nz, Nx, Int32(2); ndrange=(Nx, Nz))\n    # North (j=Ny): ndrange = (Nx, Nz)\n    kernel!(f, Ny, Nz, Nx, Int32(3); ndrange=(Nx, Nz))\n    # West (i=1): ndrange = (Ny, Nz)\n    kernel!(f, Ny, Nz, Nx, Int32(4); ndrange=(Ny, Nz))\n    # East (i=Nx): ndrange = (Ny, Nz)\n    kernel!(f, Ny, Nz, Nx, Int32(5); ndrange=(Ny, Nz))\n\nend\n```"), (name = :apply_bounce_back_wall_3d!, signature = "function apply_bounce_back_wall_3d!(f, Nx, Ny, Nz, face::Symbol)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    apply_bounce_back_wall_3d!(f, Nx, Ny, Nz, face::Symbol)\n\nApply bounce-back on a single face of the 3D domain.\nFaces: :west, :east, :south, :north, :bottom, :top.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    apply_bounce_back_wall_3d!(f, Nx, Ny, Nz, face::Symbol)\n\nApply bounce-back on a single face of the 3D domain.\nFaces: :west, :east, :south, :north, :bottom, :top.\n\"\"\"\nfunction apply_bounce_back_wall_3d!(f, Nx, Ny, Nz, face::Symbol)\n    backend = KernelAbstractions.get_backend(f)\n    if face === :bottom\n        kernel! = bounce_back_face_3d_kernel!(backend)\n        kernel!(f, Nx, Ny, Nx, Int32(1); ndrange=(Nx, Ny))\n    elseif face === :top\n        kernel! = _bounce_back_top_3d_kernel!(backend)\n        kernel!(f, Nx, Ny, Nz; ndrange=(Nx, Ny))\n    elseif face === :south\n        kernel! = bounce_back_face_3d_kernel!(backend)\n        kernel!(f, Ny, Nz, Nx, Int32(2); ndrange=(Nx, Nz))\n    elseif face === :north\n        kernel! = bounce_back_face_3d_kernel!(backend)\n        kernel!(f, Ny, Nz, Nx, Int32(3); ndrange=(Nx, Nz))\n    elseif face === :west\n        kernel! = bounce_back_face_3d_kernel!(backend)\n        kernel!(f, Ny, Nz, Nx, Int32(4); ndrange=(Ny, Nz))\n    elseif face === :east\n        kernel! = bounce_back_face_3d_kernel!(backend)\n        kernel!(f, Ny, Nz, Nx, Int32(5); ndrange=(Ny, Nz))\n    else\n        error(\"apply_bounce_back_wall_3d!: unknown face \$face\")\n    end\nend\n```"), (name = :apply_bounce_back_walls_2d!, signature = "function apply_bounce_back_walls_2d!(f, Nx, Ny)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    apply_bounce_back_walls_2d!(f, Nx, Ny)\n\nApply simple bounce-back on south, west, and east walls of a 2D cavity.\nNorth wall is handled by Zou-He (lid velocity).\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    apply_bounce_back_walls_2d!(f, Nx, Ny)\n\nApply simple bounce-back on south, west, and east walls of a 2D cavity.\nNorth wall is handled by Zou-He (lid velocity).\n\"\"\"\nfunction apply_bounce_back_walls_2d!(f, Nx, Ny)\n    backend = KernelAbstractions.get_backend(f)\n    kernel! = bounce_back_walls_2d_kernel!(backend)\n\n    # South wall (j=1)\n    kernel!(f, Nx, Ny, Int32(1); ndrange=(Nx,))\n    # West wall (i=1)\n    kernel!(f, Nx, Ny, Int32(2); ndrange=(Ny,))\n    # East wall (i=Nx)\n    kernel!(f, Nx, Ny, Int32(3); ndrange=(Ny,))\n\nend\n```"), (name = :apply_bounce_back_wall_2d!, signature = "function apply_bounce_back_wall_2d!(f, Nx, Ny, side::Symbol)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    apply_bounce_back_wall_2d!(f, Nx, Ny, side)\n\nApply bounce-back on a single wall. `side ∈ (:south, :west, :east, :north)`.\nUsed by refinement patches that touch only some domain walls.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    apply_bounce_back_wall_2d!(f, Nx, Ny, side)\n\nApply bounce-back on a single wall. `side ∈ (:south, :west, :east, :north)`.\nUsed by refinement patches that touch only some domain walls.\n\"\"\"\nfunction apply_bounce_back_wall_2d!(f, Nx, Ny, side::Symbol)\n    backend = KernelAbstractions.get_backend(f)\n    kernel! = bounce_back_walls_2d_kernel!(backend)\n    if side === :south\n        kernel!(f, Nx, Ny, Int32(1); ndrange=(Nx,))\n    elseif side === :west\n        kernel!(f, Nx, Ny, Int32(2); ndrange=(Ny,))\n    elseif side === :east\n        kernel!(f, Nx, Ny, Int32(3); ndrange=(Ny,))\n    elseif side === :north\n        kernel!(f, Nx, Ny, Int32(4); ndrange=(Nx,))\n    else\n        error(\"apply_bounce_back_wall_2d!: unknown side \$(side)\")\n    end\nend\n```"), (name = :apply_bc_rebuild_2d!, signature = "function apply_bc_rebuild_2d!(f_out, f_in, bcspec::BCSpec2D, ν::Real,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    apply_bc_rebuild_2d!(f_out, f_in, bcspec, ν, Nx, Ny;\n                          sp_field=nothing, sm_field=nothing)\n\nApply the per-face BCs in `bcspec::BCSpec2D` to `f_out` at the current\nstep. Reads pre-step values from `f_in` (streamed from interior) for\neach active face, applies the Zou-He closure, and collides locally with\nTRT Λ=3/16 at the requested viscosity `ν`.\n\nIf `sp_field` and `sm_field` (2D arrays) are provided, per-cell local\nrates are used at each face instead of the uniform ν-derived rates.\nThis is needed for SLBM on non-uniform meshes where τ varies per cell.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    apply_bc_rebuild_2d!(f_out, f_in, bcspec, ν, Nx, Ny;\n                          sp_field=nothing, sm_field=nothing)\n\nApply the per-face BCs in `bcspec::BCSpec2D` to `f_out` at the current\nstep. Reads pre-step values from `f_in` (streamed from interior) for\neach active face, applies the Zou-He closure, and collides locally with\nTRT Λ=3/16 at the requested viscosity `ν`.\n\nIf `sp_field` and `sm_field` (2D arrays) are provided, per-cell local\nrates are used at each face instead of the uniform ν-derived rates.\nThis is needed for SLBM on non-uniform meshes where τ varies per cell.\n\"\"\"\nfunction apply_bc_rebuild_2d!(f_out, f_in, bcspec::BCSpec2D, ν::Real,\n                                Nx::Int, Ny::Int;\n                                sp_field=nothing, sm_field=nothing,\n                                ρ_out=nothing, ux_out=nothing, uy_out=nothing)\n    backend = KernelAbstractions.get_backend(f_out)\n    T = eltype(f_out)\n    s_p_r, s_m_r = trt_rates(ν; Λ=3/16)\n    s_p_uni = T(s_p_r); s_m_uni = T(s_m_r)\n\n    if isnothing(sp_field)\n        _apply_bc_2d_west!(backend, f_out, f_in, bcspec.west, s_p_uni, s_m_uni, Nx, Ny;\n                             south_bc=bcspec.south, north_bc=bcspec.north)\n        _apply_bc_2d_east!(backend, f_out, f_in, bcspec.east, s_p_uni, s_m_uni, Nx, Ny;\n                             south_bc=bcspec.south, north_bc=bcspec.north)\n    else\n        _apply_bc_2d_west_local!(backend, f_out, f_in, bcspec.west, sp_field, sm_field, Nx, Ny;\n                                   south_bc=bcspec.south, north_bc=bcspec.north)\n        _apply_bc_2d_east_local!(backend, f_out, f_in, bcspec.east, sp_field, sm_field, Nx, Ny;\n                                   south_bc=bcspec.south, north_bc=bcspec.north)\n    end\n    _apply_bc_2d_south!(backend, f_out, f_in, bcspec.south, s_p_uni, s_m_uni, Nx, Ny;\n                          west_bc=bcspec.west, east_bc=bcspec.east)\n    _apply_bc_2d_north!(backend, f_out, f_in, bcspec.north, s_p_uni, s_m_uni, Nx, Ny;\n                          west_bc=bcspec.west, east_bc=bcspec.east)\n\n    if !isnothing(ρ_out)\n        _update_bc_moments_2d!(f_out, ρ_out, ux_out, uy_out, bcspec, Nx, Ny)\n    end\n    return nothing\nend\n```"), (name = :apply_bc_rebuild_3d!, signature = "function apply_bc_rebuild_3d!(f_out, f_in, bcspec::BCSpec3D, ν::Real,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    apply_bc_rebuild_3d!(f_out, f_in, bcspec, ν, Nx, Ny, Nz;\n                          sp_field=nothing, sm_field=nothing,\n                          apply_transverse=false)\n\n3D analog of `apply_bc_rebuild_2d!`. Dispatches per-face on the BC type\nin `bcspec::BCSpec3D` and applies them to `f_out`.\n\n- `west`/`east` : ZouHeVelocity / ZouHePressure (or HalfwayBB no-op)\n- `south`/`north`/`bottom`/`top` : HalfwayBB explicit swaps when\n  `apply_transverse=true`; **default false** for backwards-compat with\n  `fused_trt_libb_v2_step_3d!`, whose `PullHalfwayBB_3D` brick already\n  performs the transverse halfway-BB swap inside the streaming kernel.\n  SLBM-based callers (`PullSLBM_3D`) clamp at non-periodic edges and\n  must set `apply_transverse=true`.\n\nIf `sp_field`/`sm_field` (3D arrays) are supplied, the west/east TRT\ncollisions use per-cell relaxation rates — required for SLBM on\nstretched meshes where τ varies per cell. Transverse halfway-BB faces\nare pure population swaps and do not depend on τ.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    apply_bc_rebuild_3d!(f_out, f_in, bcspec, ν, Nx, Ny, Nz;\n                          sp_field=nothing, sm_field=nothing,\n                          apply_transverse=false)\n\n3D analog of `apply_bc_rebuild_2d!`. Dispatches per-face on the BC type\nin `bcspec::BCSpec3D` and applies them to `f_out`.\n\n- `west`/`east` : ZouHeVelocity / ZouHePressure (or HalfwayBB no-op)\n- `south`/`north`/`bottom`/`top` : HalfwayBB explicit swaps when\n  `apply_transverse=true`; **default false** for backwards-compat with\n  `fused_trt_libb_v2_step_3d!`, whose `PullHalfwayBB_3D` brick already\n  performs the transverse halfway-BB swap inside the streaming kernel.\n  SLBM-based callers (`PullSLBM_3D`) clamp at non-periodic edges and\n  must set `apply_transverse=true`.\n\nIf `sp_field`/`sm_field` (3D arrays) are supplied, the west/east TRT\ncollisions use per-cell relaxation rates — required for SLBM on\nstretched meshes where τ varies per cell. Transverse halfway-BB faces\nare pure population swaps and do not depend on τ.\n\"\"\"\nfunction apply_bc_rebuild_3d!(f_out, f_in, bcspec::BCSpec3D, ν::Real,\n                                Nx::Int, Ny::Int, Nz::Int;\n                                sp_field=nothing, sm_field=nothing,\n                                apply_transverse::Bool=false)\n    backend = KernelAbstractions.get_backend(f_out)\n    T = eltype(f_out)\n    s_p_r, s_m_r = trt_rates(ν; Λ=3/16)\n    s_p = T(s_p_r); s_m = T(s_m_r)\n    if isnothing(sp_field)\n        _apply_bc_3d_west!(backend, f_out, f_in, bcspec.west, s_p, s_m, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n        _apply_bc_3d_east!(backend, f_out, f_in, bcspec.east, s_p, s_m, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n    else\n        _apply_bc_3d_west_local!(backend, f_out, f_in, bcspec.west,\n                                  sp_field, sm_field, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n        _apply_bc_3d_east_local!(backend, f_out, f_in, bcspec.east,\n                                  sp_field, sm_field, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n    end\n    if apply_transverse\n        _apply_bc_3d_south!(backend, f_out, f_in,  bcspec.south,  s_p, s_m, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n        _apply_bc_3d_north!(backend, f_out, f_in,  bcspec.north,  s_p, s_m, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n        _apply_bc_3d_bottom!(backend, f_out, f_in, bcspec.bottom, s_p, s_m, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n        _apply_bc_3d_top!(backend, f_out, f_in,    bcspec.top,    s_p, s_m, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n    end\n    return nothing\nend\n```"), (name = :apply_fixed_temp_south_2d!, signature = "function apply_fixed_temp_south_2d!(g, T_wall, Nx)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    apply_fixed_temp_south_2d!(g, T_wall, Nx)\n\nPublic function in the kernel-level LBM operation.\nSee the method definition below for argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations. The bang suffix indicates that one or more array arguments are updated in-place.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.apply_zou_he_west_cell_F_2d!)\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction apply_zou_he_west_cell_F_2d!(Fcell::AbstractVector{T}, u_in, volume) where T\n    _check_d2q9_vector(Fcell, \"Fcell\")\n    u = T(u_in)\n    vol = T(volume)\n    f1 = Fcell[1] / vol\n    f3 = Fcell[3] / vol\n    f4 = Fcell[4] / vol\n    f5 = Fcell[5] / vol\n    f7 = Fcell[7] / vol\n    f8 = Fcell[8] / vol\n    rho_wall = (f1 + f3 + f5 + T(2) * (f4 + f7 + f8)) / (one(T) - u)\n    Fcell[2] = vol * (f4 + T(2//3) * rho_wall * u)\n    Fcell[6] = vol * (f8 - T(0.5) * (f3 - f5) + T(1//6) * rho_wall * u)\n    Fcell[9] = vol * (f7 + T(0.5) * (f3 - f5) + T(1//6) * rho_wall * u)\n    return Fcell\nend\n```"), (name = :apply_zou_he_pressure_east_cell_F_2d!, signature = "function apply_zou_he_pressure_east_cell_F_2d!(", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    apply_zou_he_pressure_east_cell_F_2d!(\n\nPublic function in the grid-refinement and conservative-tree AMR API.\nSee the method definition below for argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations. The bang suffix indicates that one or more array arguments are updated in-place.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.apply_zou_he_pressure_east_cell_F_2d!)\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction apply_zou_he_pressure_east_cell_F_2d!(\n        Fcell::AbstractVector{T},\n        volume;\n        rho_out=one(T)) where T\n    _check_d2q9_vector(Fcell, \"Fcell\")\n    vol = T(volume)\n    rho = T(rho_out)\n    f1 = Fcell[1] / vol\n    f2 = Fcell[2] / vol\n    f3 = Fcell[3] / vol\n    f5 = Fcell[5] / vol\n    f6 = Fcell[6] / vol\n    f9 = Fcell[9] / vol\n    ux = -one(T) + (f1 + f3 + f5 + T(2) * (f2 + f6 + f9)) / rho\n    Fcell[4] = vol * (f2 - T(2//3) * rho * ux)\n    Fcell[7] = vol * (f9 - T(0.5) * (f3 - f5) - T(1//6) * rho * ux)\n    Fcell[8] = vol * (f6 + T(0.5) * (f3 - f5) - T(1//6) * rho * ux)\n    return Fcell\nend\n```"), (name = :apply_composite_zou_he_west_F_2d!, signature = "function apply_composite_zou_he_west_F_2d!(", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    apply_composite_zou_he_west_F_2d!(\n\nPublic function in the grid-refinement and conservative-tree AMR API.\nSee the method definition below for argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations. The bang suffix indicates that one or more array arguments are updated in-place.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.apply_composite_zou_he_west_F_2d!)\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction apply_composite_zou_he_west_F_2d!(\n        coarse_F::AbstractArray{T,3},\n        patch::ConservativeTreePatch2D{T},\n        u_in,\n        volume_coarse,\n        volume_fine) where T\n    _check_composite_coarse_layout(coarse_F, patch)\n    @inbounds for J in axes(coarse_F, 2)\n        if first(patch.parent_i_range) <= 1 <= last(patch.parent_i_range) &&\n                J in patch.parent_j_range\n            il, jl = _patch_local_parent_index(patch, 1, J)\n            for jf in (2 * jl - 1):(2 * jl)\n                apply_zou_he_west_cell_F_2d!(\n                    @view(patch.fine_F[2 * il - 1, jf, :]), u_in, volume_fine)\n            end\n        else\n            apply_zou_he_west_cell_F_2d!(\n                @view(coarse_F[1, J, :]), u_in, volume_coarse)\n        end\n    end\n    coalesce_patch_to_shadow_F_2d!(patch)\n    return coarse_F, patch\nend\n```"), (name = :apply_composite_zou_he_pressure_east_F_2d!, signature = "function apply_composite_zou_he_pressure_east_F_2d!(", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    apply_composite_zou_he_pressure_east_F_2d!(\n\nPublic function in the grid-refinement and conservative-tree AMR API.\nSee the method definition below for argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations. The bang suffix indicates that one or more array arguments are updated in-place.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.apply_composite_zou_he_pressure_east_F_2d!)\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction apply_composite_zou_he_pressure_east_F_2d!(\n        coarse_F::AbstractArray{T,3},\n        patch::ConservativeTreePatch2D{T},\n        volume_coarse,\n        volume_fine;\n        rho_out=one(T)) where T\n    _check_composite_coarse_layout(coarse_F, patch)\n    I = last(axes(coarse_F, 1))\n    @inbounds for J in axes(coarse_F, 2)\n        if first(patch.parent_i_range) <= I <= last(patch.parent_i_range) &&\n                J in patch.parent_j_range\n            il, jl = _patch_local_parent_index(patch, I, J)\n            for jf in (2 * jl - 1):(2 * jl)\n                apply_zou_he_pressure_east_cell_F_2d!(\n                    @view(patch.fine_F[2 * il, jf, :]), volume_fine;\n                    rho_out=rho_out)\n            end\n        else\n            apply_zou_he_pressure_east_cell_F_2d!(\n                @view(coarse_F[I, J, :]), volume_coarse; rho_out=rho_out)\n        end\n    end\n    coalesce_patch_to_shadow_F_2d!(patch)\n    return coarse_F, patch\nend\n```"), (name = :apply_zou_he_north_spatial_2d!, signature = "function apply_zou_he_north_spatial_2d!(f, ux_arr, uy_arr, Nx, Ny)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    apply_zou_he_north_spatial_2d!(f, ux_arr, uy_arr, Nx, Ny)\n\nZou-He velocity BC on north wall with per-node velocity arrays.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    apply_zou_he_north_spatial_2d!(f, ux_arr, uy_arr, Nx, Ny)\n\nZou-He velocity BC on north wall with per-node velocity arrays.\n\"\"\"\nfunction apply_zou_he_north_spatial_2d!(f, ux_arr, uy_arr, Nx, Ny)\n    backend = KernelAbstractions.get_backend(f)\n    kernel! return _fit_lbfgs(problem, LBM(), data, p0, pspace;\n                          observables=observables,\n                          weights=weights,\n                          max_iter=max_iter,\n
