Collocated cell-centred grid `nx x ny`.\n\nReturns a NamedTuple with fields:\n  `u, v, p`            converged cell-centred fields (nx x ny)\n  `residual_history`   normalised continuity residual per outer iteration\n  `iters`              number of outer iterations performed\n  `converged`          whether `tol` was reached\n  `dx, dy, ycenters`   grid metrics for analytic comparison\n\nStructure: per outer iteration, a DIRECT momentum solve with frozen pressure\n(the assembled SPD viscous `-Laplacian`, factorized ONCE through the\n[`lin_factorize`](@ref)/[`lin_solve!`](@ref) seam), then Rhie-Chow face\nvelocities, then the pinned pressure-correction Poisson solve (same seam,\n`pin_k0=1`) and the compact-gradient velocity/pressure corrections. Convergence\nrequires BOTH the continuity residual AND the velocity settle below `tol`.\n`momentum_advection` is accepted for API parity with manifold/cavity steady\nsolvers; this fully-developed Poiseuille rung has no nonlinear convection term.\n\nValidated against the analytic Poiseuille parabola at 0.033% L2 error\n(`test/analytical/incns_poiseuille.jl`). The MG/GPU sibling exercising the full\npressure-velocity coupling is [`solve_incns_cavity_mg`](@ref). Registered in\n`src/Kraken.jl` and exported; also reachable as `solve(params, IncNS(:simple))`.\n\"\"\"\nfunction solve_incns_simple(; nx::Integer, ny::Integer, H::Real, mu::Real, G::Real,\n                            relax=(u = 0.7, p = 0.3),\n                            scheme::Symbol = :simplec,\n                            momentum_advection::Symbol = :linear_upwind,\n                            tol::Real = 1e-10, maxiter::Integer = 200,\n                            Lx::Real = H, backend = CPU())\n    nx = Int(nx); ny = Int(ny)\n    H = Float64(H); mu = Float64(mu); G = Float64(G); Lx = Float64(Lx)\n    αu = Float64(relax.u); αp = Float64(relax.p)\n    scheme_sym = _incns_simple_scheme(scheme)\n    momentum_scheme = _incns_momentum_advection_scheme(momentum_advection)\n    dx = Lx / nx\n    dy = H / ny\n    ycenters = [(j - 0.5) * dy for j in 1:ny]\n\n    # ----- operator backends / geometry (regular, no cut cells) -----\n    is_solid = falses(nx, ny)\n    bc = (FVFD_BC_PERIODIC, FVFD_BC_PERIODIC, FVFD_BC_WALL, FVFD_BC_WALL)  # W,E,S,N\n\n    # ----- momentum operator: SPD (-Laplacian), periodic-x / Dirichlet-y -----\n    # Amom u = (G - dp/dx). The momentum operator here is the full viscous\n    # Laplacian, which a direct (CHOLMOD) solve inverts EXACTLY in one shot for\n    # a frozen pressure. We therefore do NOT iterate the momentum equation with\n    # point-relaxation (that converges at Jacobi rate, O(N^2) sweeps). Instead\n    # we solve it directly each outer iteration; au only damps the pressure-\n    # coupling correction below. For the cavity (next mission) the advection\n    # term makes Amom non-symmetric and outer iterations matter; the same\n    # direct-solve-then-correct structure carries over.\n    Lmom = _incns_assemble_neg_laplacian(nx, ny, dx, dy; bc_x = :periodic, bc_y = :dirichlet0)\n    Amom = mu .* Lmom\n    ap = Vector(diag(Amom))                      # a_p (operator diagonal), length n\n    mom_op = _incns_factorise(Amom)\n\n    # Legacy Rhie-Chow coefficient. Keep this fixed across schemes so SIMPLEC\n    # changes only the pressure-correction path, not the converged face model.\n    ap_mat = reshape(ap, nx, ny)\n    d_rc_u = αu ./ ap_mat\n    d_rc_v = αu ./ ap_mat\n\n    # SIMPLE d-coefficient d = au / a_p (legacy velocity response to a pressure\n    # gradient). SIMPLEC subtracts sum(a_nb) from the inverse of that existing\n    # response coefficient; this preserves the extra under-relaxation already\n    # encoded by the legacy d path.\n    if scheme_sym === :simple\n        d_u = d_rc_u\n        d_v = d_rc_v\n    else\n        anb = reshape(_incns_positive_neighbour_sum(Amom), nx, ny)\n        denom = 1.0 ./ d_rc_u .- anb\n        minimum(denom) > 0.0 ||\n            throw(ArgumentError(\"SIMPLEC correction denominator must be positive; use relax.u < 1\"))\n        d_u = 1.0 ./ denom\n        d_v = 1.0 ./ denom\n    end\n\n    # ----- pressure-correction operator: d * (-Laplacian), periodic-x / Neumann-y -----\n    # Continuity:  div(u* + d*grad(p')) = 0  ->  d*(-Lap) p' = div(u*).\n    # d is uniform on this regular grid, so scale the (-Lap) by the scalar d.\n    Lp = _incns_assemble_neg_laplacian(nx, ny, dx, dy; bc_x = :periodic, bc_y = :neumann)\n    dscalar = sum(d_u) / length(d_u)\n    Ap = dscalar .* Lp\n    p_op = _incns_factorise(Ap; pin_k0 = 1)      # singular: pin reference dof\n\n    # ----- fields -----\n    u = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    v = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    p = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    gpx = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    gpy = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    uf = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    vf = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    divstar = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    pcorr = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    gpcx = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    gpcy = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n\n    residual_history = Float64[]\n    converged = false\n    iters = 0\n    vel_change = Inf\n\n    for it in 1:maxiter\n        iters = it\n\n        # ---- 1. pressure gradient of current p (compact, transpose-consistent) ----\n        # gpx,gpy hold +dp/dx,+dp/dy here; the momentum source is (G - dp/dx).\n        _incns_compact_gradient!(gpx, gpy, p, dx, dy, nx, ny)\n\n        # ---- 2. momentum predictor (direct solve, frozen pressure) ----\n        # Amom u* = (G - dp/dx) ;  Amom v* = (-dp/dy).\n        bu = vec(G .- gpx)\n        bv = vec(.-gpy)\n        ustar = reshape(_incns_solve!(mom_op, Amom, bu), nx, ny)\n        vstar = reshape(_incns_solve!(mom_op, Amom, bv), nx, ny)\n\n        # commit the predictor as the current velocity.\n        umax_prev = max(maximum(abs, u), eps())\n        du = 0.0\n        @inbounds for idx in eachindex(u)\n            du = max(du, abs(ustar[idx] - u[idx]), abs(vstar[idx] - v[idx]))\n            u[idx] = ustar[idx]\n            v[idx] = vstar[idx]\n        end\n        vel_change = du / umax_prev\n\n        # ---- 3. Rhie-Chow face velocities ----\n        _incns_rhie_chow_faces!(uf, vf, u, v, p, gpx, gpy, d_rc_u, d_rc_v,\n                                dx, dy, nx, ny)\n\n        # ---- 4. continuity residual = div(u*) ----\n        _incns_face_divergence!(divstar, uf, vf, dx, dy, nx, ny)\n\n        # normalised continuity residual (L2 of div, scaled by a reference flux)\n        ref = max(sum(abs, uf) / max(length(uf), 1) / dx, eps())\n        res = sqrt(sum(abs2, divstar) / length(divstar)) / ref\n        push!(residual_history, res)\n\n        # Converge when BOTH continuity is satisfied AND the velocity field has\n        # settled between outer iterations (vel_change -> 0). Continuity alone\n        # is insufficient: any divergence-free u(y), including an under-scaled\n        # one, satisfies it, so the momentum magnitude would be unconstrained.\n        if res < tol && vel_change < tol\n            converged = true\n            break\n        end\n\n        # ---- 5. pressure-correction Poisson: A p' = div(u*) ----\n        # Gate on a divergence floor: when div* is at machine-noise level the\n        # field is already solenoidal and inverting it only injects a spurious\n        # pressure mode (collocated SIMPLE is sensitive to this). Skip the\n        # correction in that regime; for this case p' ~ 0 and is effectively a\n        # no-op. The full path is exercised when div* is genuinely non-zero\n        # (e.g. the lid-driven cavity, next mission).\n        div_floor = 1e-10 * ref\n        if sqrt(sum(abs2, divstar) / length(divstar)) > div_floor\n            bp = vec(divstar)\n            pcorr .= reshape(_incns_solve!(p_op, Ap, bp), nx, ny)\n\n            # ---- 6. correct pressure ----\n            @. p = p + αp * pcorr\n\n            # ---- 7. correct cell velocities with grad(p') (compact) ----\n            _incns_compact_gradient!(gpcx, gpcy, pcorr, dx, dy, nx, ny)\n            # gpcx = +dp'/dx ; velocity correction u' = -d * dp'/dx = -d*gpcx\n            @. u = u - αp * d_u * gpcx\n            @. v = v - αp * d_v * gpcy\n        end\n    end\n\n    return (; u, v, p, residual_history, iters, converged, vel_change,\n            dx, dy, ycenters, H, mu, G, Lx, nx, ny, scheme=scheme_sym,\n            momentum_advection=momentum_scheme)\nend\n```"), (name = :solve_incns_cavity, signature = "function solve_incns_cavity(; nx::Integer=128, ny::Integer=128,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    solve_incns_cavity(; nx=128, ny=128, U_lid=1.0, Re=100.0,\n                       relax=(u=0.7, p=0.3), tol=1e-7, maxiter=2000,\n                       L=1.0, backend=CPU())\n\nSteady SIMPLE incompressible solver for the 2D lid-driven cavity on `[0,L]^2`.\n\nTop wall moves at `u = U_lid, v = 0`; other walls no-slip. `Re = U_lid*L/nu`,\n`rho = 1` so `mu = nu = U_lid*L/Re`. Collocated cell-centred grid `nx x ny`.\n\nMomentum: implicit symmetric viscous (-Laplacian) (CHOLMOD, factor-once) with\ndeferred-correction upwind advection moved to the RHS, momentum under-relaxation\n`relax.u`. Pressure-velocity coupling: Rhie-Chow face velocities; the all-Neumann\npressure-correction Poisson is pinned at dof 1; pressure under-relaxation\n`relax.p`. Converges when BOTH the continuity residual and the velocity-settle\nfall below `tol`.\n\nReturns a NamedTuple with `u, v, p` (nx x ny), `residual_history`, `iters`,\n`converged`, plus grid metrics (`dx, dy, xcenters, ycenters`) and `nx, ny,\nU_lid, Re, mu, L, checkerboard`.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    solve_incns_cavity(; nx=128, ny=128, U_lid=1.0, Re=100.0,\n                       relax=(u=0.7, p=0.3), tol=1e-7, maxiter=2000,\n                       L=1.0, backend=CPU())\n\nSteady SIMPLE incompressible solver for the 2D lid-driven cavity on `[0,L]^2`.\n\nTop wall moves at `u = U_lid, v = 0`; other walls no-slip. `Re = U_lid*L/nu`,\n`rho = 1` so `mu = nu = U_lid*L/Re`. Collocated cell-centred grid `nx x ny`.\n\nMomentum: implicit symmetric viscous (-Laplacian) (CHOLMOD, factor-once) with\ndeferred-correction upwind advection moved to the RHS, momentum under-relaxation\n`relax.u`. Pressure-velocity coupling: Rhie-Chow face velocities; the all-Neumann\npressure-correction Poisson is pinned at dof 1; pressure under-relaxation\n`relax.p`. Converges when BOTH the continuity residual and the velocity-settle\nfall below `tol`.\n\nReturns a NamedTuple with `u, v, p` (nx x ny), `residual_history`, `iters`,\n`converged`, plus grid metrics (`dx, dy, xcenters, ycenters`) and `nx, ny,\nU_lid, Re, mu, L, checkerboard`.\n\"\"\"\nfunction solve_incns_cavity(; nx::Integer=128, ny::Integer=128,\n                            U_lid::Real=1.0, Re::Real=100.0,\n                            relax=(u=0.7, p=0.3),\n                            tol::Real=1e-7, maxiter::Integer=2000,\n                            L::Real=1.0, backend=CPU(),\n                            verbose::Bool=false)\n    nx = Int(nx); ny = Int(ny)\n    U_lid = Float64(U_lid); Re = Float64(Re); L = Float64(L)\n    αu = Float64(relax.u); αp = Float64(relax.p)\n    mu = U_lid * L / Re            # rho = 1\n    dx = L / nx\n    dy = L / ny\n    xcenters = [(i - 0.5) * dx for i in 1:nx]\n    ycenters = [(j - 0.5) * dy for j in 1:ny]\n\n    # ----- viscous (-Laplacian), Dirichlet on all four walls -----\n    Lmom = _cavity_assemble_neg_laplacian(nx, ny, dx, dy;\n                                          bc_w=:dirichlet, bc_e=:dirichlet,\n                                          bc_s=:dirichlet, bc_n=:dirichlet)\n    Amom_visc = mu .* Lmom                       # SPD viscous operator\n    ap_visc = Vector(diag(Amom_visc))            # viscous diagonal, length n\n\n    # Momentum under-relaxation built into the diagonal: solve\n    #   (Amom_visc + (1/αu - 1) * Diag(ap_visc)) u* =\n    #        b_visc - conv - grad p + (1/αu - 1) * Diag(ap_visc) * u_old\n    # i.e. A_relaxed = Amom_visc + (1/αu - 1)*Diag(ap_visc). The added diagonal\n    # keeps the operator SPD and dominant, so CHOLMOD stays valid.\n    extra = (1.0 / αu - 1.0)\n    Drelax = spdiagm(0 => extra .* ap_visc)\n    Amom = Amom_visc + Drelax\n    ap_relax = Vector(diag(Amom))                # relaxed diagonal a_p\n    ap_visc_mat = reshape(ap_visc, nx, ny)       # matrix form for RHS broadcast\n    mom_op = _cavity_factorise(Amom)\n\n    # SIMPLE d-coefficient: d = αu / a_p (response of velocity to pressure grad).\n    # Using the relaxed a_p (standard SIMPLE under-relaxed d).\n    ap_mat = reshape(ap_relax, nx, ny)\n    d_u = αu ./ ap_mat\n    d_v = αu ./ ap_mat\n\n    # ----- pressure-correction operator: d * (-Laplacian), all-Neumann -----\n    Lp = _cavity_assemble_neg_laplacian(nx, ny, dx, dy;\n                                        bc_w=:neumann, bc_e=:neumann,\n                                        bc_s=:neumann, bc_n=:neumann)\n    dscalar = sum(d_u) / length(d_u)\n    Ap = dscalar .* Lp\n    p_op = _cavity_factorise(Ap; pin_k0=1)       # singular -> pin reference dof\n\n    # ----- Dirichlet velocity wall-value sources for momentum -----\n    # u: walls W/E/S = 0, N (lid) = U_lid.\n    src_u = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    _cavity_dirichlet_rhs!(src_u, nx, ny, dx, dy;\n                           bc_w=:dirichlet, bc_e=:dirichlet,\n                           bc_s=:dirichlet, bc_n=:dirichlet,\n                           uw_w=0.0, uw_e=0.0, uw_s=0.0, uw_n=U_lid)\n    src_u .*= mu\n    # v: all walls 0.\n    src_v = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)               # all-zero (no-slip v walls)\n\n    # ----- fields -----\n    u = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    v = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    p = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    gpx = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    gpy = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    uf = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    vf = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    conv_u = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    conv_v = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    divstar = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    pcorr = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n\n    residual_history = Float64[]\n    converged = false\n    iters = 0\n    vel_change = Inf\n\n    # reference flux scale for residual normalisation (lid-driven)\n    ref_flux = U_lid\n\n    for it in 1:maxiter\n        iters = it\n\n        # ---- 1. current pressure gradient (cell, for the momentum source and\n        #         for the Rhie-Chow cell-gradient term) ----\n        _cavity_compact_gradient!(gpx, gpy, p, dx, dy, nx, ny)\n\n        # ---- 2. Rhie-Chow face velocities from current u,v,p ----\n        _cavity_rhie_chow_faces!(uf, vf, u, v, p, gpx, gpy, d_u, d_v,\n                                 dx, dy, nx, ny)\n\n        # ---- 3. deferred-correction convection on current field ----\n        _cavity_convection!(conv_u, conv_v, u, v, uf, vf, dx, dy, nx, ny, U_lid)\n\n        # ---- 4. momentum predictor (implicit viscous, deferred advection) ----\n        # A_relaxed u* = b_visc - conv - grad p + relax_old_term.\n        # relax_old_term = (1/αu - 1)*ap_visc .* u_old.\n        bu = vec(src_u .- conv_u .- gpx .+ (extra .* ap_visc_mat) .* u)\n        bv = vec(src_v .- conv_v .- gpy .+ (extra .* ap_visc_mat) .* v)\n        ustar = reshape(_cavity_solve!(mom_op, Amom, bu), nx, ny)\n        vstar = reshape(_cavity_solve!(mom_op, Amom, bv), nx, ny)\n\n        umax_prev = max(maximum(abs, u), maximum(abs, v), U_lid * eps())\n        du = 0.0\n        @inbounds for idx in eachindex(u)\n            du = max(du, abs(ustar[idx] - u[idx]), abs(vstar[idx] - v[idx]))\n            u[idx] = ustar[idx]\n            v[idx] = vstar[idx]\n        end\n        vel_change = du / umax_prev\n\n        # ---- 5. Rhie-Chow faces from the predictor (continuity RHS) ----\n        # uf*, vf* = ubar - d^f (face grad p - avg cell grad p). The cell-grad\n        # term decouples the checkerboard mode; it stays attached to the CURRENT\n        # pressure p. The pressure-correction below uses the PURE face gradient,\n        # so its face divergence is exactly Ap = dscalar*Lp (5-point), making the\n        # face projection consistent and idempotent.\n        _cavity_compact_gradient!(gpx, gpy, p, dx, dy, nx, ny)\n        _cavity_rhie_chow_faces!(uf, vf, u, v, p, gpx, gpy, d_u, d_v,\n                                 dx, dy, nx, ny)\n\n        # ---- 6. continuity residual = div(u*_face) ----\n        _cavity_face_divergence!(divstar, uf, vf, dx, dy, nx, ny)\n        res = sqrt(sum(abs2, divstar) / length(divstar)) * dx / max(ref_flux, eps())\n        push!(residual_history, res)\n\n        if verbose && (it <= 5 || it % 100 == 0)\n            @info \"cavity SIMPLE\" it res vel_change\n        end\n\n        if res < tol && vel_change < tol\n            converged = true\n            break\n        end\n\n        # ---- 7. pressure-correction Poisson: Ap p' = div(u*_face) ----\n        bp = vec(divstar)\n        pcorr .= reshape(_cavity_solve!(p_op, Ap, bp), nx, ny)\n        pcorr .-= sum(pcorr) / length(pcorr)   # Neumann gauge\n\n        # ---- 8. correct the FACE velocities directly (exact projection) ----\n        # The assembled Ap = dscalar*(-Lap) solves Ap*pcorr = div(u*), so pcorr is\n        # MINUS the physical pressure correction p'_phys = -pcorr. The physical\n        # face/cell velocity correction u' = -d*grad(p'_phys) = +d*grad(pcorr),\n        # and the pressure update is p += αp*p'_phys = p - αp*pcorr. With the +\n        # sign the face divergence is annihilated in one shot (verified).\n        _cavity_correct_faces!(uf, vf, pcorr, d_u, d_v, dx, dy, nx, ny)\n\n        # ---- 9. correct CELL velocities with the cell pressure-corr gradient ----\n        _cavity_compact_gradient!(gpx, gpy, pcorr, dx, dy, nx, ny)\n        @. u = u + d_u * gpx\n        @. v = v + d_v * gpy\n\n        # ---- 10. correct pressure (under-relaxed) ----\n        @. p = p - αp * pcorr\n    end\n\n    checkerboard = _cavity_checkerboard_metric(p, nx, ny)\n\n    return (; u, v, p, residual_history, iters, converged, vel_change,\n            dx, dy, xcenters, ycenters, nx, ny, U_lid, Re, mu, L, checkerboard)\nend\n```"), (name = :solve_incns_cavity_mg, signature = "function solve_incns_cavity_mg(; nx::Integer=128, ny::Integer=128,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    solve_incns_cavity_mg(; nx=128, ny=128, U_lid=1.0, Re=100.0,\n                          relax=(u=0.7, p=0.3), tol=1e-7, vel_tol=1e-6,\n                          maxiter=8000, L=1.0, backend_ka=CPU(),\n                          atype=Array{Float64}, mg_tol=1e-3, mg_maxcycles=20,\n                          mom_mg_tol=1e-3, mom_mg_maxcycles=20,\n                          norm_stride=25, mg_cycles=3, mom_mg_cycles=1,\n                          verbose=false)\n\nBackend-parametric steady SIMPLE incompressible solver for the 2D lid-driven\ncavity on `[0,L]^2` (square grid, `nx == ny`). Top wall moves at `u=U_lid, v=0`;\nthe other three walls are no-slip. `Re = U_lid*L/nu`, `rho=1` so `mu=nu`.\n\nBoth the viscous/momentum predictor AND the pressure-correction Poisson are\nsolved with the matrix-free multigrid `solve_poisson_mg`: the momentum solve uses\na Helmholtz shift `σ` (under-relaxation/pseudo-transient) and the lid Dirichlet\nvalue folded into the RHS (ghost-0 convention); the pressure solve is all-Neumann\n(`bc=:neumann`, σ=0). Every field is allocated via `atype` and every elementwise\nop is a KA `@kernel` launched on `backend_ka`, so passing `backend_ka=CUDABackend()`\nand `atype=CuArray{Float64}` runs the identical source on the GPU.\n\nLatency/orchestration keywords (see file header):\n  `norm_stride`  compute the outer convergence norms (continuity residual +\n                 velocity settle) only every `norm_stride` iterations (plus\n                 iteration 1 and `maxiter`). The norms only gate the STOP\n                 decision, so the iterates are unchanged; the solver stops at\n                 the first CHECKED iteration satisfying the criterion, i.e. up\n                 to `norm_stride-1` iterations later (slightly more converged)\n                 than `norm_stride=1`. `residual_history` holds one entry per\n                 CHECK. Default 25. `norm_stride=1` = check every iteration.\n  `mg_cycles`    when > 0, run every inner MG solve with a FIXED number of\n                 V-cycles and no residual checks / zero-mean projections (zero\n                 inner host syncs; static launch sequence): the PRESSURE solve\n                 runs `mg_cycles` V-cycles (default 3 — matches the legacy\n                 1e-3 inner tolerance from a zero start) and each MOMENTUM\n                 solve runs `mom_mg_cycles` V-cycles (default 1 — the warm-\n                 started, strongly σ-dominant momentum solve needs ~1 cycle at\n                 the legacy tolerance). `mg_tol`, `mg_maxcycles`, `mom_mg_tol`,\n                 `mom_mg_maxcycles` are then ignored. `mg_cycles=0` = legacy\n                 tolerance-driven inner solves (validated against Ghia Re=100).\n  `mom_mg_cycles` fixed V-cycles per momentum solve when `mg_cycles > 0`\n                 (ignored when `mg_cycles=0`). Default 1.\n\nGPU-efficiency opt-ins (ALL default OFF — defaults are bit-identical to the\nprevious revision):\n  `mg_mixed_precision`     run the inner PRESSURE MG solves in mixed precision\n                 (F64 defect correction wrapping F32 V-cycles; see\n                 `solve_poisson_mg`'s `mixed_precision`). The outer SIMPLE\n                 iterate stays Float64.\n  `mom_mg_mixed_precision` same for the MOMENTUM MG solves. Exposed separately\n                 from the pressure flag because the two operators differ\n                 (σ-shifted Dirichlet vs singular Neumann) and may tolerate\n                 F32 differently.\n  `static_gauge` replace the library `sum!` in the fixed-cycles zero-mean gauge\n                 with a fixed two-kernel reduction (allocation-free, static\n                 launch count — required for CUDA-graph capture; last-ulp\n                 summation-order difference only). Ignored when `mg_cycles=0`.\n  `offstride_executor` injectable `f(S)` executing one full off-stride outer\n                 iteration (default `_cavity_mg_offstride_step!`). Seam for the\n                 CUDA-graph wrapper in cavity_mg_cuda.jl; on-stride (checked)\n                 iterations always run the regular uncaptured path.\n\nReturns a NamedTuple with `u, v, p` (nx x ny host `Array`s for convenience),\n`residual_history`, `iters`, `converged`, grid metrics, and `checkerboard`.\n\nValidation & performance receipts\n  * Ghia, Ghia & Shin (1982) centreline profiles: max deviation 0.689% of\n    `U_lid` at Re=100 (128², gate <=5%) and 2.31% at Re=1000 (512², improving\n    with grid) — `test/analytical/incns_cavity_mg_ghia.jl` (set\n    `INCNS_MG_GHIA_SKIP_RE1000=1` to skip the long Re=1000 case) and\n    `benchmarks/results/cavity_gpu_aqua_a100.md` (issue #7).\n  * GPU↔CPU BIT-EXACT parity (‖Δ‖∞ ~1e-16): the same source run with\n    `backend_ka=CUDABackend(), atype=CuArray{Float64}` reproduces the CPU\n    fields — `benchmarks/krk/inc_ns/cavity_gpu_bench.jl`.\n  * Fast path (`norm_stride=25, mg_cycles=3, mom_mg_cycles=1`, the defaults):\n    converged fields deviate <=4.3e-5 RELATIVE from the stride-1\n    tolerance-driven solve and stop 11 iterations later (i.e. slightly MORE\n    converged) — `test/scratch/incns_cavity_mg_fastpath_driver.jl`.\n  * Mixed precision (`mg_mixed_precision`/`mom_mg_mixed_precision`): converged\n    Ghia Re=100 fields deviate <=8.2e-10 from the all-Float64 path —\n    `test/scratch/incns_cavity_mg_mixed_precision_driver.jl`.\n  * CUDA-graph front-end: `solve_incns_cavity_mg_cuda_graph`\n    (`cavity_mg_cuda.jl`, loaded only under `using CUDA`) replays each\n    off-stride iteration as one graph launch through the `offstride_executor`\n    seam (issue #8).\n\nRegistered in `src/Kraken.jl` and exported (also reachable as\n`solve(params, IncNS(:cavity_mg))`); the file remains standalone-include-able\n(its guard pulls in `src/solve/poisson_mg.jl`).\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    solve_incns_cavity_mg(; nx=128, ny=128, U_lid=1.0, Re=100.0,\n                          relax=(u=0.7, p=0.3), tol=1e-7, vel_tol=1e-6,\n                          maxiter=8000, L=1.0, backend_ka=CPU(),\n                          atype=Array{Float64}, mg_tol=1e-3, mg_maxcycles=20,\n                          mom_mg_tol=1e-3, mom_mg_maxcycles=20,\n                          norm_stride=25, mg_cycles=3, mom_mg_cycles=1,\n                          verbose=false)\n\nBackend-parametric steady SIMPLE incompressible solver for the 2D lid-driven\ncavity on `[0,L]^2` (square grid, `nx == ny`). the file remains standalone-include-able\n(its guard pulls in `src/solve/poisson_mg.jl`).\n\"\"\"\nfunction solve_incns_cavity_mg(; nx::Integer=128, ny::Integer=128,\n                               U_lid::Real=1.0, Re::Real=100.0,\n                               relax=(u=0.7, p=0.3),\n                               tol::Real=1e-7, vel_tol::Real=1e-6,\n                               maxiter::Integer=8000,\n                               L::Real=1.0,\n                               backend_ka=KernelAbstractions.CPU(),\n                               atype::Type{<:AbstractArray}=Array{Float64},\n                               mg_tol::Real=1e-3, mg_maxcycles::Integer=20,\n                               mom_mg_tol::Real=1e-3, mom_mg_maxcycles::Integer=20,\n                               norm_stride::Integer=25,\n                               mg_cycles::Integer=3,\n                               mom_mg_cycles::Integer=1,\n                               mg_mixed_precision::Bool=false,\n                               mom_mg_mixed_precision::Bool=false,\n                               static_gauge::Bool=false,\n                               offstride_executor=nothing,\n                               verbose::Bool=false)\n    nx == ny || throw(ArgumentError(\"cavity_mg requires a square grid (nx == ny)\"))\n    N = Int(nx)\n    U_lid = Float64(U_lid); Re = Float64(Re); L = Float64(L)\n    αu = Float64(relax.u); αp = Float64(relax.p)\n    nu = U_lid * L / Re                 # rho = 1 -> mu = nu\n    dx = L / N; dy = L / N\n    h = dx\n    invdx = 1.0 / dx; invdy = 1.0 / dy\n    invh2 = 1.0 / (h * h)\n    kab = backend_ka\n    stride = max(Int(norm_stride), 1)\n    nfixed = max(Int(mg_cycles), 0)                       # pressure fixed cycles\n    use_fixed = nfixed > 0\n    nfixed_mom = use_fixed ? max(Int(mom_mg_cycles), 1) : 0  # momentum fixed cycles\n    maxit = Int(maxiter)\n\n    # ----- SIMPLE response coefficient d = αu / a_p (relaxed) -----\n    # Momentum under-relaxation is folded into the operator DIAGONAL via the\n    # Helmholtz shift σ (below), so the effective momentum diagonal is the relaxed\n    # a_p = a_visc/αu with a_visc = ν·4/h². The SIMPLE velocity-pressure response\n    # is then d = αu / a_p = αu² / a_visc — identical to cavity.jl, which\n    # reproduces Ghia's v-profile. Uniform d (collocated regular grid).\n    a_visc = nu * 4.0 * invh2\n    a_p = a_visc / αu\n    dval = αu / a_p                     # = αu² / a_visc\n    # Pressure-correction operator is dscalar*(-∇²); on the unit-square-scaled MG\n    # the d-coefficient is folded into the RHS scaling (see below), so MG solves\n    # the PLAIN Neumann Laplacian and we rescale.\n\n    # ----- momentum under-relaxation as a Helmholtz shift (matches cavity.jl) ----\n    # cavity.jl folds SIMPLE momentum under-relaxation into the operator diagonal:\n    #   A_relaxed = A_visc + (1/αu - 1) Diag(a_visc),  rhs += (1/αu-1) a_visc φ_old.\n    # Dividing by ν gives exactly the MG Helmholtz form (-∇² + σ) with\n    #   σ = (1/αu - 1) · 4/h²   and   rhs += σ φ_old   (interior a_visc/ν = 4/h²).\n    # The predictor IS the under-relaxed velocity, so we copy it straight to u,v\n    # (no second, explicit relaxation). At the fixed point φ=φ_old the σ term\n    # cancels and the converged field satisfies the un-relaxed steady momentum\n    # equation — reproducing Ghia. σ also gives strong diagonal dominance, which\n    # stabilises the deferred-correction advection at high Re and makes the MG\n    # momentum solve converge in very few V-cycles.\n    sigma_mom = (1.0 / αu - 1.0) * 4.0 * invh2\n\n    # MG solves on the unit square (spacing 1/N). The physical operator uses\n    # spacing h=L/N; on a square domain L scales (-∇²) by 1/L², so we pass the\n    # RHS scaled by L² (and σ by L²). With L=1 these are identities.\n    L2 = L * L\n    prhs_scale = L2 / dval\n    invNN = 1.0 / (N * N)\n\n    # ----- backend fields (all via atype) -----\n    mk() = (a = atype(undef, N, N); fill!(a, 0.0); a)\n    u = mk(); v = mk(); p = mk()\n    u_old = mk(); v_old = mk()\n    gpx = mk(); gpy = mk()\n    uf = mk(); vf = mk()\n    divstar = mk(); pcorr = mk()\n    rhs_u = mk(); rhs_v = mk(); rhs_p = mk()\n    d_u = mk(); d_v = mk()\n    delta = mk()\n    osc = mk(); dev2 = mk()\n    gbuf = atype(undef, 1, 1); fill!(gbuf, 0.0)   # device-resident gauge mean\n    # per-cell d = αu² h² / (ν (4 + n_wall)); dnum = αu² h² / ν = dval * 4\n    # (dval = αu²/(ν·4/h²) is the interior value).\n    dnum = αu * αu / (nu * invh2)\n    cav_fill_d_kernel!(kab)(d_u, dnum, N; ndrange=(N, N))\n    cav_fill_d_kernel!(kab)(d_v, dnum, N; ndrange=(N, N))\n\n    # ONE multigrid hierarchy shared by all three inner solves (momentum u,\n    # momentum v, pressure): every level array is fully (re)initialized per\n    # solve, so reuse is value-identical and removes 3 full level-stack\n    # allocations per outer iteration.\n    mg_hier = build_mg_hierarchy(N, atype)\n    # Shared Float32 hierarchy for the mixed-precision inner solves (only\n    # allocated when an MP flag is on; fully reinitialized per solve like\n    # mg_hier, so sharing it across the three solves is value-identical).\n    mg_hier_f32 = (mg_mixed_precision || mom_mg_mixed_precision) ?\n        build_mg_hierarchy(N, _mg_eltype_variant(atype, Float32)) : nothing\n    # 1xN column-sum buffer for the static gauge reduction.\n    csum = atype(undef, 1, N); fill!(csum, 0.0)\n    # Inner-cycle counters [momentum; pressure], host-side (see phase functions).\n    counters = zeros(Int, 2)\n\n    # Shared per-iteration state for the phase functions / injectable executor.\n    # EVERY device buffer the iteration touches lives here and in mg_hier(.f32);\n    # nothing below reallocates them, so the off-stride step is allocation-\n    # stable across iterations (CUDA-graph requirement).\n    S = (; kab, N, atype,\n         u, v, p, gpx, gpy, uf, vf, divstar, pcorr, rhs_u, rhs_v, rhs_p,\n         d_u, d_v, gbuf, csum,\n         invdx, invdy, invnu=1.0 / nu, sigma_mom, sigma_mom_mg=sigma_mom * L2,\n         invh2, U_lid, L2, prhs_scale, invNN, alpha_p=αp,\n         mg_tol, mg_maxcycles=Int(mg_maxcycles),\n         mom_mg_tol, mom_mg_maxcycles=Int(mom_mg_maxcycles),\n         nfixed, nfixed_mom, use_fixed, static_gauge,\n         mg_mixed_precision, mom_mg_mixed_precision,\n         mg_hier, mg_hier_f32, counters)\n    offexec = offstride_executor === nothing ? _cavity_mg_offstride_step! :\n              offstride_executor\n\n    xcenters = [(i - 0.5) * dx for i in 1:N]\n    ycenters = [(j - 0.5) * dy for j in 1:N]\n\n    residual_history = Float64[]\n    converged = false\n    iters = 0\n    vel_change = Inf\n    res = Inf\n    ref_flux = U_lid\n\n    for it in 1:maxit\n        iters = it\n        # Convergence norms only every `stride` iterations (+ first and last):\n        # they gate the STOP decision only, so skipping them does not change the\n        # iterates. With stride=1 this is the legacy every-iteration behavior.\n        do_check = (it == 1) || (it % stride == 0) || (it == maxit)\n\n        if !do_check\n            # OFF-STRIDE iteration: one static device launch sequence (no norms,\n            # no host syncs), via the injectable executor (CUDA-graph seam).\n            offexec(S)\n            continue\n        end\n\n        # ON-STRIDE (checked) iteration: the SAME phase sequence with the norm\n        # computations and the convergence break interleaved, exactly as before.\n\n        # 1+2. fused: cell pressure gradient + Rhie-Chow face velocities,\n        #      then deferred-correction convection + momentum RHS (×L²).\n        _cav_phase1!(S)\n\n        # snapshot old velocity for the settle metric (device-to-device copy,\n        # stream-ordered, no host sync)\n        copyto!(u_old, u); copyto!(v_old, v)\n\n        # momentum predictor: Helmholtz MG solves, warm-started from the current\n        # velocity. The σ-shifted predictor IS the under-relaxed velocity\n        # (relaxation lives in the operator/RHS): copied straight in.\n        _cav_phase2!(S)\n\n        # settle metric (device reductions; host scalar reads = the only syncs)\n        cav_delta_kernel!(kab)(delta, u, u_old, v, v_old, N; ndrange=(N, N))\n        umax_prev = max(_field_absmax(u_old), _field_absmax(v_old), U_lid * eps())\n        vel_change = _field_absmax(delta) / umax_prev\n\n        # 5+6. Rhie-Chow faces from the predictor + continuity residual\n        #      divstar = div(u*_face) AND the scaled pressure RHS.\n        _cav_phase3!(S)\n\n        res = sqrt(sum(abs2, divstar) / (N * N)) * dx / max(ref_flux, eps())\n        push!(residual_history, res)\n        if verbose && (it <= 5 || it % 100 == 0)\n            @info \"cavity_mg SIMPLE\" it res vel_change\n        end\n        # Convergence: continuity residual below `tol` AND the velocity field\n        # essentially steady (settle below `vel_tol`). The velocity-settle\n        # gate is looser because explicit momentum under-relaxation settles\n        # more slowly than the continuity residual drops.\n        if res < tol && vel_change < vel_tol\n            converged = true\n            break\n        end\n\n        # 7-10. pressure-correction Poisson + zero-mean gauge + fused\n        #       face/cell-velocity corrections and pressure update.\n        _cav_phase4!(S)\n    end\n\n    # One final device barrier before host post-processing.\n    KernelAbstractions.synchronize(kab)\n\n    # checkerboard metric via device reductions\n    pbar = sum(p) / (N * N)\n    cav_checker_kernel!(kab)(osc, dev2, p, pbar, N; ndrange=(N, N))\n    checkerboard = sqrt(sum(osc) / max(sum(dev2), eps()))\n\n    # Return host copies for convenience (interpolation/plotting on the host).\n    return (; u=Array(u), v=Array(v), p=Array(p),\n            residual_history, iters, converged, vel_change,\n            dx, dy, xcenters, ycenters, nx=N, ny=N, U_lid, Re, mu=nu, L,\n            checkerboard, sigma_mom,\n            norm_stride=stride, mg_cycles=nfixed, mom_mg_cycles=nfixed_mom,\n            mg_mixed_precision, mom_mg_mixed_precision, static_gauge,\n            mg_cycles_mom_total=counters[1], mg_cycles_p_total=counters[2])\nend\n```"), (name = :solve_incns_projection, signature = "function solve_incns_projection(; nx::Integer, ny::Integer,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    solve_incns_projection(; nx, ny, Lx, Ly, nu, dt, nsteps,\n                           bc_x=:periodic, bc_y=:periodic,\n                           fx=0.0, fy=0.0,\n                           u0=nothing, v0=nothing, p0=nothing,\n                           scheme=:cn, rhie_chow=:increment,\n                           backend=CPU(), callback=nothing)\n\nUnsteady 2D incompressible Navier-Stokes (laminar, Newtonian, rho = 1, constant\n`nu`) on `[0,Lx] x [0,Ly]`, collocated cell-centred `nx x ny` grid, advanced\n`nsteps` steps of size `dt` by an INCREMENTAL pressure-correction projection\n(fractional step): AB2 explicit advection (Euler first step), implicit\nCrank-Nicolson diffusion (`scheme=:cn`, default; `:be` = backward Euler\nfallback), ONE pressure Poisson per step.\n\nPer-axis BCs `bc_x`, `bc_y`: `:periodic` or `:wall` (no-slip `u = v = 0`;\nhomogeneous Neumann for pressure). `fx, fy` are constant body-force components\n(e.g. `fx = G` drives a periodic channel). Initial conditions `u0, v0, p0`:\n`nothing` (zero), a function `(x, y) -> value` sampled at cell centres, or an\n`(nx, ny)` matrix.\n\n`rhie_chow` selects the face-velocity (momentum) interpolation that feeds the\nPoisson RHS: `:increment` (default — incremental interpolation, faces\n`avg(u*)` plus the EXACT face projection of the pressure increment; 2nd order\nin time) or `:full` (classical `d = dt` Rhie-Chow deviation against the full\npressure; strongest checkerboard damping but O(dt*h^2) time-accuracy defect —\nsee the header note). Both keep the face field divergence-free to machine\nprecision.\n\nFACTORIZE-ONCE: the momentum Helmholtz operator `I/dt + nu*theta*(-Lap)` and\nthe pressure `(-Lap)` are constant, assembled and factorized ONCE before the\ntime loop ([`lin_factorize`](@ref), CHOLMOD, the singular pressure operator\npinned at dof 1) and reused for every step ([`lin_solve!`](@ref)):\n`nfactorizations == 2` regardless of `nsteps`, `nlinsolves == 3*nsteps`.\n\n`callback(step, t, u, v, p)` (if given) runs after each completed step with the\nLIVE arrays — copy what you keep.\n\nReturns a NamedTuple:\n  `u, v, p`        cell fields after `nsteps` steps (p in the zero-mean gauge\n                   of its increments, defined up to a constant)\n  `uf, vf`         divergence-free face velocities (east/north faces)\n  `t_final`        `nsteps*dt`\n  `ke_history`     kinetic energy `0.5*sum(u^2+v^2)*dx*dy`, length `nsteps+1`\n                   (entry 1 = initial condition)\n  `max_div_inf`    max over steps of the post-projection face-divergence Linf\n  `div_inf_final`  post-projection face-divergence Linf at the last step\n  `nfactorizations, nlinsolves`  factorize-once receipts\n  plus grid metadata (`dx, dy, xcenters, ycenters, nx, ny, nu, dt, nsteps,\n  scheme`).\n\nValidated against analytic transients: Taylor-Green vortex (spatial/temporal\norder, energy decay) in `test/analytical/incns_unsteady_taylor_green.jl` and\nimpulsively-started plane Poiseuille in\n`test/analytical/incns_unsteady_startup_channel.jl`. Registered in\n`src/Kraken.jl` and exported; also reachable as\n`solve(params, IncNS(:projection))` through the platform contract.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    solve_incns_projection(; nx, ny, Lx, Ly, nu, dt, nsteps,\n                           bc_x=:periodic, bc_y=:periodic,\n                           fx=0.0, fy=0.0,\n                           u0=nothing, v0=nothing, p0=nothing,\n                           scheme=:cn, rhie_chow=:increment,\n                           backend=CPU(), callback=nothing)\n\nUnsteady 2D incompressible Navier-Stokes (laminar, Newtonian, rho = 1, constant\n`nu`) on `[0,Lx] x [0,Ly]`, collocated cell-centred `nx x ny` grid, advanced\n`nsteps` steps of size `dt` by an INCREMENTAL pressure-correction projection\n(fractional step): AB2 explicit advection (Euler first step), implicit\nCrank-Nicolson diffusion (`scheme=:cn`, default; `:be` = backward Euler\nfallback), ONE pressure Poisson per step.\n\nPer-axis BCs `bc_x`, `bc_y`: `:periodic` or `:wall` (no-slip `u = v = 0`;\nhomogeneous Neumann for pressure). `fx, fy` are constant body-force components\n(e.g. `fx = G` drives a periodic channel). Initial conditions `u0, v0, p0`:\n`nothing` (zero), a function `(x, y) -> value` sampled at cell centres, or an\n`(nx, ny)` matrix.\n\n`rhie_chow` selects the face-velocity (momentum) interpolation that feeds the\nPoisson RHS: `:increment` (default — incremental interpolation, faces\n`avg(u*)` plus the EXACT face projection of the pressure increment; 2nd order\nin time) or `:full` (classical `d = dt` Rhie-Chow deviation against the full\npressure; strongest checkerboard damping but O(dt*h^2) time-accuracy defect —\nsee the header note). Both keep the face field divergence-free to machine\nprecision.\n\nFACTORIZE-ONCE: the momentum Helmholtz operator `I/dt + nu*theta*(-Lap)` and\nthe pressure `(-Lap)` are constant, assembled and factorized ONCE before the\ntime loop ([`lin_factorize`](@ref), CHOLMOD, the singular pressure operator\npinned at dof 1) and reused for every step ([`lin_solve!`](@ref)):\n`nfactorizations == 2` regardless of `nsteps`, `nlinsolves == 3*nsteps`.\n\n`callback(step, t, u, v, p)` (if given) runs after each completed step with the\nLIVE arrays — copy what you keep.\n\nReturns a NamedTuple:\n  `u, v, p`        cell fields after `nsteps` steps (p in the zero-mean gauge\n                   of its increments, defined up to a constant)\n  `uf, vf`         divergence-free face velocities (east/north faces)\n  `t_final`        `nsteps*dt`\n  `ke_history`     kinetic energy `0.5*sum(u^2+v^2)*dx*dy`, length `nsteps+1`\n                   (entry 1 = initial condition)\n  `max_div_inf`    max over steps of the post-projection face-divergence Linf\n  `div_inf_final`  post-projection face-divergence Linf at the last step\n  `nfactorizations, nlinsolves`  factorize-once receipts\n  plus grid metadata (`dx, dy, xcenters, ycenters, nx, ny, nu, dt, nsteps,\n  scheme`).\n\nValidated against analytic transients: Taylor-Green vortex (spatial/temporal\norder, energy decay) in `test/analytical/incns_unsteady_taylor_green.jl` and\nimpulsively-started plane Poiseuille in\n`test/analytical/incns_unsteady_startup_channel.jl`. Registered in\n`src/Kraken.jl` and exported; also reachable as\n`solve(params, IncNS(:projection))` through the platform contract.\n\"\"\"\nfunction solve_incns_projection(; nx::Integer, ny::Integer,\n                                Lx::Real, Ly::Real, nu::Real,\n                                dt::Real, nsteps::Integer,\n                                bc_x::Symbol = :periodic,\n                                bc_y::Symbol = :periodic,\n                                fx::Real = 0.0, fy::Real = 0.0,\n                                u0 = nothing, v0 = nothing, p0 = nothing,\n                                scheme::Symbol = :cn,\n                                rhie_chow::Symbol = :increment,\n                                backend = CPU(),\n                                callback = nothing)\n    nx = Int(nx); ny = Int(ny); nsteps = Int(nsteps)\n    Lx = Float64(Lx); Ly = Float64(Ly)\n    nu = Float64(nu); dt = Float64(dt)\n    fx = Float64(fx); fy = Float64(fy)\n    nsteps >= 1 || throw(ArgumentError(\"nsteps must be >= 1\"))\n    dt > 0 || throw(ArgumentError(\"dt must be positive\"))\n    bc_x in (:periodic, :wall) || throw(ArgumentError(\"bc_x must be :periodic or :wall\"))\n    bc_y in (:periodic, :wall) || throw(ArgumentError(\"bc_y must be :periodic or :wall\"))\n    scheme in (:cn, :be) || throw(ArgumentError(\"scheme must be :cn or :be\"))\n    rhie_chow in (:increment, :full) ||\n        throw(ArgumentError(\"rhie_chow must be :increment or :full\"))\n\n    theta = scheme === :cn ? 0.5 : 1.0\n    rc_dcoef = rhie_chow === :full ? Float64(dt) : 0.0\n    perx = bc_x === :periodic\n    pery = bc_y === :periodic\n\n    dx = Lx / nx\n    dy = Ly / ny\n    xcenters = [(i - 0.5) * dx for i in 1:nx]\n    ycenters = [(j - 0.5) * dy for j in 1:ny]\n    n = nx * ny\n\n    # ----- constant operators: assemble + factorize ONCE (before the loop) ----\n    # Momentum Helmholtz: I/dt + nu*theta*(-Lap), velocity walls = :dirichlet0.\n    Lmom = _proj_assemble_neg_laplacian(nx, ny, dx, dy;\n                                        bc_x = perx ? :periodic : :dirichlet0,\n                                        bc_y = pery ? :periodic : :dirichlet0)\n    Amom = spdiagm(0 => fill(1.0 / dt, n)) + (nu * theta) .* Lmom\n    mom_cache = lin_factorize(Amom; backend = CPUBackendTag(), spd = true)\n\n    # Pressure: (-Lap), pressure walls = :neumann. Singular for every BC combo\n    # here (constant nullspace) -> pin reference dof 1; the per-step RHS has\n    # zero sum (telescoping face divergence), so pinning is consistent.\n    Ap = _proj_assemble_neg_laplacian(nx, ny, dx, dy;\n                                      bc_x = perx ? :periodic : :neumann,\n                                      bc_y = pery ? :periodic : :neumann)\n    p_cache = lin_factorize(Ap; backend = CPUBackendTag(), spd = true, pin_k0 = 1)\n\n    nfactorizations = 2          # constant: the whole point of the seam\n    nlinsolves = 0\n\n    # ----- fields -----\n    u = _proj_init_field(u0, xcenters, ycenters, nx, ny)\n    v = _proj_init_field(v0, xcenters, ycenters, nx, ny)\n    p = _proj_init_field(p0, xcenters, ycenters, nx, ny)\n    uf = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    vf = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    gpx = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    gpy = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    conv_u = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    conv_v = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    convo_u = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)   # AB2 history (step n-1)\n    convo_v = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    bu = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    bv = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    divf = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    lapu = zeros(Float64, n)           # (-Lap) u^n matvec work (CN explicit half)\n    lapv = zeros(Float64, n)\n    phi = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    gphix = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    gphiy = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n\n    # Initial faces: plain averaging (dcoef = 0). Any O(h^2) divergence of the\n    # averaged initial field is annihilated by the first projection.\n    _proj_faces_from_cells!(uf, vf, u, v, p, gpx, gpy, 0.0,\n                            dx, dy, nx, ny, perx, pery)\n\n    cellvol = dx * dy\n    ke_history = Float64[0.5 * (sum(abs2, u) + sum(abs2, v)) * cellvol]\n    sizehint!(ke_history, nsteps + 1)\n    max_div_inf = 0.0\n    div_inf_final = 0.0\n    nu_expl = nu * (1.0 - theta)       # 0 for :be\n    invdt = 1.0 / dt\n\n    for step in 1:nsteps\n        # ---- 1. advection on the current field (AB2, Euler first step) ----\n        _proj_advect!(conv_u, conv_v, u, v, uf, vf, dx, dy, nx, ny, perx, pery)\n\n        # ---- 2. current pressure gradient (compact cell gradient) ----\n        _proj_compact_gradient!(gpx, gpy, p, dx, dy, nx, ny, perx, pery)\n\n        # ---- 3. momentum predictor RHS ----\n        # bu = u/dt - conv_AB2 - dp/dx + fx - nu*(1-theta)*(-Lap u)  (CN half).\n        if nu_expl != 0.0\n            mul!(lapu, Lmom, vec(u))   # lapu = (-Lap) u^n (walls: ghost -u_c)\n            mul!(lapv, Lmom, vec(v))\n        else\n            fill!(lapu, 0.0); fill!(lapv, 0.0)\n        end\n        lapu_m = reshape(lapu, nx, ny)\n        lapv_m = reshape(lapv, nx, ny)\n        if step == 1\n            @. bu = u * invdt - conv_u - gpx + fx - nu_expl * lapu_m\n            @. bv = v * invdt - conv_v - gpy + fy - nu_expl * lapv_m\n        else\n            @. bu = u * invdt - (1.5 * conv_u - 0.5 * convo_u) - gpx + fx -\n                    nu_expl * lapu_m\n            @. bv = v * invdt - (1.5 * conv_v - 0.5 * convo_v) - gpy + fy -\n                    nu_expl * lapv_m\n        end\n\n        # ---- 4. momentum solves (factorize-once cache, 2 back-subs) ----\n        ustar = reshape(lin_solve!(mom_cache, vec(bu)), nx, ny)\n        vstar = reshape(lin_solve!(mom_cache, vec(bv)), nx, ny)\n        nlinsolves += 2\n\n        # ---- 5. face velocities of the predictor ----\n        # :increment -> plain avg(u*) (rc_dcoef = 0): the compact pressure\n        #   coupling is carried by the face projection of phi below.\n        # :full -> classical Rhie-Chow d = dt deviation against p^n\n        #   (rc_dcoef = dt). See the header trade-off note.\n        _proj_faces_from_cells!(uf, vf, ustar, vstar, p, gpx, gpy, rc_dcoef,\n                                dx, dy, nx, ny, perx, pery)\n\n        # ---- 6. pressure Poisson: (-Lap) phi = -div(uf*)/dt ----\n        # (minus in the RHS => phi IS the physical increment, see header note)\n        _proj_face_divergence!(divf, uf, vf, dx, dy, nx, ny, perx, pery)\n        bphi = vec(divf) .* (-invdt)\n        phi .= reshape(lin_solve!(p_cache, bphi), nx, ny)\n        nlinsolves += 1\n        phi .-= sum(phi) / length(phi)         # zero-mean gauge\n\n        # ---- 7. project faces (exact) and cells (compact gradient) ----\n        _proj_correct_faces!(uf, vf, phi, dt, dx, dy, nx, ny, perx, pery)\n        _proj_compact_gradient!(gphix, gphiy, phi, dx, dy, nx, ny, perx, pery)\n        @. u = ustar - dt * gphix\n        @. v = vstar - dt * gphiy\n\n        # ---- 8. incremental pressure update ----\n        @. p = p + phi\n\n        # ---- 9. diagnostics + AB2 history ----\n        _proj_face_divergence!(divf, uf, vf, dx, dy, nx, ny, perx, pery)\n        div_inf_final = maximum(abs, divf)\n        max_div_inf = max(max_div_inf, div_inf_final)\n        push!(ke_history, 0.5 * (sum(abs2, u) + sum(abs2, v)) * cellvol)\n        copyto!(convo_u, conv_u)\n        copyto!(convo_v, conv_v)\n\n        callback !== nothing && callback(step, step * dt, u, v, p)\n    end\n\n    return (; u, v, p, uf, vf, t_final = nsteps * dt,\n            ke_history, max_div_inf, div_inf_final,\n            nfactorizations, nlinsolves,\n            dx, dy, xcenters, ycenters, nx, ny, nu, dt, nsteps, scheme,\n            rhie_chow)\nend\n```"), (name = :solve_incns_manifold, signature = "function solve_incns_manifold(; nx::Integer, ny::Integer, Lx::Real, Ly::Real,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    solve_incns_manifold(; nx, ny, Lx, Ly, Re, U_in,\n                         is_solid=nothing, inlet, outlet, mu=nothing,\n                         relax=(u=0.7,p=0.3), scheme=:simplec, tol=1e-7,\n                         maxiter=4000, backend=CPU(), verbose=false,\n                         momentum_advection=:linear_upwind)\n\nSteady incompressible Navier-Stokes SIMPLE solver for a 2D manifold on a\ncollocated cell-centred grid. Registered in `src/Kraken.jl` and exported; also\nreachable as `solve(params, IncNS(:manifold))` through the platform contract.\n\n`inlet = (; side, j0, j1, u)` imposes a localized velocity Dirichlet span on the\nwest/east boundary. The inlet face flux is frozen in the pressure-correction\nprojection, so the pressure side is homogeneous Neumann there. `outlet =\n(; side, j0, j1)` imposes the pressure reference: a localized Dirichlet\n`p' = 0` span in the pressure-correction Poisson, with zero-gradient momentum\nat the same velocity faces. Do not add a separate pressure pin.\n\n`is_solid` marks full solid cells. Fluid-solid pressure-correction faces are\nhomogeneous Neumann; fluid-solid momentum faces are no-slip Dirichlet faces.\nThe returned `uf, vf` use the cavity convention: `uf[i,j]` is the east face of\ncell `(i,j)`, `vf[i,j]` is the north face. Those face fields, together with\n`is_solid`, `dx`, `dy`, `nx`, and `ny`, are the handoff contract consumed by\n`solve_scalar_transport`.\n\"\"\"\nfunction solve_incns_manifold(; nx::Integer, verbose::Bool=false, scheme::Symbol=:simplec,\n                              momentum_advection::Symbol=:linear_upwind)\n    nx = Int(nx); ny = Int(ny)\n    Lx = Float64(Lx); Ly = Float64(Ly); Re = Float64(Re); U_in = Float64(U_in)\n    dx = Lx / nx\n    dy = Ly / ny\n    μ = mu === nothing ? abs(U_in) * Ly / Re : Float64(mu)\n    αu = Float64(relax.u); αp = Float64(relax.p)\n    0.0 < αu <= 1.0 || throw(ArgumentError(\"relax.u must lie in (0, 1]\"))\n    0.0 < αp <= 1.0 || throw(ArgumentError(\"relax.p must lie in (0, 1]\"))\n    scheme_sym = _mf_simple_scheme(scheme)\n    momentum_scheme = [(j - 0.5) * dy for j in 1:ny]\n\n    Lmom = _mf_assemble_momentum_laplacian(nx, ny, dx, dy, solid, bc)\n    Amom_visc = μ .* Lmom\n    ap_visc = Vector(diag(Amom_visc))\n    extra = 1.0 / αu - 1.0\n :simple\n        d_u = d_rc_u\n        d_v = d_rc_v\n    else\n        anb = reshape(_mf_positive_neighbour_sum(Amom_visc), nx, ny)\n        denom = 1.0 ./ d_rc_u .- anb\n        fluid_min = minimum(denom[.!solid])\n        fluid_min > 0.0 ||\n            throw(ArgumentError(\"SIMPLEC correction denominator must be positive; use relax.u < 1\"))\n        d_u = 1.0 ./ denom\n        d_v = ny)\n    _mf_momentum_dirichlet_rhs!(src_u, src_v, nx, ny, dx, dy, solid, bc)\n    src_u .*= μ\n\n    u = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    v = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    p = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    if bc.inlet_side === :west && bc.outlet_side === :east\n        dp0 = 12.0 * μ * abs(bc.uin) * Lx / (Ly * Ly)\n        @inbounds for j in 1:ny, i in 1:nx\n            p[i, j] = dp0 * (1.0 - xcenters[i] / Lx)\n        end\n    elseif bc.inlet_side === :east && bc.outlet_side === :west\n        dp0 = 12.0 * μ * abs(bc.uin) * Lx / (Ly * Ly)\n        @inbounds for j in 1:ny, i in 1:nx\n            p[i, j] = dp0 * (xcenters[i] / Lx)\n        end\n    end\n    _mf_zero_solid!((u, v, p), solid)\n\n    gpx = zeros(Float64, nx, ny); gpy = zeros(Float64, nx, ny)\n    uf = zeros(Float64, nx, ny); vf =   ref_flux = max(abs(U_in), abs(bc.uin), eps())\n\n    if momentum_scheme === :linear_upwind\n        _mf_compact_gradient!(gpx, gpy, p, dx, dy, nx, ny, solid, bc)\n        _mf_rhie_chow_faces!(uf, vf, uwest, u, v, p, gpx, gpy, d_rc_u, d_rc_v,\n                             dx, dy, nx, ny, solid, bc)\n    end\n\n    for it in 1:Int(maxiter)\n        iters = it\n        if momentum_scheme === :upwind\n            _mf_compact_gradient!(gpx, gpy, p, dx, dy, nx, ny, solid, bc)\n            _mf_rhie_chow_faces!(uf, vf, uwest, u, v, p, gpx, gpy, d_rc_u, d_rc_v,\n                                 dx, dy, nx, ny, solid, bc)\n            _mf_convection!(conv_u, conv_v, u, v, uf, vf, uwest, dx, dy, nx, ny,\n                            solid, bc, momentum_scheme)\n\n            bu = vec(src_u .- bu), nx, ny)\n            vstar = reshape(_mf_solve!(mom_op, bv), nx, ny)\n        else\n            adv = _mf_assemble_upwind_convection_operator(nx, ny, dx, dy, solid, bc,\n                                                          uf, vf, uwest)\n            uop = _mf_relaxed_momentum_operator(Amom_visc + adv.Cu, αu, nx, ny,\n                                                solid, scheme_sym)\n            vop = _mf_relaxed_momentum_operator(Amom_visc + adv.Cv, αu, nx, ny,\n                                                solid, scheme_sym)\n            d_rc_u = uop.d_rc\n            d_rc_v = vop.d_rc\n            d_u = uop.d\n            d_v = vop.d\n            mom_u_op = _mf_factorise(uop.Amom; spd=false)\n            mom_v_op = _mf_factorise(vop.Amom; spd=false)\n            Ap = source_excerpt = "```julia\nfunction manifold_full_cell_mask(nx::Integer, ny::Integer, Lx::Real, Ly::Real, plates)\n    nx = Int(nx); ny = Int(ny)\n    dx = Float64(Lx) / nx\n    dy = Float64(Ly) / ny\n    mask = falses(nx, ny)\n    for (nplate, plate) in enumerate(plates)\n        x0 = Float64(plate.x0); x1 = Float64(plate.x1)\n        y0 = Float64(plate.y0); y1 = Float64(plate.y1)\n        _mf_assert_gridline(x0, dx, \"plates[\$nplate].x0\")\n        _mf_assert_gridline(x1, dx, \"plates[\$nplate].x1\")\n        _mf_assert_gridline(y0, dy, \"plates[\$nplate].y0\")\n        _mf_assert_gridline(y1, dy, \"plates[\$nplate].y1\")\n        @inbounds for j in 1:ny, i in 1:nx\n            x = (i - 0.5) * dx\n            y = (j - 0.5) * dy\n            mask[i, j] |= (x0 <= x <=                 deferred_passes=4)\n\nStandalone DECOUPLED STEADY scalar advection–diffusion (\"thermal transport\")\nsolver. Given a FROZEN face-normal velocity field, solve\n\n    ∇·(u T) − DT ∇²T = 0\n\nto steady state on a collocated cell-centred grid `nx × ny` with spacing\n`dx, dy`. Given a FROZEN face-normal velocity field, solve\n\n    ∇·(u T) − DT ∇²T = 0\n\nto steady state on a collocated cell-centred grid `nx × ny` with spacing\n`dx, dy`. The assembled matrix is always the legacy first-order upwind\nadvection plus diffusion operator. With `advection=:linear_upwind` (default), a\nsecond-order linear-upwind face flux is applied by deferred correction:\n`A*T(k+1) = b + F_low(T(k)) - F_high(T(k))`. The factorization is reused for\nevery Picard RHS. With `advection=:upwind`, the legacy single-solve path is\npreserved.\n\nArguments:\n  `uf, vf`   FROZEN face-normal velocities. `uf[i,j]` = east face of cell\n             `(i,j)` (x-normal), `vf[i,j]` = north face (y-normal). SAME layout\n             as `inc_ns/simple.jl`.\n  `DT`       scalar diffusivity (thermal diffusivity / conductivity proxy).\n  `is_solid` full-cell solid mask. Solid rows are pinned to `T=0`, and\n             fluid-solid faces are adiabatic/impermeable.\n  `bc`       NamedTuple keyed `west/east/south/north`, each a\n             whole-side `(kind::Symbol, value)` BC or a vector of segments\n             `(lo, hi, kind, value)`. Segment ranges are cell indices along\n             that side: `j` for west/east, `i` for south/north. Uncovered\n             segment cells default to adiabatic `(kind=:flux, value=0)`.\n               `:dirichlet` — imposed inlet/wall value `T = value`.\n               `:flux`      — Neumann wall heat flux `q = value`; enters as a\n                              SOURCE in `b` on the wall-adjacent row (q/h), NOT\n                              in `A`; no advective boundary transport.\n               `:outflow`   — zero-gradient (ghost = interior); advection carries\n                              the interior upwind value.\n  `source`   optional volumetric source field `S[i,j]` (heat generation /\n             manufactured-solution term): the balance becomes\n             `div(uT) − DT·lap(T) = S`. `nothing` (default) means no source.\n  `advection` `:linear_upwind` for deferred second-order advection, or\n             `:upwind` for the legacy first-order single solve.\n  `deferred_passes` maximum Picard correction solves after the initial upwind\n             solve; the factorization is reused.\n  `deferred_tol` relative infinity-norm update tolerance for stopping the\n             deferred correction.\n  `backend`  optional backend tag; `nothing` (default) routes to the CPU seam.\n\nAssembly mirrors `inc_ns/simple.jl` (5-point Laplacian → sparse CSC) and the\ncavity's first-order upwind advection (`_cavity_convection!`), transcribed into\nmatrix coefficients (donor diagonal `+F`, acceptor off-diagonal `−F`). The solve\nuses the shared factorize-once seam with `spd=false` (A is non-symmetric due to\nupwind).\n\nReturns a NamedTuple with fields:\n  `T`                  steady scalar field (`nx × ny`).\n  `residual_history`   single-element `[‖A·T − b‖]` (should be ~machine eps).\n  `iters`              always `1` (single linear solve, no loop).\n  `converged`          whether the residual is at machine-noise level.\n  `dx, dy, ycenters`   grid metrics for analytic comparison.\n  `nx, ny, DT`         echoed inputs.\n  `Pe_cell`            cell Péclet number `max|u|·min(dx,dy)/DT`.\n\"\"\"\nfunction solve_scalar_transport(; nx::Integer, ny::Integer, dx::Real, dy::Real,\n                                uf::AbstractMatrix, vf::AbstractMatrix, DT::Real,\n                                is_solid::AbstractMatrix = falses(Int(nx), Int(ny)),\n                                bc, source = nothing, backend = nothing,\n                                advection::Symbol = :linear_upwind,\n                                deferred_passes::Integer = 4,\n                                deferred_tol::Real = 1e-8)\n    nx = Int(nx); ny = Int(ny)\n    dx = Float64(dx); dy = Float64(dy); DT = Float64(DT)\n    scheme = _st_advection_scheme(advection)\n    max_deferred = Int(deferred_passes)\n    max_deferred >= 0 ||\n        throw(ArgumentError(\"deferred_passes must be non-negative; got \$deferred_passes\"))\n    tol_deferred = Float64(deferred_tol)\n    tol_deferred > 0.0 ||\n        throw(ArgumentError(\"deferred_tol must be positive; got \$deferred_tol\"))\n    ycenters = [(j - 0.5) * dy for j in 1:ny]\n\n    A, b = _st_assemble_system(nx, ny, dx, dy, uf, vf, DT, is_solid;\n                               bc = bc, source = source)\n\n    # A is non-symmetric (first-order upwind advection) -> spd=false routes the\n    # seam to a sparse LU (the CPU spd=false branch gates on `issymmetric(A)`\n    # and factorizes genuinely non-symmetric operators with `lu`). The solve is\n    # a single factorize + solve through the shared factorize-once seam; the\n    # cache would amortize re-solves if T were ever re-solved on a fresh RHS.\n    btag = backend === nothing ? CPUBackendTag() : backend\n    cache = lin_factorize(A; backend = btag, spd = false)\n    Tvec = lin_solve!(cache, b)\n    Tvec = Vector{Float64}(Tvec)\n    T = reshape(Tvec, nx, ny)\n\n    # Residual ‖A·T − b‖ (should be ~machine eps for a direct solve).\n    resid = norm(A * Tvec .- b)\n    residual_history = [resid]\n    linear_converged = resid <= 1e-8 * max(norm(b), 1.0)\n\n    deferred_passes_used = 0\n    deferred_converged = scheme === :upwind\n    deferred_rel_change = 0.0\n\n    if scheme === :linear_upwind && max_deferred > 0\n        solid = Matrix{Bool}(is_solid)\n        corr = zeros(Float64, length(b))\n        rhs = similar(b)\n        _st_advection_deferred_correction!(corr, T, uf, vf, solid, nx, ny, dx, dy)\n        if norm(corr, Inf) == 0.0\n            deferred_converged = true\n        else\n            for _ in 1:max_deferred\n                @. rhs = b + corr\n                next = Vector{Float64}(lin_solve!(cache, rhs))\n                lin_resid = norm(A * next .- rhs)\n                push!(residual_history, lin_resid)\n                denom = max(norm(next, Inf), eps(Float64))\n                deferred_rel_change = norm(next .- Tvec, Inf) / denom\n                deferred_passes_used += 1\n                Tvec = next\n                T = reshape(Tvec, nx, ny)\n                linear_converged = lin_resid <= 1e-8 * max(norm(rhs), 1.0)\n                if deferred_rel_change <= tol_deferred\n                    deferred_converged = true\n                    break\n                end\n                _st_advection_deferred_correction!(corr, T, uf, vf, solid,\n                                                   nx, ny, dx, dy)\n            end\n        end\n    end\n\n    # Cell Péclet number Pe = max|u|·min(dx,dy)/DT.\n    umax = max(maximum(abs, uf), maximum(abs, vf))\n    Pe_cell = umax * min(dx, dy) / DT\n\n    iters = 1 + deferred_passes_used\n    converged = linear_converged\n    return (; T, residual_history, iters, converged, dx, dy, ycenters,\n            nx, ny, DT, Pe_cell, advection = scheme,\n            deferred_passes_used, deferred_converged, deferred_rel_change)\nend\n```"), (name = :lin_factorize, signature = "function lin_factorize(A::SparseMatrixCSC{Float64,Int};", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    lin_factorize(A; backend=CPUBackendTag(), spd=true, pin_k0=0) -> LinearSolveCache\n\nFactorize the constant operator `A` ONCE for `backend` and return a reusable\ncache. `spd=true` selects Cholesky; `spd=false` selects an LU/LDLᵀ fallback.\n`pin_k0>0` pins reference dof `k0` (singular all-Neumann/periodic operator) at\nfactorize time via `pin_reference_dof`; the RHS is then pinned consistently per\nsolve inside [`lin_solve!`](@ref).\n\nThis is one of the TWO functions of the backend-parametric factorize-once seam\n(dispatch keyed on the `LinearSolveBackend` singleton tag):\n\n  * `CPUBackendTag()` (default) — this file; `SparseMatrixCSC{Float64,Int}`,\n    CHOLMOD Cholesky / LDLᵀ / UMFPACK LU. Registered in `src/Kraken.jl` (exported by `using Kraken`).\nReceipts: `test/analytical/poisson_linearsolve_mms.jl` (CPU) and\n`test/analytical/poisson_cudss_gpu.jl` (GPU, gated on `CUDA.functional()`).\n\"\"\"\nfunction solve_poisson_direct(f, N::Integer;\n                              bc::Symbol = :dirichlet,\n                              method::LinearSolveBackend = PoissonLinearSolve(),\n                              k0::Integer = 1)\n    N = _check_grid_size(N)\n    ffun = _poisson_rhs_function(f, N)\n\n    if bc === :dirichlet\n        A, b = assemble_poisson_dirichlet(N, ffun)\n        pin = 0\n    elseif bc === :neumann\n        A, b = assemble_poisson_neumann_unpinned(N, ffun)\n        pin = Int(k0)\n    else\n        throw(ArgumentError(\"bc must be :dirichlet or :neumann\"))\n    end\n\n    cache = lin_factorize(A; backend = method, spd = true, pin_k0 = pin)\n    u = lin_solve!(cache, b)\n    return reshape(Vector{Float64}(Array(u)), N, N)\nend\n```"), (name = :solve_poisson_dirichlet, signature = "function solve_poisson_dirichlet(N::Integer, f::Function)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    solve_poisson_dirichlet(N, f) -> Matrix{Float64}\n\nSolve `-∇²u = f` on the unit square with homogeneous Dirichlet boundaries on an\n`N x N` cell-centred grid. Inhomogeneous Dirichlet\ndata must be folded into the RHS by the caller. `f(x, y)` is sampled at cell\ncentres `((i-0.5)h, (j-0.5)h)`, `h = 1/N`.\n\nThis is the assembled CPU reference path; the matrix-free GPU path with the SAME\noperator convention is [`solve_poisson_mg`](@ref). The all-Neumann operator is singular (constant\nnullspace: a missing neighbour SUBTRACTS `1/h²` from the diagonal, zero-flux\nmirror); the system is regularised by pinning reference DOF `k0` to the exact\nvalue `u_exact` at that cell centre via `pin_reference_dof` (row/col `k0`\nreplaced by identity, RHS adjusted consistently). `u_exact` is evaluated ONLY at\nthe pinned cell centre — it anchors the additive constant.\n\nReceipt: `test/analytical/poisson_mms.jl` (unpinned operator has zero row sums\nand `solve_poisson` throws on it; pinned variant converges at second order).\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    solve_poisson_neumann(N, f, u_exact; k0=1) -> Matrix{Float64}\n\nSolve the all-Neumann (zero-flux) Poisson problem `-∇²u = f` on the unit square,\n`N x N` cell-centred grid. The all-Neumann operator is singular (constant\nnullspace: a missing neighbour SUBTRACTS `1/h²` from the diagonal, zero-flux\nmirror); the system is regularised by pinning reference DOF `k0` to the exact\nvalue `u_exact` at that cell centre via `pin_reference_dof` (row/col `k0`\nreplaced by identity, RHS adjusted consistently). `u_exact` is evaluated ONLY at\nthe pinned cell centre — it anchors the additive constant.\n\nReceipt: `test/analytical/poisson_mms.jl` (unpinned operator has zero row sums\nand `solve_poisson` throws on it; pinned variant converges at second order).\n\"\"\"\nfunction solve_poisson_neumann(N::Integer, f::Function, u_exact::Function; k0::Integer=1)\n    A, b = assemble_poisson_neumann_pinned(N, f, u_exact; k0=k0)\n    return solve_poisson(A, b, N)\nend\n```"), (name = :pin_reference_dof, signature = "function pin_reference_dof(A::SparseMatrixCSC{Float64, Int},", docstring = "", source_excerpt = "```julia\nfunction pin_reference_dof(A::SparseMatrixCSC{Float64, Int},\n                           b::AbstractVector{<:Real},\n                           k0::Integer,\n                           value::Real)\n    size(A, 1) == size(A, 2) || throw(ArgumentError(\"A must be square\"))\n    n = size(A, 1)\n    length(b) == n || throw(ArgumentError(\"b length must match A\"))\n    1 <= k0 <= n || throw(ArgumentError(\"pin index k0 must be in 1:size(A,1)\"))\n\n    k0 = Int(k0)\n    pin_value = Float64(value)\n    b_pinned = Float64.(b)\n\n    rows = rowvals(A)\n    vals = nonzeros(A)\n    for p in nzrange(A, k0)\n        row = rows[p]\n        if row != k0\n            b_pinned[row] -= vals[p] * pin_value\n        end\n    end\n    b_pinned[k0] = pin_value\n\n    old_I, old_J, old_V = findnz(A)\n    I = Int[]\n    J = Int[]\n    V = Float64[]\n    sizehint!(I, length(old_V) + 1)\n    sizehint!(J, length(old_V) + 1)\n    sizehint!(V, length(old_V) + 1)\n\n    for q in eachindex(old_V)\n        if old_I[q] != k0 && old_J[q] != k0\n            _push_entry!(I, J, V, old_I[q], old_J[q], old_V[q])\n        end\n    end\n    _push_entry!(I, J, V, k0, k0, 1.0)\n\n    return sparse(I, J, V, n, n), b_pinned\nend\n```"), (name = :assemble_poisson_embedded, signature = "function assemble_poisson_embedded(N::Integer, face_frac_x, face_frac_y, vol_frac,", docstring = "", source_excerpt = "```julia\nfunction assemble_poisson_embedded(N::Integer, face_frac_x, face_frac_y, vol_frac,\n                                   f::Function;\n                                   outer_bc::Symbol=:neumann,\n                                   embedded_bc::Symbol=:neumann,\n                                   outer_dirichlet::Function=_zero_dirichlet_value,\n                                   embedded_dirichlet::Function=_zero_dirichlet_value)\n    N = _check_grid_size(N)\n    _check_bc_symbol(outer_bc, \"outer_bc\")\n    _check_bc_symbol(embedded_bc, \"embedded_bc\")\n    _check_fraction_arrays(N, face_frac_x, face_frac_y, vol_frac)\n\n    n = N * N\n    h = 1.0 / Float64(N)\n    invh2 = 1.0 / (h * h)\n\n    I = Int[]\n    J = Int[]\n    V = Float64[]\n    sizehint!(I, 6n)\n    sizehint!(J, 6n)\n    sizehint!(V, 6n)\n\n    diag = zeros(Float64, n)\n    b = zeros(Float64, n)\n\n    for j in 1:N, i in 1:N\n        k = linear_index(i, j, N)\n        vol = _check_fraction_value(vol_frac[i, j], \"vol_frac\", i, j)\n        if _is_fluid(vol)\n            x, y = cell_coordinates(i, j, N)\n            b[k] = vol * Float64(f(x, y))\n        else\n            diag[k] = 1.0\n        end\n    end\n\n    for j in 1:N, i in 2:N\n        left = linear_index(i - 1, j, N)\n        right = linear_index(i, j, N)\n        if _is_fluid(vol_frac[i - 1, j]) && _is_fluid(vol_frac[i, j])\n            α = _check_fraction_value(face_frac_x[i, j], \"face_frac_x\", i, j)\n            α > 0.0 && _add_symmetric_face!(I, J, V, diag, left, right, α * invh2)\n        end\n    end\n\n    for j in 2:N, i in 1:N\n        bottom = linear_index(i, j - 1, N)\n        top = linear_index(i, j, N)\n        if _is_fluid(vol_frac[i, j - 1]) && _is_fluid(vol_frac[i, j])\n            α = _check_fraction_value(face_frac_y[i, j], \"face_frac_y\", i, j)\n            α > 0.0 && _add_symmetric_face!(I, J, V, diag, bottom, top, α * invh2)\n        end\n    end\n\n    if outer_bc == :dirichlet\n        _add_outer_dirichlet_faces!(\n            diag, b, N, face_frac_x, face_frac_y, vol_frac, outer_dirichlet, invh2,\n        )\n    end\n\n    if embedded_bc == :dirichlet\n        _add_embedded_dirichlet_faces!(\n            diag, b, N, face_frac_x, face_frac_y, vol_frac, embedded_dirichlet, invh2,\n        )\n    end\n\n    for k in 1:n\n        _push_entry!(I, J, V, k, k, diag[k])\n    end\n\n    return sparse(I, J, V, n, n), b\nend\n```"), (name = :solve_poisson_embedded, signature = "function solve_poisson_embedded(N::Integer, face_frac_x, face_frac_y, vol_frac,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    solve_poisson_embedded(N, face_frac_x, face_frac_y, vol_frac, f;\n                           outer_bc=:neumann, embedded_bc=:neumann,\n                           outer_dirichlet=g, embedded_dirichlet=g) -> Matrix{Float64}\n\nSolve the cut-cell (embedded-boundary) Poisson problem `-∇²u = f` on the unit\nsquare: assemble via `assemble_poisson_embedded`, then solve through\n[`solve_poisson`](@ref) (factorize-once CPU CHOLMOD seam).\n\nAperture-fraction convention (see file header): `face_frac_x :: (N+1, N)` and\n`face_frac_y :: (N, N+1)` are OPEN fractions of the x-/y-normal faces (shared\ninterior faces, plus the box faces at indices 1 and N+1); `vol_frac :: (N, N)` is\nthe open volume fraction. Fully solid cells (`vol_frac == 0`) are kept as\nisolated identity rows with `b = 0`, so the global `N²` indexing stays compatible\nwith the regular-grid solver. The fluid-fluid conductance of an interior face is\nthe symmetric `α/h²` pair; with `embedded_bc=:dirichlet` the BLOCKED part\n`β = 1-α` of each cut-cell face becomes a Dirichlet wall contributing `2β/h²`\n(half-spacing) to the diagonal and `2β/h² · g` to the RHS.\n\nWith the default all-Neumann BCs the assembled operator is singular: do NOT call\nthis directly — assemble, pin a fluid DOF (`first_fluid_dof` +\n`pin_reference_dof`), and call `solve_poisson`, as the MMS tests do. Direct calls\nare valid whenever a Dirichlet face makes the operator non-singular.\n\nReceipt: `test/analytical/poisson_embedded_mms.jl` (all-ones fractions reproduce\nthe regular solver; tilted half-plane geometry `tilted_half_plane_fractions`\nconverges ~2nd order in the fluid L2 norm).
