The bang suffix indicates that one or more array arguments are updated in-place.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.slbm_trt_libb_step_local_biquad_2d!)\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction slbm_trt_libb_step_local_biquad_2d!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,\n                                               q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y,\n                                               geom::SLBMGeometry,\n                                               sp_field, sm_field)\n    backend = KernelAbstractions.get_backend(f_in)\n    kernel! = build_lbm_kernel(backend, _SLBM_TRT_LIBB_LOCAL_BIQUAD_SPEC_2D)\n    kernel!(f_out, ρ, ux, uy, f_in, is_solid,\n            q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y,\n            geom.i_dep, geom.j_dep,\n            geom.Nξ, geom.Nη,\n            sp_field, sm_field,\n            geom.periodic_ξ, geom.periodic_η;\n            ndrange=(geom.Nξ, geom.Nη))\nend\n```"), (name = :slbm_reg_libb_step_local_2d!, signature = "function slbm_reg_libb_step_local_2d!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    slbm_reg_libb_step_local_2d!(...)\n\nSLBM + Regularized TRT + LI-BB step (D2Q9). Uses Latt & Chopard (2006)\nregularization: reconstructs f_neq from the stress tensor Π⁽¹⁾ only,\nfiltering ghost modes. Stable at τ→0.5 on stretched meshes where the\nstandard TRT/BGK collision diverges.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    slbm_reg_libb_step_local_2d!(...)\n\nSLBM + Regularized TRT + LI-BB step (D2Q9). Uses Latt & Chopard (2006)\nregularization: reconstructs f_neq from the stress tensor Π⁽¹⁾ only,\nfiltering ghost modes. Stable at τ→0.5 on stretched meshes where the\nstandard TRT/BGK collision diverges.\n\"\"\"\nfunction slbm_reg_libb_step_local_2d!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,\n                                        q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y,\n                                        geom::SLBMGeometry,\n                                        sp_field, sm_field)\n    backend = KernelAbstractions.get_backend(f_in)\n    kernel! = build_lbm_kernel(backend, _SLBM_REG_LIBB_LOCAL_SPEC_2D)\n    kernel!(f_out, ρ, ux, uy, f_in, is_solid,\n            q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y,\n            geom.i_dep, geom.j_dep,\n            geom.Nξ, geom.Nη,\n            sp_field, sm_field,\n            geom.periodic_ξ, geom.periodic_η;\n            ndrange=(geom.Nξ, geom.Nη))\nend\n```"), (name = :precompute_q_wall_slbm_cylinder_2d, signature = "function precompute_q_wall_slbm_cylinder_2d(", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    precompute_q_wall_slbm_cylinder_2d(mesh, is_solid, cx, cy, R;\n        omega_inner=0, FT=Float64) -> (q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y)\n\nPrecompute LI-BB cut fractions on a curvilinear mesh for a cylindrical\nbody centered at `(cx, cy)` with radius `R` in physical space.\n\nFor each fluid node `(i,j)` and direction `q`, if the computational\nneighbor `(i+cxq, j+cyq)` is solid, we ray-intersect the physical-space\nsegment from the fluid node to the neighbor with the circle. The wall\nvelocity for a rotating inner cylinder is `u_wall = omega_inner × r`.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    precompute_q_wall_slbm_cylinder_2d(mesh, is_solid, cx, cy, R;\n        omega_inner=0, FT=Float64) -> (q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y)\n\nPrecompute LI-BB cut fractions on a curvilinear mesh for a cylindrical\nbody centered at `(cx, cy)` with radius `R` in physical space.\n\nFor each fluid node `(i,j)` and direction `q`, if the computational\nneighbor `(i+cxq, j+cyq)` is solid, we ray-intersect the physical-space\nsegment from the fluid node to the neighbor with the circle. The wall\nvelocity for a rotating inner cylinder is `u_wall = omega_inner × r`.\n\"\"\"\nfunction precompute_q_wall_slbm_cylinder_2d(\n        mesh::CurvilinearMesh{T},\n        is_solid::AbstractMatrix{Bool},\n        cx_body::Real, cy_body::Real, R_body::Real;\n        omega_inner::Real=0,\n        FT::Type{<:AbstractFloat}=T) where {T}\n\n    Nξ, Nη = mesh.Nξ, mesh.Nη\n    cxs = velocities_x(D2Q9())\n    cys = velocities_y(D2Q9())\n\n    q_wall    = zeros(FT, Nξ, Nη, 9)\n    uw_link_x = zeros(FT, Nξ, Nη, 9)\n    uw_link_y = zeros(FT, Nξ, Nη, 9)\n\n    cx_b, cy_b, R_b = FT(cx_body), FT(cy_body), FT(R_body)\n    R² = R_b * R_b\n    Ω = FT(omega_inner)\n\n    @inbounds for j in 1:Nη, i in 1:Nξ\n        is_solid[i, j] && continue\n\n        Xf = mesh.X[i, j]\n        Yf = mesh.Y[i, j]\n\n        for q in 2:9\n            diq = cxs[q]\n            djq = cys[q]\n            in_ = i + diq\n            jn_ = j + djq\n\n            if mesh.periodic_ξ\n                in_ = ((in_ - 1) % Nξ + Nξ) % Nξ + 1\n            end\n\n            (in_ < 1 || in_ > Nξ || jn_ < 1 || jn_ > Nη) && continue\n            is_solid[in_, jn_] || continue\n\n            Xn = mesh.X[in_, jn_]\n            Yn = mesh.Y[in_, jn_]\n\n            # Ray-circle intersection: P(t) = P_fluid + t*(P_neighbor - P_fluid)\n            dx = Xn - Xf\n            dy = Yn - Yf\n            fx = Xf - cx_b\n            fy = Yf - cy_b\n\n            a = dx * dx + dy * dy\n            b_coeff = FT(2) * (fx * dx + fy * dy)\n            c_coeff = fx * fx + fy * fy - R²\n            disc = b_coeff * b_coeff - FT(4) * a * c_coeff\n\n            if disc < zero(FT)\n                q_wall[i, j, q] = FT(0.5)\n            else\n                sd = sqrt(disc)\n                t1 = (-b_coeff - sd) / (FT(2) * a)\n                t2 = (-b_coeff + sd) / (FT(2) * a)\n                t = (t1 > zero(FT) && t1 ≤ one(FT)) ? t1 :\n                    (t2 > zero(FT) && t2 ≤ one(FT)) ? t2 : FT(0.5)\n                q_wall[i, j, q] = t\n            end\n\n            if !iszero(Ω)\n                tw = q_wall[i, j, q]\n                Xw = Xf + tw * dx\n                Yw = Yf + tw * dy\n                uw_link_x[i, j, q] = -Ω * (Yw - cy_b)\n                uw_link_y[i, j, q] =  Ω * (Xw - cx_b)\n            end\n        end\n    end\n\n    return q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y\nend\n```"), (name = :compute_local_omega_2d, signature = "function compute_local_omega_2d(mesh::CurvilinearMesh{T}; ν::Real, Λ::Real=3/16,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    compute_local_omega_2d(mesh; ν, Λ=3/16, scaling=:quadratic, τ_floor=0.5)\n        -> (s_plus_field, s_minus_field)\n\nPrecompute per-cell TRT relaxation rates on a curvilinear mesh, accounting\nfor the local cell size variation. Returns 2D arrays `s_plus[Nξ, Nη]` and\n`s_minus[Nξ, Nη]`.\n\nOn meshes with aggressive stretching (cell-size ratio ≳ 10×), quadratic\nSLBM rescaling drives `τ → 0.5` on the largest cells, which destabilises\nTRT. The `τ_floor` kwarg clamps `τ_local ≥ τ_floor`, trading a small\nexcess numerical viscosity on coarse cells (where resolution is already\npoor so it matters little) for stability. Set `τ_floor=0.5` (default) to\ndisable the clamp — identical to pre-clamp behaviour.\n\nThe local cell size is estimated as\n`√(dXdξ² + dYdξ²) · Δξ · √(dXdη² + dYdη²) · Δη`.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    compute_local_omega_2d(mesh; ν, Λ=3/16, scaling=:quadratic, τ_floor=0.5)\n        -> (s_plus_field, s_minus_field)\n\nPrecompute per-cell TRT relaxation rates on a curvilinear mesh, accounting\nfor the local cell size variation. Returns 2D arrays `s_plus[Nξ, Nη]` and\n`s_minus[Nξ, Nη]`.\n\nOn meshes with aggressive stretching (cell-size ratio ≳ 10×), quadratic\nSLBM rescaling drives `τ → 0.5` on the largest cells, which destabilises\nTRT. The `τ_floor` kwarg clamps `τ_local ≥ τ_floor`, trading a small\nexcess numerical viscosity on coarse cells (where resolution is already\npoor so it matters little) for stability. Set `τ_floor=0.5` (default) to\ndisable the clamp — identical to pre-clamp behaviour.\n\nThe local cell size is estimated as\n`√(dXdξ² + dYdξ²) · Δξ · √(dXdη² + dYdη²) · Δη`.\n\"\"\"\nfunction compute_local_omega_2d(mesh::CurvilinearMesh{T}; ν::Real, Λ::Real=3/16,\n                                 scaling::Symbol=:quadratic,\n                                 τ_floor::Real=0.5) where {T}\n    Nξ, Nη = mesh.Nξ, mesh.Nη\n    denom_ξ = T(mesh.periodic_ξ ? Nξ : Nξ - 1)\n    denom_η = T(mesh.periodic_η ? Nη : Nη - 1)\n    Δξ = one(T) / denom_ξ\n    Δη = one(T) / denom_η\n\n    s_plus_ref, s_minus_ref = trt_rates(ν; Λ=Λ)\n    τ_plus_ref  = one(T) / T(s_plus_ref)\n    τ_minus_ref = one(T) / T(s_minus_ref)\n    τ_lo = T(τ_floor)\n\n    sp = zeros(T, Nξ, Nη)\n    sm = zeros(T, Nξ, Nη)\n\n    @inbounds for j in 1:Nη, i in 1:Nξ\n        lξ = sqrt(mesh.dXdξ[i, j]^2 + mesh.dYdξ[i, j]^2) * Δξ\n        lη = sqrt(mesh.dXdη[i, j]^2 + mesh.dYdη[i, j]^2) * Δη\n        dx_local = sqrt(lξ * lη)\n        r = dx_local / mesh.dx_ref\n\n        if scaling === :quadratic\n            # SLBM with global dt: ν = (τ-0.5)/3 * dx²/dt. For uniform ν\n            # with varying dx: τ_local - 0.5 = (dx_ref/dx_local)² * (τ_ref - 0.5)\n            r_inv2 = (mesh.dx_ref / dx_local)^2\n            τ_plus_local  = r_inv2 * (τ_plus_ref  - T(0.5)) + T(0.5)\n            τ_minus_local = r_inv2 * (τ_minus_ref - T(0.5)) + T(0.5)\n        elseif scaling === :none\n            # Uniform τ (no local rescaling). Use this for diagnostic\n            # comparison or when local-CFL is disabled.\n            τ_plus_local  = τ_plus_ref\n            τ_minus_local = τ_minus_ref\n        else  # :linear (Filippova-Hänel, for refinement with Δt ∝ Δx)\n            τ_plus_local  = r * (τ_plus_ref  - T(0.5)) + T(0.5)\n            τ_minus_local = r * (τ_minus_ref - T(0.5)) + T(0.5)\n        end\n        sp[i, j] = one(T) / max(τ_plus_local,  τ_lo)\n        sm[i, j] = one(T) / max(τ_minus_local, τ_lo)\n    end\n\n    return sp, sm\nend\n```"), (name = :PullSLBM, signature = "struct PullSLBM <: LBMBrick end", docstring = "\"Semi-Lagrangian pull D2Q9: interpolate f_in at precomputed departure points.\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"Semi-Lagrangian pull D2Q9: interpolate f_in at precomputed departure points.\"\nstruct PullSLBM <: LBMBrick end\n```"), (name = :CollideTRTLocalDirect, signature = "struct CollideTRTLocalDirect <: LBMBrick end", docstring = "\"TRT collision with per-cell relaxation rates from 2D arrays s_plus[i,j], s_minus[i,j].\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"TRT collision with per-cell relaxation rates from 2D arrays s_plus[i,j], s_minus[i,j].\"\nstruct CollideTRTLocalDirect <: LBMBrick end\n```"), (name = :CurvilinearMesh3D, signature = "struct CurvilinearMesh3D{T<:AbstractFloat, AT<:AbstractArray{T, 3}}", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    CurvilinearMesh3D{T, AT}\n\nLogically structured `Nξ × Nη × Nζ` mesh in computational space with a\nuser-supplied mapping to physical 3D space. All 9 metric derivatives and\nthe Jacobian determinant are precomputed.\n\n# Fields\n- `Nξ, Nη, Nζ`: logical grid extents\n- `periodic_ξ, periodic_η, periodic_ζ`: wrap-around flags\n- `X, Y, Z`: physical node coordinates `[Nξ, Nη, Nζ]`\n- `dXdξ, dXdη, dXdζ, dYdξ, ..., dZdζ`: 9 metric derivatives\n- `J`: Jacobian determinant\n- `dx_ref`: physical distance per lattice unit\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    CurvilinearMesh3D{T, AT}\n\nLogically structured `Nξ × Nη × Nζ` mesh in computational space with a\nuser-supplied mapping to physical 3D space. All 9 metric derivatives and\nthe Jacobian determinant are precomputed.\n\n# Fields\n- `Nξ, Nη, Nζ`: logical grid extents\n- `periodic_ξ, periodic_η, periodic_ζ`: wrap-around flags\n- `X, Y, Z`: physical node coordinates `[Nξ, Nη, Nζ]`\n- `dXdξ, dXdη, dXdζ, dYdξ, ..., dZdζ`: 9 metric derivatives\n- `J`: Jacobian determinant\n- `dx_ref`: physical distance per lattice unit\n\"\"\"\nstruct CurvilinearMesh3D{T<:AbstractFloat, AT<:AbstractArray{T, 3}}\n    type::Symbol\n    Nξ::Int\n    Nη::Int\n    Nζ::Int\n    periodic_ξ::Bool\n    periodic_η::Bool\n    periodic_ζ::Bool\n    X::AT\n    Y::AT\n    Z::AT\n    dXdξ::AT; dXdη::AT; dXdζ::AT\n    dYdξ::AT; dYdη::AT; dYdζ::AT\n    dZdξ::AT; dZdη::AT; dZdζ::AT\n    J::AT\n    dx_ref::T\nend\n```"), (name = :build_mesh_3d, signature = "function build_mesh_3d(mapping;", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    build_mesh_3d(mapping; Nξ, Nη, Nζ, ...) -> CurvilinearMesh3D\n\nSample the 3D mapping on the logical grid and compute all 9 metric\nderivatives + Jacobian determinant via ForwardDiff.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    build_mesh_3d(mapping; Nξ, Nη, Nζ, ...) -> CurvilinearMesh3D\n\nSample the 3D mapping on the logical grid and compute all 9 metric\nderivatives + Jacobian determinant via ForwardDiff.\n\"\"\"\nfunction build_mesh_3d(mapping;\n                       Nξ::Int, Nη::Int, Nζ::Int,\n                       periodic_ξ::Bool=false, periodic_η::Bool=false,\n                       periodic_ζ::Bool=false,\n                       type::Symbol=:custom,\n                       dx_ref::Union{Real, Nothing}=nothing,\n                       FT::Type{<:AbstractFloat}=Float64)\n    X = zeros(FT, Nξ, Nη, Nζ); Y = similar(X); Z = similar(X)\n    dXdξ = similar(X); dXdη = similar(X); dXdζ = similar(X)\n    dYdξ = similar(X); dYdη = similar(X); dYdζ = similar(X)\n    dZdξ = similar(X); dZdη = similar(X); dZdζ = similar(X)\n    J = similar(X)\n\n    denom_ξ = FT(periodic_ξ ? Nξ : Nξ - 1)\n    denom_η = FT(periodic_η ? Nη : Nη - 1)\n    denom_ζ = FT(periodic_ζ ? Nζ : Nζ - 1)\n\n    for k in 1:Nζ, j in 1:Nη, i in 1:Nξ\n        ξ = FT(i - 1) / denom_ξ\n        η = FT(j - 1) / denom_η\n        ζ = FT(k - 1) / denom_ζ\n        xyz = mapping(ξ, η, ζ)\n        X[i,j,k] = xyz[1]; Y[i,j,k] = xyz[2]; Z[i,j,k] = xyz[3]\n        dX_ξ, dX_η, dX_ζ, dY_ξ, dY_η, dY_ζ, dZ_ξ, dZ_η, dZ_ζ, detJ =\n            compute_metric_3d(mapping, ξ, η, ζ)\n        dXdξ[i,j,k] = dX_ξ; dXdη[i,j,k] = dX_η; dXdζ[i,j,k] = dX_ζ\n        dYdξ[i,j,k] = dY_ξ; dYdη[i,j,k] = dY_η; dYdζ[i,j,k] = dY_ζ\n        dZdξ[i,j,k] = dZ_ξ; dZdη[i,j,k] = dZ_η; dZdζ[i,j,k] = dZ_ζ\n        J[i,j,k] = detJ\n    end\n\n    dxr = dx_ref === nothing ?\n          _default_dx_ref_3d(dXdξ, dXdη, dXdζ, dYdξ, dYdη, dYdζ,\n                              dZdξ, dZdη, dZdζ, Nξ, Nη, Nζ,\n                              periodic_ξ, periodic_η, periodic_ζ, FT) :\n          FT(dx_ref)\n\n    mesh = CurvilinearMesh3D{FT, Array{FT,3}}(type, Nξ, Nη, Nζ,\n        periodic_ξ, periodic_η, periodic_ζ, X, Y, Z,\n        dXdξ, dXdη, dXdζ, dYdξ, dYdη, dYdζ, dZdξ, dZdη, dZdζ, J, dxr)\n    validate_mesh_3d(mesh)\n    return mesh\nend\n```"), (name = :validate_mesh_3d, signature = "function validate_mesh_3d(mesh::CurvilinearMesh3D{T}) where {T}", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    validate_mesh_3d(mesh::CurvilinearMesh3D{T}) where {T}\n\nPublic function in the curvilinear mesh and SLBM API.\nSee the method definition below for argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.validate_mesh_3d)\n```\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    validate_mesh_3d(mesh::CurvilinearMesh3D{T}) where {T}\n\nPublic function in the curvilinear mesh and SLBM API.\nSee the method definition below for argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.validate_mesh_3d)\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction validate_mesh_3d(mesh::CurvilinearMesh3D{T}) where {T}\n    Jmin = minimum(mesh.J); Jmax = maximum(mesh.J)\n    Jabs_min = min(abs(Jmin), abs(Jmax))\n    if Jabs_min == zero(T) || (Jmin < zero(T) && Jmax > zero(T))\n        error(\"CurvilinearMesh3D: degenerate Jacobian (sign change or zero): \" *\n              \"Jmin=\$Jmin, Jmax=\$Jmax\")\n    end\n    return nothing\nend\n```"), (name = :stretched_box_mesh_3d, signature = "function stretched_box_mesh_3d(; x_min::Real, x_max::Real,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    stretched_box_mesh_3d(; x_min, x_max, y_min, y_max, z_min, z_max,\n                           Nx, Ny, Nz,\n                           x_stretch=0, y_stretch=0, z_stretch=0,\n                           x_stretch_dir=:none, y_stretch_dir=:none, z_stretch_dir=:none,\n                           FT=Float64) -> CurvilinearMesh3D\n\nRectangular 3D mesh with optional tanh stretching per axis. Same\nstretching directions as the 2D version.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    stretched_box_mesh_3d(; x_min, x_max, y_min, y_max, z_min, z_max,\n                           Nx, Ny, Nz,\n                           x_stretch=0, y_stretch=0, z_stretch=0,\n                           x_stretch_dir=:none, y_stretch_dir=:none, z_stretch_dir=:none,\n                           FT=Float64) -> CurvilinearMesh3D\n\nRectangular 3D mesh with optional tanh stretching per axis. Same\nstretching directions as the 2D version.\n\"\"\"\nfunction stretched_box_mesh_3d(; x_min::Real, x_max::Real,\n                                 y_min::Real, y_max::Real,\n                                 z_min::Real, z_max::Real,\n                                 Nx::Int, Ny::Int, Nz::Int,\n                                 x_stretch::Real=0.0, y_stretch::Real=0.0, z_stretch::Real=0.0,\n                                 x_stretch_dir::Symbol=:none,\n                                 y_stretch_dir::Symbol=:none,\n                                 z_stretch_dir::Symbol=:none,\n                                 FT::Type{<:AbstractFloat}=Float64)\n    xminT, xmaxT = FT(x_min), FT(x_max)\n    yminT, ymaxT = FT(y_min), FT(y_max)\n    zminT, zmaxT = FT(z_min), FT(z_max)\n    sxT, syT, szT = FT(x_stretch), FT(y_stretch), FT(z_stretch)\n\n    function mapping(ξ, η, ζ)\n        tx = _stretch(ξ, sxT, x_stretch_dir)\n        ty = _stretch(η, syT, y_stretch_dir)\n        tz = _stretch(ζ, szT, z_stretch_dir)\n        return (xminT + (xmaxT - xminT) * tx,\n                yminT + (ymaxT - yminT) * ty,\n                zminT + (zmaxT - zminT) * tz)\n    end\n\n    return build_mesh_3d(mapping; Nξ=Nx, Nη=Ny, Nζ=Nz,\n                         periodic_ξ=false, periodic_η=false, periodic_ζ=false,\n                         type=:stretched_box_3d, FT=FT)\nend\n```"), (name = :cartesian_mesh_3d, signature = "function cartesian_mesh_3d(; x_min::Real, x_max::Real,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    cartesian_mesh_3d(; x_min, x_max, y_min, y_max, z_min, z_max,\n                        Nx, Ny, Nz, FT=Float64)\n\nConvenience: uniform Cartesian 3D mesh.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    cartesian_mesh_3d(; x_min, x_max, y_min, y_max, z_min, z_max,\n                        Nx, Ny, Nz, FT=Float64)\n\nConvenience: uniform Cartesian 3D mesh.\n\"\"\"\nfunction cartesian_mesh_3d(; x_min::Real, x_max::Real,\n                             y_min::Real, y_max::Real,\n                             z_min::Real, z_max::Real,\n                             Nx::Int, Ny::Int, Nz::Int,\n                             FT::Type{<:AbstractFloat}=Float64)\n    return stretched_box_mesh_3d(; x_min=x_min, x_max=x_max,\n                                   y_min=y_min, y_max=y_max,\n                                   z_min=z_min, z_max=z_max,\n                                   Nx=Nx, Ny=Ny, Nz=Nz, FT=FT)\nend\n```"), (name = :SLBMGeometry3D, signature = "struct SLBMGeometry3D{T<:AbstractFloat, AT4<:AbstractArray{T, 4}}", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    SLBMGeometry3D{T, AT4}\n\nPrecomputed departure indices for D3Q19 SLBM. Fields `i_dep[Nξ,Nη,Nζ,19]`,\n`j_dep`, `k_dep` in grid-index space.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    SLBMGeometry3D{T, AT4}\n\nPrecomputed departure indices for D3Q19 SLBM. Fields `i_dep[Nξ,Nη,Nζ,19]`,\n`j_dep`, `k_dep` in grid-index space.\n\"\"\"\nstruct SLBMGeometry3D{T<:AbstractFloat, AT4<:AbstractArray{T, 4}}\n    i_dep::AT4\n    j_dep::AT4\n    k_dep::AT4\n    Nξ::Int\n    Nη::Int\n    Nζ::Int\n    periodic_ξ::Bool\n    periodic_η::Bool\n    periodic_ζ::Bool\n    dx_ref::T\nend\n```"), (name = :build_slbm_geometry_3d, signature = "function build_slbm_geometry_3d(mesh::CurvilinearMesh3D{T}; local_cfl::Bool=false) where {T}", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    build_slbm_geometry_3d(mesh::CurvilinearMesh3D{T}; local_cfl::Bool=false) where {T}\n\nPublic function in the curvilinear mesh and SLBM API.\nSee the method definition below for argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.build_slbm_geometry_3d)\n```\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    build_slbm_geometry_3d(mesh::CurvilinearMesh3D{T}; local_cfl::Bool=false) where {T}\n\nPublic function in the curvilinear mesh and SLBM API.\nSee the method definition below for argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.build_slbm_geometry_3d)\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction build_slbm_geometry_3d(mesh::CurvilinearMesh3D{T}; local_cfl::Bool=false) where {T}\n    Nξ, Nη, Nζ = mesh.Nξ, mesh.Nη, mesh.Nζ\n    cx = velocities_x(D3Q19())\n    cy = velocities_y(D3Q19())\n    cz = velocities_z(D3Q19())\n\n    denom_ξ = T(mesh.periodic_ξ ? Nξ : Nξ - 1)\n    denom_η = T(mesh.periodic_η ? Nη : Nη - 1)\n    denom_ζ = T(mesh.periodic_ζ ? Nζ : Nζ - 1)\n    Δξ = one(T) / denom_ξ\n    Δη = one(T) / denom_η\n    Δζ = one(T) / denom_ζ\n\n    i_dep = zeros(T, Nξ, Nη, Nζ, 19)\n    j_dep = zeros(T, Nξ, Nη, Nζ, 19)\n    k_dep = zeros(T, Nξ, Nη, Nζ, 19)\n    dxr = mesh.dx_ref\n\n    @inbounds for k in 1:Nζ, j in 1:Nη, i in 1:Nξ\n        J = mesh.J[i,j,k]\n        # Metric tensor components\n        dX_ξ = mesh.dXdξ[i,j,k]; dX_η = mesh.dXdη[i,j,k]; dX_ζ = mesh.dXdζ[i,j,k]\n        dY_ξ = mesh.dYdξ[i,j,k]; dY_η = mesh.dYdη[i,j,k]; dY_ζ = mesh.dYdζ[i,j,k]\n        dZ_ξ = mesh.dZdξ[i,j,k]; dZ_η = mesh.dZdη[i,j,k]; dZ_ζ = mesh.dZdζ[i,j,k]\n\n        # Inverse Jacobian (cofactor / det). Rows of inv give ∂ξ/∂X, etc.\n        ξx = (dY_η*dZ_ζ - dY_ζ*dZ_η) / J\n        ξy = (dX_ζ*dZ_η - dX_η*dZ_ζ) / J\n        ξz = (dX_η*dY_ζ - dX_ζ*dY_η) / J\n        ηx = (dY_ζ*dZ_ξ - dY_ξ*dZ_ζ) / J\n        ηy = (dX_ξ*dZ_ζ - dX_ζ*dZ_ξ) / J\n        ηz = (dX_ζ*dY_ξ - dX_ξ*dY_ζ) / J\n        ζx = (dY_ξ*dZ_η - dY_η*dZ_ξ) / J\n        ζy = (dX_η*dZ_ξ - dX_ξ*dZ_η) / J\n        ζz = (dX_ξ*dY_η - dX_η*dY_ξ) / J\n\n        if local_cfl\n            lξ = sqrt(dX_ξ^2 + dY_ξ^2 + dZ_ξ^2) * Δξ\n            lη = sqrt(dX_η^2 + dY_η^2 + dZ_η^2) * Δη\n            lζ = sqrt(dX_ζ^2 + dY_ζ^2 + dZ_ζ^2) * Δζ\n            dxr_local = cbrt(lξ * lη * lζ)\n        else\n            dxr_local = dxr\n        end\n\n        for q in 1:19\n            cqx = T(cx[q]); cqy = T(cy[q]); cqz = T(cz[q])\n            Δi = -dxr_local * denom_ξ * (ξx*cqx + ξy*cqy + ξz*cqz)\n            Δj = -dxr_local * denom_η * (ηx*cqx + ηy*cqy + ηz*cqz)\n            Δk = -dxr_local * denom_ζ * (ζx*cqx + ζy*cqy + ζz*cqz)\n            i_dep[i,j,k,q] = T(i) + Δi\n            j_dep[i,j,k,q] = T(j) + Δj\n            k_dep[i,j,k,q] = T(k) + Δk\n        end\n    end\n\n    return SLBMGeometry3D{T, Array{T,4}}(i_dep, j_dep, k_dep, Nξ, Nη, Nζ,\n        mesh.periodic_ξ, mesh.periodic_η, mesh.periodic_ζ, dxr)\nend\n```"), (name = :transfer_slbm_geometry_3d, signature = "function transfer_slbm_geometry_3d(geom::SLBMGeometry3D{T}, backend) where {T}", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    transfer_slbm_geometry_3d(geom::SLBMGeometry3D{T}, backend) where {T}\n\nPublic function in the curvilinear mesh and SLBM API.\nSee the method definition below for argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.transfer_slbm_geometry_3d)\n```\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    transfer_slbm_geometry_3d(geom::SLBMGeometry3D{T}, backend) where {T}\n\nPublic function in the curvilinear mesh and SLBM API.\nSee the method definition below for argument requirements, array layout, and backend expectations.\n\n```julia\nusing Kraken\n\nmethods(Kraken.transfer_slbm_geometry_3d)\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction transfer_slbm_geometry_3d(geom::SLBMGeometry3D{T}, backend) where {T}\n    i_dep = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, size(geom.i_dep))\n    j_dep = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, size(geom.j_dep))\n    k_dep = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, size(geom.k_dep))\n    copyto!(i_dep, geom.i_dep); copyto!(j_dep, geom.j_dep); copyto!(k_dep, geom.k_dep)\n    return SLBMGeometry3D{T, typeof(i_dep)}(i_dep, j_dep, k_dep, geom.Nξ, geom.Nη, geom.Nζ,\n        geom.periodic_ξ, geom.periodic_η, geom.periodic_ζ, geom.dx_ref)\nend\n```"), (name = :slbm_bgk_step_3d!, signature = "function slbm_bgk_step_3d!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, uz, is_solid,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    slbm_bgk_step_3d!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, uz, is_solid, geom, ω)\n\nFused SLBM + BGK step for D3Q19 on a curvilinear 3D mesh.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    slbm_bgk_step_3d!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, uz, is_solid, geom, ω)\n\nFused SLBM + BGK step for D3Q19 on a curvilinear 3D mesh.\n\"\"\"\nfunction slbm_bgk_step_3d!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, uz, is_solid,\n                            geom::SLBMGeometry3D, ω)\n    backend = KernelAbstractions.get_backend(f_in)\n    ET = eltype(f_in)\n    kernel! = slbm_bgk_step_3d_kernel!(backend)\n    kernel!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, uz, is_solid,\n            geom.i_dep, geom.j_dep, geom.k_dep,\n            geom.Nξ, geom.Nη, geom.Nζ, ET(ω),\n            geom.periodic_ξ, geom.periodic_η, geom.periodic_ζ;\n            ndrange=(geom.Nξ, geom.Nη, geom.Nζ))\nend\n```"), (name = :slbm_trt_libb_step_3d!, signature = "function slbm_trt_libb_step_3d!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, uz, is_solid,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    slbm_trt_libb_step_3d!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, uz, is_solid,\n                            q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y, uw_link_z,\n                            geom, ν; Λ=3/16)\n\nFused single-pass SLBM + TRT + LI-BB step on a 3D curvilinear mesh\n(D3Q19). Combines semi-Lagrangian streaming, LI-BB pre-phase substitution\non cut links (Bouzidi for arbitrary `q_w ∈ (0, 1]`) and a TRT collision\nwith magic parameter `Λ`.\n\nReduces to the Cartesian halfway-BB + TRT + LI-BB pipeline when the mesh\nis uniform Cartesian (departures land on neighbour nodes, trilinear\ncollapses to a single node read).\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    slbm_trt_libb_step_3d!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, uz, is_solid,\n                            q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y, uw_link_z,\n                            geom, ν; Λ=3/16)\n\nFused single-pass SLBM + TRT + LI-BB step on a 3D curvilinear mesh\n(D3Q19). Combines semi-Lagrangian streaming, LI-BB pre-phase substitution\non cut links (Bouzidi for arbitrary `q_w ∈ (0, 1]`) and a TRT collision\nwith magic parameter `Λ`.\n\nReduces to the Cartesian halfway-BB + TRT + LI-BB pipeline when the mesh\nis uniform Cartesian (departures land on neighbour nodes, trilinear\ncollapses to a single node read).\n\"\"\"\nfunction slbm_trt_libb_step_3d!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, uz, is_solid,\n                                  q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y, uw_link_z,\n                                  geom::SLBMGeometry3D, ν; Λ::Real=3/16)\n    backend = KernelAbstractions.get_backend(f_in)\n    ET = eltype(f_in)\n    s_plus, s_minus = trt_rates(ν; Λ=Λ)\n    kernel! = build_lbm_kernel(backend, _SLBM_TRT_LIBB_SPEC_3D)\n    kernel!(f_out, ρ, ux, uy, uz, f_in, is_solid,\n            q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y, uw_link_z,\n            geom.i_dep, geom.j_dep, geom.k_dep,\n            geom.Nξ, geom.Nη, geom.Nζ,\n            ET(s_plus), ET(s_minus),\n            geom.periodic_ξ, geom.periodic_η, geom.periodic_ζ;\n            ndrange=(geom.Nξ, geom.Nη, geom.Nζ))\nend\n```"), (name = :slbm_trt_libb_step_local_3d!, signature = "function slbm_trt_libb_step_local_3d!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, uz, is_solid,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    slbm_trt_libb_step_local_3d!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, uz, is_solid,\n                                  q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y, uw_link_z,\n                                  geom, sp_field, sm_field)\n\nSLBM + TRT + LI-BB step (D3Q19) with PER-CELL relaxation rates from the\ndevice-side 3D arrays `sp_field` and `sm_field` (e.g. produced by\n`compute_local_omega_3d` and copied to the backend). Required on\nstretched curvilinear meshes where the local cell size — and therefore τ\n— varies per cell.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    slbm_trt_libb_step_local_3d!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, uz, is_solid,\n                                  q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y, uw_link_z,\n                                  geom, sp_field, sm_field)\n\nSLBM + TRT + LI-BB step (D3Q19) with PER-CELL relaxation rates from the\ndevice-side 3D arrays `sp_field` and `sm_field` (e.g. produced by\n`compute_local_omega_3d` and copied to the backend). Required on\nstretched curvilinear meshes where the local cell size — and therefore τ\n— varies per cell.\n\"\"\"\nfunction slbm_trt_libb_step_local_3d!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, uz, is_solid,\n                                        q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y, uw_link_z,\n                                        geom::SLBMGeometry3D,\n                                        sp_field, sm_field)\n    backend = KernelAbstractions.get_backend(f_in)\n    kernel! = build_lbm_kernel(backend, _SLBM_TRT_LIBB_LOCAL_SPEC_3D)\n    kernel!(f_out, ρ, ux, uy, uz, f_in, is_solid,\n            q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y, uw_link_z,\n            geom.i_dep, geom.j_dep, geom.k_dep,\n            geom.Nξ, geom.Nη, geom.Nζ,\n            sp_field, sm_field,\n            geom.periodic_ξ, geom.periodic_η, geom.periodic_ζ;\n            ndrange=(geom.Nξ, geom.Nη, geom.Nζ))\nend\n```"), (name = :precompute_q_wall_slbm_sphere_3d, signature = "function precompute_q_wall_slbm_sphere_3d(", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    precompute_q_wall_slbm_sphere_3d(mesh, is_solid,\n        cx_body, cy_body, cz_body, R_body;\n        FT=Float64)\n        -> (q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y, uw_link_z)\n\nPrecompute LI-BB cut fractions on a 3D curvilinear mesh for a stationary\nsphere centred at `(cx_body, cy_body, cz_body)` with radius `R_body` in\nphysical space.\n\nFor each fluid node `(i, j, k)` and direction `q ∈ 2..19`, if the\ncomputational neighbour is solid we solve the quadratic\n`|P_f + t·(P_n − P_f) − P_c|² = R²` for the smallest positive `t ∈ (0, 1]`\nand store it as `q_wall[i, j, k, q]`. Wall velocities are zero (returned\nas freshly-allocated zero arrays); rotating-body / moving-body variants\ncan be added later by mirroring the 2D `omega_inner` branch.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    precompute_q_wall_slbm_sphere_3d(mesh, is_solid,\n        cx_body, cy_body, cz_body, R_body;\n        FT=Float64)\n        -> (q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y, uw_link_z)\n\nPrecompute LI-BB cut fractions on a 3D curvilinear mesh for a stationary\nsphere centred at `(cx_body, cy_body, cz_body)` with radius `R_body` in\nphysical space.\n\nFor each fluid node `(i, j, k)` and direction `q ∈ 2..19`, if the\ncomputational neighbour is solid we solve the quadratic\n`|P_f + t·(P_n − P_f) − P_c|² = R²` for the smallest positive `t ∈ (0, 1]`\nand store it as `q_wall[i, j, k, q]`. Wall velocities are zero (returned\nas freshly-allocated zero arrays); rotating-body / moving-body variants\ncan be added later by mirroring the 2D `omega_inner` branch.\n\"\"\"\nfunction precompute_q_wall_slbm_sphere_3d(\n        mesh::CurvilinearMesh3D{T},\n        is_solid::AbstractArray{Bool, 3},\n        cx_body::Real, cy_body::Real, cz_body::Real, R_body::Real;\n        FT::Type{<:AbstractFloat}=T) where {T}\n\n    Nξ, Nη, Nζ = mesh.Nξ, mesh.Nη, mesh.Nζ\n    cxs = velocities_x(D3Q19())\n    cys = velocities_y(D3Q19())\n    czs = velocities_z(D3Q19())\n\n    q_wall    = zeros(FT, Nξ, Nη, Nζ, 19)\n    uw_link_x = zeros(FT, Nξ, Nη, Nζ, 19)\n    uw_link_y = zeros(FT, Nξ, Nη, Nζ, 19)\n    uw_link_z = zeros(FT, Nξ, Nη, Nζ, 19)\n\n    cxb, cyb, czb, Rb = FT(cx_body), FT(cy_body), FT(cz_body), FT(R_body)\n    R² = Rb * Rb\n\n    @inbounds for k in 1:Nζ, j in 1:Nη, i in 1:Nξ\n        is_solid[i, j, k] && continue\n\n        Xf = FT(mesh.X[i, j, k])\n        Yf = FT(mesh.Y[i, j, k])\n        Zf = FT(mesh.Z[i, j, k])\n\n        for q in 2:19\n            diq = cxs[q]; djq = cys[q]; dkq = czs[q]\n            in_ = i + diq; jn_ = j + djq; kn_ = k + dkq\n\n            mesh.periodic_ξ && (in_ = ((in_ - 1) % Nξ + Nξ) % Nξ + 1)\n            mesh.periodic_η && (jn_ = ((jn_ - 1) % Nη + Nη) % Nη + 1)\n            mesh.periodic_ζ && (kn_ = ((kn_ - 1) % Nζ + Nζ) % Nζ + 1)\n\n            (in_ < 1 || in_ > Nξ ||\n             jn_ < 1 || jn_ > Nη ||\n             kn_ < 1 || kn_ > Nζ) && continue\n            is_solid[in_, jn_, kn_] || continue\n\n            Xn = FT(mesh.X[in_, jn_, kn_])\n            Yn = FT(mesh.Y[in_, jn_, kn_])\n            Zn = FT(mesh.Z[in_, jn_, kn_])\n\n            dx = Xn - Xf; dy = Yn - Yf; dz = Zn - Zf\n            fx = Xf - cxb; fy = Yf - cyb; fz = Zf - czb\n\n            a = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz\n            b_coeff = FT(2) * (fx * dx + fy * dy + fz * dz)\n            c_coeff = fx * fx + fy * fy + fz * fz - R²\n            disc = b_coeff * b_coeff - FT(4) * a * c_coeff\n\n            if disc < zero(FT)\n                q_wall[i, j, k, q] = FT(0.5)\n            else\n                sd = sqrt(disc)\n                t1 = (-b_coeff - sd) / (FT(2) * a)\n                t2 = (-b_coeff + sd) / (FT(2) * a)\n                t = (t1 > zero(FT) && t1 ≤ one(FT)) ? t1 :\n                    (t2 > zero(FT) && t2 ≤ one(FT)) ? t2 : FT(0.5)\n                q_wall[i, j, k, q] = t\n            end\n        end\n    end\n\n    return q_wall, uw_link_x, uw_link_y, uw_link_z\nend\n```"), (name = :compute_local_omega_3d, signature = "function compute_local_omega_3d(mesh::CurvilinearMesh3D{T};", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    compute_local_omega_3d(mesh; ν, Λ=3/16, scaling=:quadratic)\n        -> (s_plus_field, s_minus_field)\n\nPrecompute per-cell TRT relaxation rates `s_plus[i,j,k]` and\n`s_minus[i,j,k]` on a 3D curvilinear mesh, accounting for the local\ncell-size variation. Returns 3D arrays of size `Nξ × Nη × Nζ`.\n\n`scaling=:quadratic` corresponds to SLBM with a single global Δt\n(τ_local − 0.5 ∝ (Δx_ref/Δx_local)²); `scaling=:linear` is the\nFilippova-Hänel rescaling for grid-refinement-style Δt ∝ Δx.\n\nLocal cell size estimated from the column-norm of the metric:\n`Δx_local = (lξ · lη · lζ)^(1/3)` with `lξ = √(dXdξ² + dYdξ² + dZdξ²) · Δξ`.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    compute_local_omega_3d(mesh; ν, Λ=3/16, scaling=:quadratic)\n        -> (s_plus_field, s_minus_field)\n\nPrecompute per-cell TRT relaxation rates `s_plus[i,j,k]` and\n`s_minus[i,j,k]` on a 3D curvilinear mesh, accounting for the local\ncell-size variation. Returns 3D arrays of size `Nξ × Nη × Nζ`.\n\n`scaling=:quadratic` corresponds to SLBM with a single global Δt\n(τ_local − 0.5 ∝ (Δx_ref/Δx_local)²); `scaling=:linear` is the\nFilippova-Hänel rescaling for grid-refinement-style Δt ∝ Δx.\n\nLocal cell size estimated from the column-norm of the metric:\n`Δx_local = (lξ · lη · lζ)^(1/3)` with `lξ = √(dXdξ² + dYdξ² + dZdξ²) · Δξ`.\n\"\"\"\nfunction compute_local_omega_3d(mesh::CurvilinearMesh3D{T};\n                                  ν::Real, Λ::Real=3/16,\n                                  scaling::Symbol=:quadratic,\n                                  τ_floor::Real=0.5) where {T}\n    Nξ, Nη, Nζ = mesh.Nξ, mesh.Nη, mesh.Nζ\n    denom_ξ = T(mesh.periodic_ξ ? Nξ : Nξ - 1)\n    denom_η = T(mesh.periodic_η ? Nη : Nη - 1)\n    denom_ζ = T(mesh.periodic_ζ ? Nζ : Nζ - 1)\n    Δξ = one(T) / denom_ξ\n    Δη = one(T) / denom_η\n    Δζ = one(T) / denom_ζ\n\n    s_plus_ref, s_minus_ref = trt_rates(ν; Λ=Λ)\n    τ_plus_ref  = one(T) / T(s_plus_ref)\n    τ_minus_ref = one(T) / T(s_minus_ref)\n    τ_lo = T(τ_floor)\n\n    sp = zeros(T, Nξ, Nη, Nζ)\n    sm = zeros(T, Nξ, Nη, Nζ)\n\n    @inbounds for k in 1:Nζ, j in 1:Nη, i in 1:Nξ\n        lξ = sqrt(mesh.dXdξ[i,j,k]^2 + mesh.dYdξ[i,j,k]^2 + mesh.dZdξ[i,j,k]^2) * Δξ\n        lη = sqrt(mesh.dXdη[i,j,k]^2 + mesh.dYdη[i,j,k]^2 + mesh.dZdη[i,j,k]^2) * Δη\n        lζ = sqrt(mesh.dXdζ[i,j,k]^2 + mesh.dYdζ[i,j,k]^2 + mesh.dZdζ[i,j,k]^2) * Δζ\n        dx_local = cbrt(lξ * lη * lζ)\n\n        if scaling === :quadratic\n            r_inv2 = (mesh.dx_ref / dx_local)^2\n            τ_plus_local  = r_inv2 * (τ_plus_ref  - T(0.5)) + T(0.5)\n            τ_minus_local = r_inv2 * (τ_minus_ref - T(0.5)) + T(0.5)\n        else\n            r = dx_local / mesh.dx_ref\n            τ_plus_local  = r * (τ_plus_ref  - T(0.5)) + T(0.5)\n            τ_minus_local = r * (τ_minus_ref - T(0.5)) + T(0.5)\n        end\n        sp[i,j,k] = one(T) / max(τ_plus_local,  τ_lo)\n        sm[i,j,k] = one(T) / max(τ_minus_local, τ_lo)\n    end\n\n    return sp, sm\nend\n```"), (name = :PullSLBM_3D, signature = "struct PullSLBM_3D <: LBMBrick end", docstring = "\"Semi-Lagrangian pull D3Q19: trilinear-interpolate f_in at the precomputed departure points (i_dep[i,j,k,q], j_dep[i,j,k,q], k_dep[i,j,k,q]). Reduces to a plain pull-stream when the mesh is uniform Cartesian (departures land exactly on neighbour nodes).\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"Semi-Lagrangian pull D3Q19: trilinear-interpolate f_in at the precomputed departure points (i_dep[i,j,k,q], j_dep[i,j,k,q], k_dep[i,j,k,q]). Reduces to a plain pull-stream when the mesh is uniform Cartesian (departures land exactly on neighbour nodes).\"\nstruct PullSLBM_3D <: LBMBrick end\n```"), (name = :CollideTRTLocalDirect_3D, signature = "struct CollideTRTLocalDirect_3D <: LBMBrick end", docstring = "\"TRT collision on D3Q19 with PER-CELL relaxation rates s_plus[i,j,k], s_minus[i,j,k]. Writes directly to f_out[i,j,k,:]. Used by SLBM 3D on stretched curvilinear meshes (compute_local_omega_3d).\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"TRT collision on D3Q19 with PER-CELL relaxation rates s_plus[i,j,k], s_minus[i,j,k]. Writes directly to f_out[i,j,k,:]. Used by SLBM 3D on stretched curvilinear meshes (compute_local_omega_3d).\"\nstruct CollideTRTLocalDirect_3D <: LBMBrick end\n```"), (name = :load_gmsh_mesh_2d, signature = "function load_gmsh_mesh_2d(path::AbstractString;", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    load_gmsh_mesh_2d(path; surface_tag=nothing, layout=:axis_aligned, FT=Float64)\n        -> (mesh::CurvilinearMesh, groups::GmshPhysicalGroups)\n\nOpen a gmsh `.msh` (or `.geo` followed by `gmsh.model.mesh.generate`) and\nbuild a `CurvilinearMesh` from the nodes of the surface tagged\n`surface_tag` (auto if exactly one surface is present). The mesh must\nhave been generated as a Transfinite quadrangular block.\n\n`layout=:axis_aligned`: sort nodes lex (Y, X) and reshape; works for\nany Transfinite block whose physical layout is axis-aligned.\n\n`layout=:topological`: TODO — edge-walk the connectivity (needed for\nO-grids, where physical X is not monotone in ξ).\n\nReturns the `CurvilinearMesh` and a `GmshPhysicalGroups` struct mapping\nphysical names/tags to the geo entities the user can assign to BCSpec\nfaces.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    load_gmsh_mesh_2d(path; surface_tag=nothing, layout=:axis_aligned, FT=Float64)\n        -> (mesh::CurvilinearMesh, groups::GmshPhysicalGroups)\n\nOpen a gmsh `.msh` (or `.geo` followed by `gmsh.model.mesh.generate`) and\nbuild a `CurvilinearMesh` from the nodes of the surface tagged\n`surface_tag` (auto if exactly one surface is present). The mesh must\nhave been generated as a Transfinite quadrangular block.\n\n`layout=:axis_aligned`: sort nodes lex (Y, X) and reshape; works for\nany Transfinite block whose physical layout is axis-aligned.\n\n`layout=:topological`: TODO — edge-walk the connectivity (needed for\nO-grids, where physical X is not monotone in ξ).\n\nReturns the `CurvilinearMesh` and a `GmshPhysicalGroups` struct mapping\nphysical names/tags to the geo entities the user can assign to BCSpec\nfaces.\n\"\"\"\nfunction load_gmsh_mesh_2d(path::AbstractString;\n                            surface_tag::Union{Int, Nothing}=nothing,\n                            layout::Symbol=:axis_aligned,\n                            periodic_ξ::Bool=false, periodic_η::Bool=false,\n                            FT::Type{<:AbstractFloat}=Float64)\n    gmsh.initialize()\n    try\n        gmsh.option.setNumber(\"General.Terminal\", 0)\n        if endswith(lowercase(path), \".geo\")\n            gmsh.open(path)\n            gmsh.model.mesh.generate(2)\n        else\n            gmsh.open(path)\n        end\n        return _load_2d_open(; surface_tag=surface_tag, layout=layout,\n                             periodic_ξ=periodic_ξ, periodic_η=periodic_η, FT=FT)\n    finally\n        gmsh.finalize()\n    end\nend\n```"), (name = :load_gmsh_mesh_3d, signature = "function load_gmsh_mesh_3d(path::AbstractString;", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    load_gmsh_mesh_3d(path; volume_tag=nothing, layout=:axis_aligned, FT=Float64)\n        -> (mesh::CurvilinearMesh3D, groups::GmshPhysicalGroups)\n\n3D counterpart. Same Phase A axis-aligned layout: lex sort on (z, y, x)\nthen reshape to `(Nξ, Nη, Nζ)`.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    load_gmsh_mesh_3d(path; volume_tag=nothing, layout=:axis_aligned, FT=Float64)\n        -> (mesh::CurvilinearMesh3D, groups::GmshPhysicalGroups)\n\n3D counterpart. Same Phase A axis-aligned layout: lex sort on (z, y, x)\nthen reshape to `(Nξ, Nη, Nζ)`.\n\"\"\"\nfunction load_gmsh_mesh_3d(path::AbstractString;\n                            volume_tag::Union{Int, Nothing}=nothing,\n                            layout::Symbol=:axis_aligned,\n                            periodic_ξ::Bool=false, periodic_η::Bool=false,\n                            periodic_ζ::Bool=false,\n                            FT::Type{<:AbstractFloat}=Float64)\n    gmsh.initialize()\n    try\n        gmsh.option.setNumber(\"General.Terminal\", 0)\n        if endswith(lowercase(path), \".geo\")\n            gmsh.open(path)\n            gmsh.model.mesh.generate(3)\n        else\n            gmsh.open(path)\n        end\n        return _load_3d_open(; volume_tag=volume_tag, layout=layout,\n                             periodic_ξ=periodic_ξ, periodic_η=periodic_η,\n                             periodic_ζ=periodic_ζ, FT=FT)\n    finally\n        gmsh.finalize()\n    end\nend\n```"), (name = :GmshPhysicalGroups, signature = "struct GmshPhysicalGroups", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    GmshPhysicalGroups\n\nPer-tag mapping returned alongside a mesh: `name => tag` for each Physical\ngroup, and `tag => geo_entities` (the ξ/η/ζ entity ids the user can match\nto a face of the structured block).\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    GmshPhysicalGroups\n\nPer-tag mapping returned alongside a mesh: `name => tag` for each Physical\ngroup, and `tag => geo_entities` (the ξ/η/ζ entity ids the user can match\nto a face of the structured block).\n\"\"\"\nstruct GmshPhysicalGroups\n    by_name::Dict{String, Int}              # name → physical tag\n    by_tag::Dict{Int, Vector{Int}}          # physical tag → geo entities\n    dim::Dict{Int, Int}                     # physical tag → topological dim\nend\n```"), (name = :Block, signature = "struct Block{T<:AbstractFloat, AT}", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    Block{T, AT}\n\nOne structured block in a multi-block mesh. Wraps:\n\n- `id::Symbol`       — unique name used to reference this block in\n                       interface declarations and diagnostics. The\n                       sanity check rejects duplicates.\n- `mesh::CurvilinearMesh{T, AT}` — the logical `Nξ × Nη` grid and its\n                       metric. Any Kraken-compatible curvilinear mesh\n                       works (uniform Cartesian, polar, gmsh-imported).\n- `boundary_tags::NamedTuple` — four keys `(:west, :east, :south, :north)`,\n                       each mapped to a `Symbol` that is either a\n                       physical BC name or `INTERFACE_TAG`. A block\n                       that touches nothing has no `:interface` tag;\n                       a block with all four edges interior has all\n                       four tags equal to `INTERFACE_TAG`.\n\nConstruct with `Block(id, mesh; west=..., east=..., south=..., north=...)`;\nthe kwarg form enforces that the four edges are always named explicitly\nso there is no silent default.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    Block{T, AT}\n\nOne structured block in a multi-block mesh. Wraps:\n\n- `id::Symbol`       — unique name used to reference this block in\n                       interface declarations and diagnostics. The\n                       sanity check rejects duplicates.\n- `mesh::CurvilinearMesh{T, AT}` — the logical `Nξ × Nη` grid and its\n                       metric. Any Kraken-compatible curvilinear mesh\n                       works (uniform Cartesian, polar, gmsh-imported).\n- `boundary_tags::NamedTuple` — four keys `(:west, :east, :south, :north)`,\n                       each mapped to a `Symbol` that is either a\n                       physical BC name or `INTERFACE_TAG`. A block\n                       that touches nothing has no `:interface` tag;\n                       a block with all four edges interior has all\n                       four tags equal to `INTERFACE_TAG`.\n\nConstruct with `Block(id, mesh; west=..., east=..., south=..., north=...)`;\nthe kwarg form enforces that the four edges are always named explicitly\nso there is no silent default.\n\"\"\"\nstruct Block{T<:AbstractFloat, AT}\n    id::Symbol\n    mesh::CurvilinearMesh{T, AT}\n    boundary_tags::NamedTuple{(:west, :east, :south, :north), NTuple{4, Symbol}}\nend\n```"), (name = :Interface, signature = "struct Interface", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    Interface(from=(:block_a, :east), to=(:block_b, :west))\n\nDeclares that edge `east` of block `:block_a` is stitched to edge\n`west` of block `:block_b`. MVP enforces:\n\n- both edges have the same length in lattice units (Nξ or Nη match);\n- both tags in the corresponding `boundary_tags` are `INTERFACE_TAG`;\n- the local cell metric on the two edges is \"consistent\" — same dx\n  within a tolerance, same physical coordinates at the shared edge.\n\nOrientation: MVP supports only the trivial case where the two edges\nrun in the same local direction so the copy is index-aligned. Non-\ntrivial orientations (flip, 90° rotation) are tracked as a follow-up.\n\nBoth `from` and `to` endpoints are stored as 2-tuples `(block_id, edge_symbol)`.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    Interface(from=(:block_a, :east), to=(:block_b, :west))\n\nDeclares that edge `east` of block `:block_a` is stitched to edge\n`west` of block `:block_b`. MVP enforces:\n\n- both edges have the same length in lattice units (Nξ or Nη match);\n- both tags in the corresponding `boundary_tags` are `INTERFACE_TAG`;\n- the local cell metric on the two edges is \"consistent\" — same dx\n  within a tolerance, same physical coordinates at the shared edge.\n\nOrientation: MVP supports only the trivial case where the two edges\nrun in the same local direction so the copy is index-aligned. Non-\ntrivial orientations (flip, 90° rotation) are tracked as a follow-up.\n\nBoth `from` and `to` endpoints are stored as 2-tuples `(block_id, edge_symbol)`.\n\"\"\"\nstruct Interface\n    from::Tuple{Symbol, Symbol}\n    to::Tuple{Symbol, Symbol}\nend\n```"), (name = :MultiBlockMesh2D, signature = "struct MultiBlockMesh2D{T<:AbstractFloat, AT}", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    MultiBlockMesh2D{T, AT}\n\nA flat collection of `Block`s + a flat list of `Interface`s. Carries a\nprecomputed `block_by_id::Dict{Symbol, Int}` so the rest of the solver\ncan look up blocks by name in O(1) without scanning the vector on\nevery kernel call.\n\nConstructor: `MultiBlockMesh2D(blocks; interfaces=Interface[])`. Does\nNOT run sanity checks at construction — call `sanity_check_multiblock`\nexplicitly before launching a simulation (matches the v0.2 pattern in\n`src/sanity_check.jl`).\n\nThe type parameters `T, AT` are inherited from the first block; the\nsanity check verifies that all blocks share the same element type so\nthe kernels can run in one homogeneous compiled path.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    MultiBlockMesh2D{T, AT}\n\nA flat collection of `Block`s + a flat list of `Interface`s. Carries a\nprecomputed `block_by_id::Dict{Symbol, Int}` so the rest of the solver\ncan look up blocks by name in O(1) without scanning the vector on\nevery kernel call.\n\nConstructor: `MultiBlockMesh2D(blocks; interfaces=Interface[])`. Does\nNOT run sanity checks at construction — call `sanity_check_multiblock`\nexplicitly before launching a simulation (matches the v0.2 pattern in\n`src/sanity_check.jl`).\n\nThe type parameters `T, AT` are inherited from the first block; the\nsanity check verifies that all blocks share the same element type so\nthe kernels can run in one homogeneous compiled path.\n\"\"\"\nstruct MultiBlockMesh2D{T<:AbstractFloat, AT}\n    blocks::Vector{Block{T, AT}}\n    interfaces::Vector{Interface}\n    block_by_id::Dict{Symbol, Int}\nend\n```"), (name = :EDGE_SYMBOLS_2D, signature = "", docstring = "", source_excerpt = ""), (name = :INTERFACE_TAG, signature = "", docstring = "", source_excerpt = ""), (name = :getblock, signature = "function getblock(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D, id::Symbol)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    getblock(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D, id::Symbol) -> Block\n\nLook up a block by its `id`. Throws a `KeyError` with a list of valid\nids if the id is not found (so a typo in an `Interface` declaration is\ncaught with a useful message instead of a silent hash miss).\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    getblock(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D, id::Symbol) -> Block\n\nLook up a block by its `id`. Throws a `KeyError` with a list of valid\nids if the id is not found (so a typo in an `Interface` declaration is\ncaught with a useful message instead of a silent hash miss).\n\"\"\"\nfunction getblock(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D, id::Symbol)\n    idx = get(mbm.block_by_id, id, 0)\n    idx == 0 && throw(KeyError(\"block id \$id not found; known ids = \$(keys(mbm.block_by_id))\"))\n    return mbm.blocks[idx]\nend\n```"), (name = :edge_length, signature = "function edge_length(block::Block, edge::Symbol)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    edge_length(block::Block, edge::Symbol) -> Int\n\nNumber of nodes along `edge`. Returns `block.mesh.Nη` for west/east\n(the edge runs along η) and `block.mesh.Nξ` for south/north (the edge\nruns along ξ). Throws on an unknown edge symbol.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    edge_length(block::Block, edge::Symbol) -> Int\n\nNumber of nodes along `edge`. Returns `block.mesh.Nη` for west/east\n(the edge runs along η) and `block.mesh.Nξ` for south/north (the edge\nruns along ξ). Throws on an unknown edge symbol.\n\"\"\"\nfunction edge_length(block::Block, edge::Symbol)\n    if edge === :west || edge === :east\n        return block.mesh.Nη\n    elseif edge === :south || edge === :north\n        return block.mesh.Nξ\n    else\n        error(\"edge_length: unknown edge \$edge; valid = \$EDGE_SYMBOLS_2D\")\n    end\nend\n```"), (name = :edge_coords, signature = "function edge_coords(block::Block, edge::Symbol)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    edge_coords(block::Block, edge::Symbol) -> (xs, ys)\n\nPhysical `(X, Y)` coordinates of the nodes lying on `edge`, in the\ndirection the edge is naturally parameterised (west/east along j,\nsouth/north along i). Used by the sanity check to verify that two\ninterface edges are physically colocated.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    edge_coords(block::Block, edge::Symbol) -> (xs, ys)\n\nPhysical `(X, Y)` coordinates of the nodes lying on `edge`, in the\ndirection the edge is naturally parameterised (west/east along j,\nsouth/north along i). Used by the sanity check to verify that two\ninterface edges are physically colocated.\n\"\"\"\nfunction edge_coords(block::Block, edge::Symbol)\n    mesh = block.mesh\n    if edge === :west\n        xs = [mesh.X[1, j] for j in 1:mesh.Nη]\n        ys = [mesh.Y[1, j] for j in 1:mesh.Nη]\n    elseif edge === :east\n        xs = [mesh.X[mesh.Nξ, j] for j in 1:mesh.Nη]\n        ys = [mesh.Y[mesh.Nξ, j] for j in 1:mesh.Nη]\n    elseif edge === :south\n        xs = [mesh.X[i, 1] for i in 1:mesh.Nξ]\n        ys = [mesh.Y[i, 1] for i in 1:mesh.Nξ]\n    elseif edge === :north\n        xs = [mesh.X[i, mesh.Nη] for i in 1:mesh.Nξ]\n        ys = [mesh.Y[i, mesh.Nη] for i in 1:mesh.Nξ]\n    else\n        error(\"edge_coords: unknown edge \$edge\")\n    end\n    return xs, ys\nend\n```"), (name = :MultiBlockSanityIssue, signature = "struct MultiBlockSanityIssue", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    MultiBlockSanityIssue(severity::Symbol, code::Symbol, block_id::Union{Symbol,Nothing},\n                          edge::Union{Symbol,Nothing}, message::String)\n\nOne invariant violation reported by `sanity_check_multiblock`.\n\n- `severity`: `:error` (must fix before running) or `:warning`\n- `code`: short symbol identifying the check family\n- `block_id`, `edge`: locate the offence, `nothing` if global\n- `message`: human-readable detail\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    MultiBlockSanityIssue(severity::Symbol, code::Symbol, block_id::Union{Symbol,Nothing},\n                          edge::Union{Symbol,Nothing}, message::String)\n\nOne invariant violation reported by `sanity_check_multiblock`.\n\n- `severity`: `:error` (must fix before running) or `:warning`\n- `code`: short symbol identifying the check family\n- `block_id`, `edge`: locate the offence, `nothing` if global\n- `message`: human-readable detail\n\"\"\"\nstruct MultiBlockSanityIssue\n    severity::Symbol\n    code::Symbol\n    block_id::Union{Symbol, Nothing}\n    edge::Union{Symbol, Nothing}\n    message::String\nend\n```"), (name = :sanity_check_multiblock, signature = "function sanity_check_multiblock(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D;", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    sanity_check_multiblock(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D; tol=1e-9, verbose=true)\n        -> Vector{MultiBlockSanityIssue}\n\nRun all invariants on `mbm` and return the collected issues. If\n`verbose=true` each issue is printed as it is found. The caller\ndecides how to react:\n\n```julia\nissues = sanity_check_multiblock(mbm)\nany(iss -> iss.severity === :error, issues) &&\n    error(\"multi-block mesh has \\\$(length(issues)) validation issues\")\n```\n\n`tol` is the absolute coordinate tolerance used by the colocation\ncheck (`InterfaceEdgesColocated`).\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    sanity_check_multiblock(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D; tol=1e-9, verbose=true)\n        -> Vector{MultiBlockSanityIssue}\n\nRun all invariants on `mbm` and return the collected issues. If\n`verbose=true` each issue is printed as it is found. The caller\ndecides how to react:\n\n```julia\nissues = sanity_check_multiblock(mbm)\nany(iss -> iss.severity === :error, issues) &&\n    error(\"multi-block mesh has \\\$(length(issues)) validation issues\")\n```\n\n`tol` is the absolute coordinate tolerance used by the colocation\ncheck (`InterfaceEdgesColocated`).\n\"\"\"\nfunction sanity_check_multiblock(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D;\n                                  tol::Real=1e-9, verbose::Bool=true)\n    issues = MultiBlockSanityIssue[]\n    _check_no_duplicate_block_ids!(issues, mbm)\n    _check_edge_tags_known!(issues, mbm)\n    _check_uniform_element_type!(issues, mbm)\n    _check_interface_refs_exist!(issues, mbm)\n    _check_interface_both_edges_marked!(issues, mbm)\n    _check_interface_edges_same_length!(issues, mbm)\n    _check_interface_edges_colocated!(issues, mbm; tol=tol)\n    _check_interface_orientation_trivial!(issues, mbm; tol=tol)\n    _check_every_marked_edge_used!(issues, mbm)\n    if verbose\n        for iss in issues\n            println(iss)\n        end\n        if isempty(issues)\n            println(\"sanity_check_multiblock: OK (\$(length(mbm.blocks)) blocks, \$(length(mbm.interfaces)) interfaces)\")\n        end\n    end\n    return issues\nend\n```"), (name = :BlockState2D, signature = "mutable struct BlockState2D{T<:AbstractFloat, AT3<:AbstractArray{T, 3}, AT2<:AbstractArray{T, 2}}", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    BlockState2D{T, AT3, AT2}\n\nRuntime state for one block in a multi-block simulation. Stores the\npopulations and macroscopic fields on an EXTENDED grid that includes\n`n_ghost` cells on every side. The physical interior is a view over\n`(n_ghost + 1 .. n_ghost + Nξ_phys, n_ghost + 1 .. n_ghost + Nη_phys)`.\n\nFields\n------\n- `f::AT3`           — populations, size `(Nξ_ext, Nη_ext, 9)`\n- `ρ::AT2`, `ux::AT2`, `uy::AT2` — macroscopic fields, `(Nξ_ext, Nη_ext)`\n- `Nξ_phys, Nη_phys::Int`   — physical grid dimensions\n- `n_ghost::Int`            — ghost-layer width (1 for D2Q9, 2 for higher stencils)\n\nAllocate via `allocate_block_state_2d(block; n_ghost=1, backend=CPU())`.\nThe allocator initialises `ρ ≡ 1`, `ux = uy ≡ 0`, `f = 0` (caller is\nexpected to overwrite `f` with equilibrium before the first step).\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    BlockState2D{T, AT3, AT2}\n\nRuntime state for one block in a multi-block simulation. Stores the\npopulations and macroscopic fields on an EXTENDED grid that includes\n`n_ghost` cells on every side. The physical interior is a view over\n`(n_ghost + 1 .. n_ghost + Nξ_phys, n_ghost + 1 .. n_ghost + Nη_phys)`.\n\nFields\n------\n- `f::AT3`           — populations, size `(Nξ_ext, Nη_ext, 9)`\n- `ρ::AT2`, `ux::AT2`, `uy::AT2` — macroscopic fields, `(Nξ_ext, Nη_ext)`\n- `Nξ_phys, Nη_phys::Int`   — physical grid dimensions\n- `n_ghost::Int`            — ghost-layer width (1 for D2Q9, 2 for higher stencils)\n\nAllocate via `allocate_block_state_2d(block; n_ghost=1, backend=CPU())`.\nThe allocator initialises `ρ ≡ 1`, `ux = uy ≡ 0`, `f = 0` (caller is\nexpected to overwrite `f` with equilibrium before the first step).\n\"\"\"\nmutable struct BlockState2D{T<:AbstractFloat, AT3<:AbstractArray{T, 3}, AT2<:AbstractArray{T, 2}}\n    f::AT3\n    ρ::AT2\n    ux::AT2\n    uy::AT2\n    const Nξ_phys::Int\n    const Nη_phys::Int\n    const n_ghost::Int\nend\n```"), (name = :allocate_block_state_2d, signature = "function allocate_block_state_2d(block::Block{T, AT2}; n_ghost=1,\n                             backend=KernelAbstractions.CPU()) -> BlockState2D\n\nAllocate f / ρ / ux / uy of the extended size (Nξ_phys + 2·n_ghost) ×\n(Nη_phys + 2·n_ghost). `ρ` initialised to 1, velocities to 0, `f` to 0\n(caller seeds equilibrium before the first step).\n\"\"\"\nfunction allocate_block_state_2d(block::Block{T, AT2}; fill!(f,  zero(T))\n    ρ  = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, Nx_ext, Ny_ext);    fill!(ρ,  one(T))\n    ux = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, Nx_ext, Ny_ext);    fill!(ux, zero(T))\n    uy = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, Nx_ext, Ny_ext);    fill!(uy, zero(T))\n    return BlockState2D{T, typeof(f), typeof(ρ)}(f, ρ, ux, uy,\n                                                   block.mesh.Nξ, block.mesh.Nη, n_ghost)\nend\n```"), (name = :interior_f, signature = "", docstring = "", source_excerpt = ""), (name = :interior_macro, signature = "", docstring = "", source_excerpt = ""), (name = :ext_dims, signature = "", docstring = "", source_excerpt = ""), (name = :exchange_ghost_2d!, signature = "function exchange_ghost_2d!(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    exchange_ghost_2d!(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D,\n                        states::AbstractVector{<:BlockState2D})\n\nFill the ghost rows of each block's `state.f` from the physical\ninterior of its neighbour across every declared interface. Must be\ncalled BEFORE the step kernel (reads `state.f` as `f_in`).\n\nPrecondition: all blocks share the same `n_ghost`.\n\nCall sequence per timestep:\n\n    exchange_ghost_2d!(mbm, states)                   # fill ghosts\n    for (k, blk) in enumerate(mbm.blocks)\n        Nx_ext, Ny_ext = ext_dims(states[k])\n        fused_bgk_step!(f_out[k], states[k].f, ...,   # step on extended size\n                          states[k].ρ, states[k].ux, states[k].uy,\n                          is_solid_ext[k], Nx_ext, Ny_ext, ω)\n    end\n    for (k, blk) in enumerate(mbm.blocks)\n        apply_bc_rebuild_2d!(interior_f(f_out[k]),    # physical BCs on interior view\n                              interior_f(states[k].f), bcspec[k], ν,\n                              states[k].Nξ_phys, states[k].Nη_phys)\n    end\n    # swap states[k].f ↔ f_out[k]  (handled by caller)\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    exchange_ghost_2d!(mbm::MultiBlockMesh2D,\n                        states::AbstractVector{<:BlockState2D})\n\nFill the ghost rows of each block's `state.f` from the physical\ninterior of its neighbour across every declared interface. fill ghosts\n    for (k, blk) in enumerate(mbm.blocks)\n        Nx_ext, Ny_ext = ext_dims(states[k])\n        fused_bgk_step!(f_out[k], states[k].f, ...,   # step on extended size\n                          states[k].ρ, states[k].ux, states[k].uy,\n                          is_solid_ext[k], Nx_ext, Ny_ext, ω)\n    end\n    for (k, blk) in enumerate(mbm.blocks)\n        apply_bc_rebuild_2d!(interior_f(f_out[k]),    #
