N=64, ν=0.01, u0=0.01, backend, T)\n\nInitialize populations to equilibrium with Taylor-Green velocity field.\n\"\"\"\nfunction initialize_taylor_green_2d(; N=64, nu=nothing, ν=0.01, u0=0.01,\n                                     backend=KernelAbstractions.CPU(), T=Float64)\n    !isnothing(nu) && (ν = nu)\n    config = LBMConfig(D2Q9(); Nx=N, Ny=N, ν=ν, u_lid=0.0, max_steps=0)\n    Nx, Ny = N, N\n    k = T(2π / N)\n\n    f_in  = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    f_out = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    ρ_arr = KernelAbstractions.ones(backend, T, Nx, Ny)\n    ux    = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, Nx, Ny)\n    uy    = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, T, Nx, Ny)\n    is_solid = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, Bool, Nx, Ny)\n\n    w = weights(D2Q9())\n    f_cpu = zeros(T, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    for j in 1:Ny, i in 1:Nx\n        x = T(i - 1)\n        y = T(j - 1)\n        ux_tg = -T(u0) * cos(k * x) * sin(k * y)\n        uy_tg =  T(u0) * sin(k * x) * cos(k * y)\n        ρ_tg = one(T) - T(3) * T(u0)^2 / T(4) * (cos(T(2) * k * x) + cos(T(2) * k * y))\n        for q in 1:9\n            f_cpu[i, j, q] = equilibrium(D2Q9(), ρ_tg, ux_tg, uy_tg, q)\n        end\n    end\n    copyto!(f_in, f_cpu)\n    copyto!(f_out, f_cpu)\n\n    return (f_in=f_in, f_out=f_out, ρ=ρ_arr, ux=ux, uy=uy, is_solid=is_solid,\n            config=config, u0=u0, k=k)\nend\n```"), (name = :run_taylor_green_2d, signature = "function run_taylor_green_2d(; N=64, nu=nothing, ν=0.01, u0=0.01, max_steps=1000,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    run_taylor_green_2d(; N=64, ν=0.01, u0=0.01, max_steps=1000, backend, T)\n\nTaylor-Green vortex decay in a fully periodic domain.\nReturns final macroscopic fields.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    run_taylor_green_2d(; N=64, ν=0.01, u0=0.01, max_steps=1000, backend, T)\n\nTaylor-Green vortex decay in a fully periodic domain.\nReturns final macroscopic fields.\n\"\"\"\nfunction run_taylor_green_2d(; N=64, nu=nothing, ν=0.01, u0=0.01, max_steps=1000,\n                              backend=KernelAbstractions.CPU(), T=Float64)\n    !isnothing(nu) && (ν = nu)\n    state = initialize_taylor_green_2d(; N=N, ν=ν, u0=u0, backend=backend, T=T)\n    f_in, f_out = state.f_in, state.f_out\n    ρ, ux, uy = state.ρ, state.ux, state.uy\n    is_solid = state.is_solid\n    ω = T(1.0 / (3.0 * ν + 0.5))\n\n    for step in 1:max_steps\n        stream_fully_periodic_2d!(f_out, f_in, N, N)\n        collide_2d!(f_out, is_solid, ω)\n        f_in, f_out = f_out, f_in\n    end\n\n    compute_macroscopic_2d!(ρ, ux, uy, f_in)\n    return (ρ=Array(ρ), ux=Array(ux), uy=Array(uy),\n            config=state.config, u0=u0, k=state.k, max_steps=max_steps)\nend\n```"), (name = :initialize_cylinder_2d, signature = "function initialize_cylinder_2d(; Nx=200, Ny=50, cx=nothing, cy=nothing, radius=10,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    initialize_cylinder_2d(; Nx=200, Ny=50, cx=Nx÷4, cy=Ny÷2, radius=10,\n                            u_in=0.05, ν=0.05, backend, T)\n\nInitialize a channel with a circular cylinder obstacle.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    initialize_cylinder_2d(; Nx=200, Ny=50, cx=Nx÷4, cy=Ny÷2, radius=10,\n                            u_in=0.05, ν=0.05, backend, T)\n\nInitialize a channel with a circular cylinder obstacle.\n\"\"\"\nfunction initialize_cylinder_2d(; Nx=200, Ny=50, cx=nothing, cy=nothing, radius=10,\n                                 u_in=0.05, nu=nothing, ν=0.05,\n                                 backend=KernelAbstractions.CPU(), T=Float64)\n    !isnothing(nu) && (ν = nu)\n    cx = isnothing(cx) ? Nx ÷ 4 : cx\n    cy = isnothing(cy) ? Ny ÷ 2 : cy\n    config = LBMConfig(D2Q9(); Nx=Nx, Ny=Ny, ν=ν, u_lid=0.0, max_steps=0)\n    state = initialize_2d(config, T; backend=backend)\n\n    # Set cylinder as solid\n    solid_cpu = zeros(Bool, Nx, Ny)\n    for j in 1:Ny, i in 1:Nx\n        if (i - cx)^2 + (j - cy)^2 <= radius^2\n            solid_cpu[i, j] = true\n        end\n    end\n    copyto!(state.is_solid, solid_cpu)\n\n    # Initialize to equilibrium with uniform inflow velocity\n    w = weights(D2Q9())\n    f_cpu = zeros(T, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    for j in 1:Ny, i in 1:Nx\n        for q in 1:9\n            f_cpu[i, j, q] = equilibrium(D2Q9(), one(T), T(u_in), zero(T), q)\n        end\n    end\n    copyto!(state.f_in, f_cpu)\n    copyto!(state.f_out, f_cpu)\n\n    return state, config\nend\n```"), (name = :run_cylinder_2d, signature = "function run_cylinder_2d(; Nx=200, Ny=50, cx=nothing, cy=nothing, radius=10,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    run_cylinder_2d(; Nx=200, Ny=50, radius=10, u_in=0.05, ν=0.05,\n                     max_steps=20000, backend, T)\n\nFlow around a cylinder at Re = u_in * 2*radius / ν.\nDrag computed via momentum exchange on post-stream populations, averaged\nover last `avg_window` steps.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    run_cylinder_2d(; Nx=200, Ny=50, radius=10, u_in=0.05, ν=0.05,\n                     max_steps=20000, backend, T)\n\nFlow around a cylinder at Re = u_in * 2*radius / ν.\nDrag computed via momentum exchange on post-stream populations, averaged\nover last `avg_window` steps.\n\"\"\"\nfunction run_cylinder_2d(; Nx=200, Ny=50, cx=nothing, cy=nothing, radius=10,\n                          u_in=0.05, nu=nothing, ν=0.05, max_steps=20000, avg_window=1000,\n                          backend=KernelAbstractions.CPU(), T=Float64)\n    !isnothing(nu) && (ν = nu)\n    state, config = initialize_cylinder_2d(; Nx=Nx, Ny=Ny, cx=cx, cy=cy,\n                                            radius=radius, u_in=u_in, ν=ν,\n                                            backend=backend, T=T)\n    f_in, f_out = state.f_in, state.f_out\n    ρ, ux, uy = state.ρ, state.ux, state.uy\n    is_solid = state.is_solid\n    ω = T(omega(config))\n\n    Fx_sum = 0.0\n    Fy_sum = 0.0\n    n_avg = 0\n\n    for step in 1:max_steps\n        # 1. Stream (f_in = pre-stream, f_out = post-stream)\n        stream_2d!(f_out, f_in, Nx, Ny)\n\n        # 2. BCs\n        apply_zou_he_west_2d!(f_out, u_in, Nx, Ny)\n        apply_zou_he_pressure_east_2d!(f_out, Nx, Ny)\n\n        # 3. MEA drag: f_pre=f_in (pre-stream), f_post=f_out (post-stream+BCs)\n        if step > max_steps - avg_window\n            drag = compute_drag_mea_2d(f_in, f_out, is_solid, Nx, Ny)\n            Fx_sum += drag.Fx\n            Fy_sum += drag.Fy\n            n_avg += 1\n        end\n\n        # 4. Collide\n        collide_2d!(f_out, is_solid, ω)\n\n        # 5. Macroscopic + swap\n        compute_macroscopic_2d!(ρ, ux, uy, f_out)\n        f_in, f_out = f_out, f_in\n    end\n\n    Fx_avg = Fx_sum / n_avg\n    Fy_avg = Fy_sum / n_avg\n    D = 2 * radius\n    Cd = 2.0 * Fx_avg / (1.0 * u_in^2 * D)\n\n    return (ρ=Array(ρ), ux=Array(ux), uy=Array(uy), config=config,\n            Cd=Cd, Fx=Fx_avg, Fy=Fy_avg)\nend\n```"), (name = :compute_drag_mea_2d, signature = "function compute_drag_mea_2d(f_pre, f_post, is_solid, Nx, Ny)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    compute_drag_mea_2d(f_pre, f_post, is_solid, Nx, Ny)\n\nCompute drag and lift via two-time-level momentum exchange:\n- `f_pre`: populations BEFORE streaming (= post-collision from previous step)\n- `f_post`: populations AFTER streaming + BCs (= pre-collision current step)\n\nThe force on the solid for each boundary link q from fluid to solid is:\n  F = c_q · f_q(pre-stream) + c_q · f_q̄(post-stream)\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    compute_drag_mea_2d(f_pre, f_post, is_solid, Nx, Ny)\n\nCompute drag and lift via two-time-level momentum exchange:\n- `f_pre`: populations BEFORE streaming (= post-collision from previous step)\n- `f_post`: populations AFTER streaming + BCs (= pre-collision current step)\n\nThe force on the solid for each boundary link q from fluid to solid is:\n  F = c_q · f_q(pre-stream) + c_q · f_q̄(post-stream)\n\"\"\"\nfunction compute_drag_mea_2d(f_pre, f_post, is_solid, Nx, Ny)\n    fpre = Array(f_pre)\n    fpost = Array(f_post)\n    solid = Array(is_solid)\n    cxv = [0, 1, 0, -1,  0, 1, -1, -1,  1]\n    cyv = [0, 0, 1,  0, -1, 1,  1, -1, -1]\n    opp = [1, 4, 5, 2, 3, 8, 9, 6, 7]\n\n    Fx_total = 0.0\n    Fy_total = 0.0\n\n    for j in 1:Ny, i in 1:Nx\n        if !solid[i, j]\n            for q in 2:9\n                ni = i + cxv[q]\n                nj = j + cyv[q]\n                if 1 <= ni <= Nx && 1 <= nj <= Ny && solid[ni, nj]\n                    oq = opp[q]\n                    # f_q(pre-stream): population about to leave fluid toward solid\n                    # f_opp(post-stream): population that just bounced back from solid\n                    Fx_total += Float64(cxv[q]) * (fpre[i, j, q] + fpost[i, j, oq])\n                    Fy_total += Float64(cyv[q]) * (fpre[i, j, q] + fpost[i, j, oq])\n                end\n            end\n        end\n    end\n\n    return (Fx=Fx_total, Fy=Fy_total)\nend\n```"), (name = :run_cylinder_libb_2d, signature = "function run_cylinder_libb_2d(; Nx::Int=300, Ny::Int=80,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    run_cylinder_libb_2d(; Nx=300, Ny=80, cx=Nx÷4, cy=Ny÷2, radius=10,\n                          u_in=0.04, ν=0.04, max_steps=50000,\n                          avg_window=5000, inlet=:parabolic, ρ_out=1.0)\n\n2D cylinder with LI-BB V2 boundary condition. Parabolic / uniform\nZou-He velocity inlet, Zou-He pressure outlet; both reconstructed from\npre-step populations to bypass the kernel's halfway-BB fallback\ncorruption at the non-wall boundaries. Top / bottom channel walls are\nhalfway-BB via the kernel's fallback at j=1 and j=Ny.\n\nArguments:\n- `u_in`: centerline u_max for `:parabolic` inlet; uniform u for `:uniform`.\n- `inlet`: `:parabolic` (Schäfer-Turek 2D convention) or `:uniform`.\n- `ρ_out`: outlet density for the Zou-He pressure BC (default 1).\n\nReturns a NamedTuple with:\n- `ρ`, `ux`, `uy`, `is_solid`, `q_wall`, `u_ref`, `D`, `Fx`, `Fy`\n- `Cd = 2·Fx / (u_ref² · D)` with `u_ref = u_mean = 2/3 · u_max`\n  (parabolic) or `u_ref = u_in` (uniform).\n- `Cl` analogously.\n\nReference for Schäfer-Turek 2D-1 (Re=20, blockage ≈ 25%): Cd ≈ 5.58.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    run_cylinder_libb_2d(; Nx=300, Ny=80, cx=Nx÷4, cy=Ny÷2, radius=10,\n                          u_in=0.04, ν=0.04, max_steps=50000,\n                          avg_window=5000, inlet=:parabolic, ρ_out=1.0)\n\n2D cylinder with LI-BB V2 boundary condition. Parabolic / uniform\nZou-He velocity inlet, Zou-He pressure outlet; both reconstructed from\npre-step populations to bypass the kernel's halfway-BB fallback\ncorruption at the non-wall boundaries. Top / bottom channel walls are\nhalfway-BB via the kernel's fallback at j=1 and j=Ny.\n\nArguments:\n- `u_in`: centerline u_max for `:parabolic` inlet; uniform u for `:uniform`.\n- `inlet`: `:parabolic` (Schäfer-Turek 2D convention) or `:uniform`.\n- `ρ_out`: outlet density for the Zou-He pressure BC (default 1).\n\nReturns a NamedTuple with:\n- `ρ`, `ux`, `uy`, `is_solid`, `q_wall`, `u_ref`, `D`, `Fx`, `Fy`\n- `Cd = 2·Fx / (u_ref² · D)` with `u_ref = u_mean = 2/3 · u_max`\n  (parabolic) or `u_ref = u_in` (uniform).\n- `Cl` analogously.\n\nReference for Schäfer-Turek 2D-1 (Re=20, blockage ≈ 25%): Cd ≈ 5.58.\n\"\"\"\nfunction run_cylinder_libb_2d(; Nx::Int=300, Ny::Int=80,\n                                cx::Union{Nothing,Real}=nothing,\n                                cy::Union{Nothing,Real}=nothing,\n                                radius::Real=10,\n                                u_in::Real=0.04, ν::Real=0.04,\n                                max_steps::Int=50_000,\n                                avg_window::Int=5_000,\n                                inlet::Symbol=:parabolic,\n                                ρ_out::Real=1.0,\n                                backend=KernelAbstractions.CPU(),\n                                T::Type{<:AbstractFloat}=Float64)\n    cx = isnothing(cx) ? Nx ÷ 4 : Float64(cx)\n    cy = isnothing(cy) ? Ny ÷ 2 : Float64(cy)\n\n    q_wall_h, is_solid_h = precompute_q_wall_cylinder(Nx, Ny, cx, cy, radius; FT=T)\n\n    u_prof_h = if inlet === :parabolic\n        [T(4) * T(u_in) * T(j - 1) * T(Ny - j) / T(Ny - 1)^2 for j in 1:Ny]\n    elseif inlet === :uniform\n        fill(T(u_in), Ny)\n    else\n        error(\"unknown inlet \$(inlet); expected :parabolic or :uniform\")\n    end\n    u_ref = inlet === :parabolic ? (2 / 3) * Float64(u_in) : Float64(u_in)\n\n    # Host-side initial populations\n    f_in_h  = zeros(T, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    for j in 1:Ny, i in 1:Nx, q in 1:9\n        f_in_h[i, j, q] = Kraken.equilibrium(D2Q9(), one(T), u_prof_h[j],\n                                               zero(T), q)\n    end\n\n    # Device allocations\n    q_wall    = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    is_solid  = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, Bool, Nx, Ny)\n    uw_x      = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    uw_y      = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    f_in      = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    f_out     = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    ρ         = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, Nx, Ny)\n    ux        = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, Nx, Ny)\n    uy        = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, Nx, Ny)\n    u_profile = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, Ny)\n    copyto!(q_wall, q_wall_h); copyto!(is_solid, is_solid_h)\n    fill!(uw_x, zero(T)); fill!(uw_y, zero(T))\n    copyto!(f_in, f_in_h); fill!(f_out, zero(T))\n    fill!(ρ, one(T)); fill!(ux, zero(T)); fill!(uy, zero(T))\n    copyto!(u_profile, u_prof_h)\n\n    Fx_sum = 0.0; Fy_sum = 0.0; n_avg = 0\n\n    for step in 1:max_steps\n        fused_trt_libb_v2_step!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid,\n                                 q_wall, uw_x, uw_y, Nx, Ny, T(ν))\n        # Pre-collision Zou-He rebuild at i=1 and i=Nx (j=1..Ny)\n        rebuild_inlet_outlet_libb_2d!(f_out, f_in, u_profile, ρ_out, ν, Nx, Ny)\n\n        if step > max_steps - avg_window\n            drag = compute_drag_libb_mei_2d(f_out, q_wall, uw_x, uw_y, Nx, Ny)\n            Fx_sum += drag.Fx; Fy_sum += drag.Fy\n            n_avg  += 1\n        end\n\n        f_in, f_out = f_out, f_in\n    end\n    KernelAbstractions.synchronize(backend)\n\n    Fx_avg = Fx_sum / n_avg\n    Fy_avg = Fy_sum / n_avg\n    D      = 2 * Float64(radius)\n    Cd     = 2.0 * Fx_avg / (u_ref^2 * D)\n    Cl     = 2.0 * Fy_avg / (u_ref^2 * D)\n\n    return (; ρ = Array(ρ), ux = Array(ux), uy = Array(uy),\n             Cd, Cl, Fx = Fx_avg, Fy = Fy_avg,\n             q_wall = Array(q_wall), is_solid = Array(is_solid),\n             u_ref, D, inlet)\nend\n```"), (name = :run_rayleigh_benard_2d, signature = "function run_rayleigh_benard_2d(; Nx=128, Ny=32, Ra=2000.0, Pr=1.0,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    run_rayleigh_benard_2d(; Nx=128, Ny=32, Ra=2000, Pr=1.0, T_hot=1.0, T_cold=0.0,\n                            max_steps=20000, backend, T)\n\nRayleigh-Bénard convection: hot bottom wall, cold top wall, periodic x.\nRa = β·g·ΔT·H³/(ν·α), Pr = ν/α.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    run_rayleigh_benard_2d(; Nx=128, Ny=32, Ra=2000, Pr=1.0, T_hot=1.0, T_cold=0.0,\n                            max_steps=20000, backend, T)\n\nRayleigh-Bénard convection: hot bottom wall, cold top wall, periodic x.\nRa = β·g·ΔT·H³/(ν·α), Pr = ν/α.\n\"\"\"\nfunction run_rayleigh_benard_2d(; Nx=128, Ny=32, Ra=2000.0, Pr=1.0,\n                                 T_hot=1.0, T_cold=0.0, max_steps=20000,\n                                 backend=KernelAbstractions.CPU(), FT=Float64)\n    ΔT = T_hot - T_cold\n    H = Ny  # channel height in lattice units (half-way BB)\n\n    # Choose ν for stability (ω not too close to 2)\n    ν = 0.05\n    α = ν / Pr               # thermal diffusivity\n    β_g = Ra * ν * α / (ΔT * H^3)  # β·g combined\n\n    ω_f = FT(1.0 / (3.0 * ν + 0.5))     # flow relaxation\n    ω_T = FT(1.0 / (3.0 * α + 0.5))     # thermal relaxation\n\n    config = LBMConfig(D2Q9(); Nx=Nx, Ny=Ny, ν=ν, u_lid=0.0, max_steps=max_steps)\n    state = initialize_2d(config, FT; backend=backend)\n    f_in, f_out = state.f_in, state.f_out\n    ρ, ux, uy = state.ρ, state.ux, state.uy\n    is_solid = state.is_solid\n\n    # Thermal populations: initialize to linear temperature profile\n    g_in  = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, FT, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    g_out = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, FT, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    Temp  = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, FT, Nx, Ny)\n\n    w = weights(D2Q9())\n    g_cpu = zeros(FT, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    for j in 1:Ny, i in 1:Nx\n        # Linear profile from T_hot (j=1) to T_cold (j=Ny) + small perturbation\n        T_init = FT(T_hot - ΔT * (j - 1) / (Ny - 1))\n        T_init += FT(0.01 * ΔT) * sin(FT(2π * i / Nx)) * sin(FT(π * j / Ny))\n        for q in 1:9\n            g_cpu[i, j, q] = FT(w[q]) * T_init\n        end\n    end\n    copyto!(g_in, g_cpu)\n    copyto!(g_out, g_cpu)\n\n    T_ref = FT((T_hot + T_cold) / 2)\n\n    for step in 1:max_steps\n        # 1. Stream flow (periodic x, wall y)\n        stream_periodic_x_wall_y_2d!(f_out, f_in, Nx, Ny)\n\n        # 2. Stream thermal (same kernel)\n        stream_periodic_x_wall_y_2d!(g_out, g_in, Nx, Ny)\n\n        # 3. Thermal BCs: fixed temperature at walls\n        apply_fixed_temp_south_2d!(g_out, T_hot, Nx)\n        apply_fixed_temp_north_2d!(g_out, T_cold, Nx, Ny)\n\n        # 4. Compute temperature for Boussinesq coupling\n        compute_temperature_2d!(Temp, g_out)\n\n        # 5. Collide thermal (uses flow velocity)\n        compute_macroscopic_2d!(ρ, ux, uy, f_out)\n        collide_thermal_2d!(g_out, ux, uy, ω_T)\n\n        # 6. Collide flow with per-node Boussinesq force: Fy(i,j) = β·g·(T(i,j) - T_ref)\n        collide_boussinesq_2d!(f_out, Temp, is_solid, ω_f, β_g, T_ref)\n\n        # 7. Swap\n        f_in, f_out = f_out, f_in\n        g_in, g_out = g_out, g_in\n    end\n\n    compute_macroscopic_2d!(ρ, ux, uy, f_in)\n    compute_temperature_2d!(Temp, g_in)\n\n    return (ρ=Array(ρ), ux=Array(ux), uy=Array(uy), Temp=Array(Temp),\n            config=config, Ra=Ra, Pr=Pr, ν=ν, α=α)\nend\n```"), (name = :run_natural_convection_2d, signature = "function run_natural_convection_2d(; N=128, Ra=1e4, Pr=0.71, Rc=1.0,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    run_natural_convection_2d(; N=128, Ra=1e4, Pr=0.71, Rc=1.0,\n                                T_hot=1.0, T_cold=0.0, max_steps=50000,\n                                backend, FT)\n\nNatural convection in a square cavity: hot left wall, cold right wall,\nadiabatic top/bottom. Boussinesq approximation with optional\ntemperature-dependent viscosity via modified Arrhenius law.\n\nRa = β·g·ΔT·H³/(ν·α), Pr = ν/α, Rc = η_max/η_min (rheological contrast).\nFor Rc=1: constant viscosity. For Rc>1: ν(T) = ν_ref·exp(α_visc·(T - T_ref)).\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    run_natural_convection_2d(; N=128, Ra=1e4, Pr=0.71, Rc=1.0,\n                                T_hot=1.0, T_cold=0.0, max_steps=50000,\n                                backend, FT)\n\nNatural convection in a square cavity: hot left wall, cold right wall,\nadiabatic top/bottom. Boussinesq approximation with optional\ntemperature-dependent viscosity via modified Arrhenius law.\n\nRa = β·g·ΔT·H³/(ν·α), Pr = ν/α, Rc = η_max/η_min (rheological contrast).\nFor Rc=1: constant viscosity. For Rc>1: ν(T) = ν_ref·exp(α_visc·(T - T_ref)).\n\"\"\"\nfunction run_natural_convection_2d(; N=128, Ra=1e4, Pr=0.71, Rc=1.0,\n                                     T_hot=1.0, T_cold=0.0, max_steps=50000,\n                                     backend=KernelAbstractions.CPU(), FT=Float64)\n    Nx, Ny = N, N\n    ΔT = T_hot - T_cold\n    H = FT(N)\n\n    # LBM parameters (NatConv convention: TRef=0, η=Pr, κ=1, β=Pr·Ra)\n    ν = FT(0.05)\n    α_thermal = ν / FT(Pr)\n    β_g = FT(Ra) * ν * α_thermal / (FT(ΔT) * H^3)\n\n    ω_f = FT(1.0 / (3.0 * ν + 0.5))\n    ω_T = FT(1.0 / (3.0 * α_thermal + 0.5))\n\n    # Variable viscosity: ν(T) = ν_ref · exp(α_visc · (T - T0_visc))\n    # Rc = η_cold/η_hot: hot side is Rc times MORE FLUID\n    # η_cold(T=0) = ν_ref, η_hot(T=1) = ν_ref/Rc → α = -ln(Rc)\n    α_visc = FT(-log(Rc))\n    T0_visc = FT(T_cold)\n    # Buoyancy reference: F = β_g · (T - T_ref_buoy)\n    T_ref_buoy = FT((T_hot + T_cold) / 2)\n\n    config = LBMConfig(D2Q9(); Nx=Nx, Ny=Ny, ν=Float64(ν), u_lid=0.0, max_steps=max_steps)\n    state = initialize_2d(config, FT; backend=backend)\n    f_in, f_out = state.f_in, state.f_out\n    ρ, ux, uy = state.ρ, state.ux, state.uy\n    is_solid = state.is_solid\n\n    # Thermal populations: horizontal linear profile T(x)\n    g_in  = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, FT, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    g_out = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, FT, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    Temp  = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, FT, Nx, Ny)\n\n    w = weights(D2Q9())\n    g_cpu = zeros(FT, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    for j in 1:Ny, i in 1:Nx\n        T_init = FT(T_hot - ΔT * (i - 1) / (Nx - 1))\n        T_init += FT(0.01 * ΔT) * sin(FT(2π * i / Nx)) * sin(FT(π * j / Ny))\n        for q in 1:9\n            g_cpu[i, j, q] = FT(w[q]) * T_init\n        end\n    end\n    copyto!(g_in, g_cpu)\n    copyto!(g_out, g_cpu)\n\n    # Fused kernel: 1 GPU launch per step (stream + BC + macroscopic + collide)\n    for step in 1:max_steps\n        if Rc ≈ 1.0\n            fused_natconv_step!(f_out, f_in, g_out, g_in, Temp, Nx, Ny,\n                                 ω_f, ω_T, β_g, T_ref_buoy, FT(T_hot), FT(T_cold))\n        else\n            fused_natconv_vt_step!(f_out, f_in, g_out, g_in, Temp, Nx, Ny,\n                                    ν, T0_visc, α_visc, ω_T, β_g, T_ref_buoy,\n                                    FT(T_hot), FT(T_cold))\n        end\n        f_in, f_out = f_out, f_in\n        g_in, g_out = g_out, g_in\n    end\n\n    compute_macroscopic_2d!(ρ, ux, uy, f_in)\n    compute_temperature_2d!(Temp, g_in)\n\n    # Compute Nusselt number at hot wall (second-order forward FD)\n    T_cpu = Array(Temp)\n    dx = FT(1.0)  # lattice spacing\n    Nu_local = zeros(FT, Ny)\n    for j in 2:Ny-1\n        Nu_local[j] = -H * (-3*T_cpu[1,j] + 4*T_cpu[2,j] - T_cpu[3,j]) / (2*dx) / FT(ΔT)\n    end\n    Nu = sum(Nu_local[2:end-1]) / (Ny - 2)\n\n    return (ρ=Array(ρ), ux=Array(ux), uy=Array(uy), Temp=T_cpu,\n            Nu=Nu, config=config, Ra=Ra, Pr=Pr, Rc=Rc, ν=Float64(ν), α=Float64(α_thermal))\nend\n```"), (name = :run_natural_convection_refined_2d, signature = "function run_natural_convection_refined_2d(; N=128, Ra=1e4, Pr=0.71, Rc=1.0,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    run_natural_convection_refined_2d(; N=128, Ra=1e4, Pr=0.71, Rc=1.0,\n                                        T_hot=1.0, T_cold=0.0, max_steps=50000,\n                                        wall_fraction=0.2, ratio=2,\n                                        backend, FT)\n\nNatural convection in a square cavity with patch refinement near the hot (west)\nand cold (east) walls. Patches cover `wall_fraction` of the domain width on\neach side, refined by `ratio` (default 2:1).\n\nSame physics as run_natural_convection_2d but with better boundary layer\nresolution at lower total cost.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    run_natural_convection_refined_2d(; N=128, Ra=1e4, Pr=0.71, Rc=1.0,\n                                        T_hot=1.0, T_cold=0.0, max_steps=50000,\n                                        wall_fraction=0.2, ratio=2,\n                                        backend, FT)\n\nNatural convection in a square cavity with patch refinement near the hot (west)\nand cold (east) walls. Patches cover `wall_fraction` of the domain width on\neach side, refined by `ratio` (default 2:1).\n\nSame physics as run_natural_convection_2d but with better boundary layer\nresolution at lower total cost.\n\"\"\"\nfunction run_natural_convection_refined_2d(; N=128, Ra=1e4, Pr=0.71, Rc=1.0,\n                                             T_hot=1.0, T_cold=0.0, max_steps=50000,\n                                             wall_fraction=0.2, ratio=2,\n                                             backend=KernelAbstractions.CPU(), FT=Float64)\n    Nx, Ny = N, N\n    ΔT = T_hot - T_cold\n    H = FT(N)\n    dx = FT(1.0)\n\n    # LBM parameters\n    ν = FT(0.05)\n    α_thermal = ν / FT(Pr)\n    β_g = FT(Ra) * ν * α_thermal / (FT(ΔT) * H^3)\n\n    ω_f = FT(1.0 / (3.0 * ν + 0.5))\n    ω_T = FT(1.0 / (3.0 * α_thermal + 0.5))\n\n    α_visc = FT(-log(Rc))\n    T0_visc = FT(T_cold)\n    T_ref_buoy = FT((T_hot + T_cold) / 2)\n\n    # --- Base grid ---\n    config = LBMConfig(D2Q9(); Nx=Nx, Ny=Ny, ν=Float64(ν), u_lid=0.0, max_steps=max_steps)\n    state = initialize_2d(config, FT; backend=backend)\n    f_in, f_out = state.f_in, state.f_out\n    ρ, ux, uy = state.ρ, state.ux, state.uy\n    is_solid = state.is_solid\n\n    g_in  = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, FT, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    g_out = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, FT, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    Temp  = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, FT, Nx, Ny)\n\n    w = weights(D2Q9())\n    g_cpu = zeros(FT, Nx, Ny, 9)\n    for j in 1:Ny, i in 1:Nx\n        T_init = FT(T_hot - ΔT * (i - 1) / (Nx - 1))\n        T_init += FT(0.01 * ΔT) * sin(FT(2π * i / Nx)) * sin(FT(π * j / Ny))\n        for q in 1:9\n            g_cpu[i, j, q] = FT(w[q]) * T_init\n        end\n    end\n    copyto!(g_in, g_cpu)\n    copyto!(g_out, g_cpu)\n\n    # --- Create refinement patches near walls ---\n    L = FT(N * dx)\n    wall_width = wall_fraction * L\n\n    patch_west = create_patch(\"west_wall\", 1, ratio,\n        (0.0, 0.0, Float64(wall_width), Float64(L)),\n        Nx, Ny, Float64(dx), Float64(ω_f), FT; backend=backend)\n    patch_east = create_patch(\"east_wall\", 1, ratio,\n        (Float64(L - wall_width), 0.0, Float64(L), Float64(L)),\n        Nx, Ny, Float64(dx), Float64(ω_f), FT; backend=backend)\n\n    domain = create_refined_domain(Nx, Ny, Float64(dx), Float64(ω_f),\n                                    [patch_west, patch_east])\n\n    # Thermal arrays for patches\n    thermal_west = create_thermal_patch_arrays(patch_west, Float64(ω_T);\n                                                T_init=Float64((T_hot + T_cold) / 2),\n                                                backend=backend)\n    thermal_east = create_thermal_patch_arrays(patch_east, Float64(ω_T);\n                                                T_init=Float64((T_hot + T_cold) / 2),\n                                                backend=backend)\n    thermals = [thermal_west, thermal_east]\n\n    # Thermal BCs for patches at domain walls\n    bc_thermal_patch_fns = Dict{Int, Function}(\n        1 => (g, Nx_p, Ny_p) -> apply_fixed_temp_west_2d!(g, T_hot, Ny_p),\n        2 => (g, Nx_p, Ny_p) -> apply_fixed_temp_east_2d!(g, T_cold, Nx_p, Ny_p),\n    )\n\n    # Flow no-slip BCs for patches: each patch spans the full vertical extent\n    # so it touches south, north, AND its respective lateral wall.\n    bc_flow_patch_fns = Dict{Int, Function}(\n        1 => (f, Nx_p, Ny_p) -> begin\n            apply_bounce_back_wall_2d!(f, Nx_p, Ny_p, :west)\n            apply_bounce_back_wall_2d!(f, Nx_p, Ny_p, :south)\n            apply_bounce_back_wall_2d!(f, Nx_p, Ny_p, :north)\n        end,\n        2 => (f, Nx_p, Ny_p) -> begin\n            apply_bounce_back_wall_2d!(f, Nx_p, Ny_p, :east)\n            apply_bounce_back_wall_2d!(f, Nx_p, Ny_p, :south)\n            apply_bounce_back_wall_2d!(f, Nx_p, Ny_p, :north)\n        end,\n    )\n\n    # Initialize patch interiors from coarse state (otherwise patches start\n    # at uniform T=0.5 / rest and pollute the coarse grid via restriction).\n    compute_macroscopic_2d!(ρ, ux, uy, f_in)\n    compute_temperature_2d!(Temp, g_in)\n    for (pidx, patch) in enumerate(domain.patches)\n        Kraken.prolongate_f_rescaled_full_2d!(\n            patch.f_in, f_in, ρ, ux, uy,\n            patch.ratio, patch.Nx_inner, patch.Ny_inner,\n            patch.n_ghost, first(patch.parent_i_range), first(patch.parent_j_range),\n            Nx, Ny, Float64(ω_f), Float64(patch.omega))\n        copyto!(patch.f_out, patch.f_in)\n        compute_macroscopic_2d!(patch.rho, patch.ux, patch.uy, patch.f_in)\n        fill_thermal_full!(patch, thermals[pidx], g_in, Nx, Ny)\n    end\n\n    # Build collision mask: is_solid OR patch-covered\n    # collide_boussinesq_2d! already skips is_solid cells, so we OR in patch cells\n    is_skip = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, Bool, Nx, Ny)\n    is_skip_cpu = Array(is_solid)\n    for patch in domain.patches\n        for j in patch.parent_j_range, i in patch.parent_i_range\n            is_skip_cpu[i, j] = true\n        end\n    end\n    copyto!(is_skip, is_skip_cpu)\n\n    # Use the original fused kernel for coarse step (full domain).\n    # The restriction will overwrite patch-covered cells afterward.\n    fused_step = if Rc ≈ 1.0\n        (fo, fi, go, gi, Te, nx, ny) -> fused_natconv_step!(\n            fo, fi, go, gi, Te, nx, ny,\n            ω_f, ω_T, β_g, T_ref_buoy, FT(T_hot), FT(T_cold))\n    else\n        (fo, fi, go, gi, Te, nx, ny) -> fused_natconv_vt_step!(\n            fo, fi, go, gi, Te, nx, ny,\n            ν, T0_visc, α_visc, ω_T, β_g, T_ref_buoy,\n            FT(T_hot), FT(T_cold))\n    end\n\n    # Coarse BC re-application after restriction (patches overwrite wall cells)\n    bc_coarse = (f, g, Te, nx, ny) -> begin\n        # Thermal: Dirichlet at hot/cold walls\n        apply_fixed_temp_west_2d!(g, T_hot, ny)\n        apply_fixed_temp_east_2d!(g, T_cold, nx, ny)\n        # Flow: bounce-back all walls\n        apply_bounce_back_wall_2d!(f, nx, ny, :south)\n        apply_bounce_back_wall_2d!(f, nx, ny, :north)\n        apply_bounce_back_wall_2d!(f, nx, ny, :west)\n        apply_bounce_back_wall_2d!(f, nx, ny, :east)\n    end\n\n    # --- Time loop ---\n    for step in 1:max_steps\n        f_in, f_out, g_in, g_out = advance_thermal_refined_step!(\n            domain, thermals,\n            f_in, f_out, g_in, g_out, ρ, ux, uy, Temp, is_solid;\n            fused_step_fn=fused_step,\n            omega_T_coarse=Float64(ω_T),\n            β_g=Float64(β_g),\n            T_ref_buoy=Float64(T_ref_buoy),\n            bc_thermal_patch_fns=bc_thermal_patch_fns,\n            bc_flow_patch_fns=bc_flow_patch_fns,\n            bc_coarse_fn=bc_coarse\n        )\n    end\n\n    compute_macroscopic_2d!(ρ, ux, uy, f_in)\n    compute_temperature_2d!(Temp, g_in)\n\n    # Nusselt at hot wall — compute from the fine-grid west patch for accuracy.\n    # The coarse grid (after restriction) has block-averaged temperatures that\n    # smooth the wall gradient, giving ~20% error. The fine patch resolves it.\n    T_cpu = Array(Temp)\n    T_fine = Array(thermals[1].Temp)\n    ng = domain.patches[1].n_ghost\n    Ny_fine = domain.patches[1].Ny_inner\n    dx_f = FT(domain.patches[1].dx)\n\n    Nu_fine = zeros(FT, Ny_fine)\n    for jf in 1:Ny_fine\n        j = jf + ng\n        i1, i2, i3 = ng + 1, ng + 2, ng + 3\n        dTdx = (-3 * T_fine[i1, j] + 4 * T_fine[i2, j] - T_fine[i3, j]) / (2 * dx_f)\n        Nu_fine[jf] = -H * dTdx / FT(ΔT)\n    end\n    Nu = sum(Nu_fine[2:end-1]) / (Ny_fine - 2)\n\n    return (ρ=Array(ρ), ux=Array(ux), uy=Array(uy), Temp=T_cpu,\n            Nu=Nu, config=config, Ra=Ra, Pr=Pr, Rc=Rc, ν=Float64(ν), α=Float64(α_thermal),\n            domain=domain, thermals=thermals)\nend\n```"), (name = :run_natural_convection_3d, signature = "function run_natural_convection_3d(; N=32, Ra=1e3, Pr=0.71,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    run_natural_convection_3d(; N=32, Ra=1e3, Pr=0.71,\n                                T_hot=1.0, T_cold=0.0, max_steps=10000,\n                                backend, FT)\n\nNatural convection in a cube: hot west wall (x=0), cold east wall (x=N),\nadiabatic on all other faces. (1991) — Ra=1e3 → Nu≈1.085, Ra=1e4 → Nu≈2.10.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    run_natural_convection_3d(; N=32, Ra=1e3, Pr=0.71,\n                                T_hot=1.0, T_cold=0.0, max_steps=10000,\n                                backend, FT)\n\nNatural convection in a cube: hot west wall (x=0), cold east wall (x=N),\nadiabatic on all other faces.                               backend=KernelAbstractions.CPU(), FT=Float64)\n    Nx, Ny, Nz = N, N, N\n    ΔT = T_hot - T_cold\n    H = FT(N)\n\n    ν = FT(0.05)\n    α_thermal = ν / FT(Pr)\n    β_g = FT(Ra) * ν * α_thermal / (FT(ΔT) * H^3)\n\n    ω_f = FT(1.0 / (3.0 * ν + 0.5))\n    ω_T = FT(1.0 / (3.0 * α_thermal + 0.5))\n    T_ref = FT((T_hot + T_cold) / 2)\n\n    # --- Initialize flow ---\n    config = LBMConfig(D3Q19(); Nx=Nx, Ny=Ny, Nz=Nz, ν=Float64(ν),\n                       u_lid=0.0, max_steps=max_steps)\n    state = initialize_3d(config, FT; backend=backend)\n    f_in, f_out = state.f_in, state.f_out\n    ρ, ux, uy, uz = state.ρ, state.ux, state.uy, state.uz\n    is_solid = state.is_solid\n\n    # --- Initialize thermal ---\n    g_in  = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, FT, Nx, Ny, Nz, 19)\n    g_out = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, FT, Nx, Ny, Nz, 19)\n    Temp  = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, FT, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n\n    w = weights(D3Q19())\n    g_cpu = zeros(FT, Nx, Ny, Nz, 19)\n    for k in 1:Nz, j in 1:Ny, i in 1:Nx\n        T_init = FT(T_hot - ΔT * (i - 1) / (Nx - 1))\n        for q in 1:19\n            g_cpu[i, j, k, q] = FT(w[q]) * T_init\n        end\n    end\n    copyto!(g_in, g_cpu)\n    copyto!(g_out, g_cpu)\n\n    # --- Time loop ---\n    for step in 1:max_steps\n        # Stream both\n        stream_3d!(f_out, f_in, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n        stream_3d!(g_out, g_in, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n\n        # Thermal BCs: Dirichlet west/east, adiabatic (bounce-back) elsewhere\n        apply_fixed_temp_west_3d!(g_out, T_hot, Ny, Nz)\n        apply_fixed_temp_east_3d!(g_out, T_cold, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n\n        # Recover temperature and macroscopic\n        compute_temperature_3d!(Temp, g_out)\n        compute_macroscopic_3d!(ρ, ux, uy, uz, f_out)\n\n        # Collide thermal (BGK)\n        collide_thermal_3d!(g_out, ux, uy, uz, ω_T)\n\n        # Collide flow (Boussinesq, gravity in y)\n        collide_boussinesq_3d!(f_out, Temp, is_solid, ω_f, β_g, T_ref)\n\n        # Swap\n        f_in, f_out = f_out, f_in\n        g_in, g_out = g_out, g_in\n    end\n\n    compute_macroscopic_3d!(ρ, ux, uy, uz, f_in)\n    compute_temperature_3d!(Temp, g_in)\n\n    # Nusselt at hot wall (x=0): Nu = -H * dT/dx / ΔT (2nd-order FD)\n    T_cpu = Array(Temp)\n    Nu_arr = zeros(FT, Ny, Nz)\n    for k in 1:Nz, j in 1:Ny\n        dTdx = (-3*T_cpu[1,j,k] + 4*T_cpu[2,j,k] - T_cpu[3,j,k]) / FT(2)\n        Nu_arr[j, k] = -H * dTdx / FT(ΔT)\n    end\n    # Average excluding edge rows\n    Nu = sum(Nu_arr[2:end-1, 2:end-1]) / max((Ny-2)*(Nz-2), 1)\n\n    return (ρ=Array(ρ), ux=Array(ux), uy=Array(uy), uz=Array(uz),\n            Temp=T_cpu, Nu=Nu, config=config, Ra=Ra, Pr=Pr,\n            ν=Float64(ν), (single buffer).\nMust alternate with `aa_even_step!`.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    aa_odd_step!(f, is_solid, Nx, Ny, ω)\n\nAA-pattern odd step: read local, collide, push to neighbors (single buffer).\nMust alternate with `aa_even_step!`.\n\"\"\"\nfunction aa_odd_step!(f, is_solid, Nx, Ny, ω)\n    backend = KernelAbstractions.get_backend(f)\n    ET = eltype(f)\n    kernel! = aa_odd_kernel!(backend)\n    kernel!(f, is_solid, Nx, Ny, ET(ω); ndrange=(Nx, Ny))\nend\n```"), (name = :run_sphere_libb_3d, signature = "function run_sphere_libb_3d(; Nx::Int=120, Ny::Int=60, Nz::Int=60,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    run_sphere_libb_3d(; Nx=120, Ny=60, Nz=60, radius=8, u_in=0.04,\n                        ν=…, max_steps=20000, avg_window=5000,\n                        inlet=:uniform, ρ_out=1.0)\n\n3D sphere in an x-flow. Halfway-BB on y/z walls (kernel fallback),\nZou-He velocity inlet at i=1 + Zou-He pressure outlet at i=Nx\nreconstructed pre-collision via the modular BC system\n(`apply_bc_rebuild_3d!`).\n\n- `inlet=:uniform`: inlet velocity u = (u_in, 0, 0) constant over y, z.\n- `inlet=:parabolic`: parabolic in both y and z. `u_in` is the\n  centerline maximum.\n- `inlet=:parabolic_y`: parabolic in y only (rectangular duct,\n  infinite in z direction).\n\nThe y and z domain walls are half-way, so a parabolic direction of `N`\nnodes is sampled as `6 ū (j - 1/2)(N + 1/2 - j) / (N² + 1/2)` with\ndiscrete mean `ū = (2/3) u_in` (the product of two such factors for\n`:parabolic`, mean `(4/9) u_in`); these are the `u_ref` used for Cd. The\nZou-He rebuild covers every node of the inlet and outlet faces.\n\nDrag integrated via `compute_drag_libb_3d` over `avg_window` steps.\nReference: free-stream sphere Re=20, Cd ≈ 2.6 (Clift et al. 1978;\nconfinement-adjusted upward for ducted setups).\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    run_sphere_libb_3d(; Nx=120, Ny=60, Nz=60, radius=8, u_in=0.04,\n                        ν=…, max_steps=20000, avg_window=5000,\n                        inlet=:uniform, ρ_out=1.0)\n\n3D sphere in an x-flow. Halfway-BB on y/z walls (kernel fallback),\nZou-He velocity inlet at i=1 + Zou-He pressure outlet at i=Nx\nreconstructed pre-collision via the modular BC system\n(`apply_bc_rebuild_3d!`).\n\n- `inlet=:uniform`: inlet velocity u = (u_in, 0, 0) constant over y, z.\n- `inlet=:parabolic`: parabolic in both y and z. `u_in` is the\n  centerline maximum.\n- `inlet=:parabolic_y`: parabolic in y only (rectangular duct,\n  infinite in z direction).\n\nThe y and z domain walls are half-way, so a parabolic direction of `N`\nnodes is sampled as `6 ū (j - 1/2)(N + 1/2 - j) / (N² + 1/2)` with\ndiscrete mean `ū = (2/3) u_in` (the product of two such factors for\n`:parabolic`, mean `(4/9) u_in`); these are the `u_ref` used for Cd. The\nZou-He rebuild covers every node of the inlet and outlet faces.\n\nDrag integrated via `compute_drag_libb_3d` over `avg_window` steps.\nReference: free-stream sphere Re=20, Cd ≈ 2.6 (Clift et al. 1978;\nconfinement-adjusted upward for ducted setups).\n\"\"\"\nfunction run_sphere_libb_3d(; Nx::Int=120, Ny::Int=60, Nz::Int=60,\n                              cx::Union{Nothing,Real}=nothing,\n                              cy::Union{Nothing,Real}=nothing,\n                              cz::Union{Nothing,Real}=nothing,\n                              radius::Real=8,\n                              u_in::Real=0.04, ν::Real=0.04,\n                              max_steps::Int=20_000,\n                              avg_window::Int=5_000,\n                              inlet::Symbol=:uniform,\n                              ρ_out::Real=1.0,\n                              backend=KernelAbstractions.CPU(),\n                              T::Type{<:AbstractFloat}=Float64)\n    cx = isnothing(cx) ? Nx ÷ 4 : Float64(cx)\n    cy = isnothing(cy) ? Ny ÷ 2 : Float64(cy)\n    cz = isnothing(cz) ? Nz ÷ 2 : Float64(cz)\n\n    # Precompute on CPU (analytic geometry, not kernel-launched)\n    q_wall_h, is_solid_h = precompute_q_wall_sphere_3d(Nx, Ny, Nz, cx, cy, cz,\n                                                        radius; FT=T)\n    # Inlet profile matrix (Ny, Nz): normal-into-domain velocity per cell.\n    u_profile_h = zeros(T, Ny, Nz)\n    if inlet === :uniform\n        fill!(u_profile_h, T(u_in))\n    elseif inlet === :parabolic\n        # Parabolic in both y and z, peak = u_in at (Ny/2, Nz/2).\n        # Normalised so max(u) = u_in.\n        Hy = T(Ny - 1); Hz = T(Nz - 1)\n        for k in 1:Nz, j in 1:Ny\n            yy = T(j - 1); zz = T(k - 1)\n            u_profile_h[j, k] = T(16) * T(u_in) *\n                                yy * (Hy - yy) * zz * (Hz - zz) /\n                                (Hy^2 * Hz^2)\n        end\n    elseif inlet === :parabolic_y\n        Hy = T(Ny - 1)\n        for j in 1:Ny\n            yy = T(j - 1)\n            val = T(4) * T(u_in) * yy * (Hy - yy) / Hy^2\n            for k in 1:Nz\n                u_profile_h[j, k] = val\n            end\n        end\n    else\n        error(\"unknown inlet \$(inlet); expected :uniform|:parabolic|:parabolic_y\")\n    end\n\n    f_in_h = zeros(T, Nx, Ny, Nz, 19)\n    for k in 1:Nz, j in 1:Ny, i in 1:Nx, q in 1:19\n        f_in_h[i, j, k, q] = Kraken.equilibrium(D3Q19(), one(T),\n                                                 u_profile_h[j, k],\n                                                 zero(T), zero(T), q)\n    end\n\n    # Allocate on the target backend\n    q_wall   = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, Nx, Ny, Nz, 19)\n    is_solid = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, Bool, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n    uw_x     = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, Nx, Ny, Nz, 19)\n    uw_y     = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, Nx, Ny, Nz, 19)\n    uw_z     = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, Nx, Ny, Nz, 19)\n    f_in     = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, Nx, Ny, Nz, 19)\n    f_out    = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, Nx, Ny, Nz, 19)\n    ρ        = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n    ux       = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n    uy       = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n    uz       = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n    u_profile = KernelAbstractions.allocate(backend, T, Ny, Nz)\n\n    copyto!(q_wall, q_wall_h)\n    copyto!(is_solid, is_solid_h)\n    fill!(uw_x, zero(T)); fill!(uw_y, zero(T)); fill!(uw_z, zero(T))\n    copyto!(f_in, f_in_h)\n    fill!(ρ, one(T));  fill!(ux, zero(T))\n    fill!(uy, zero(T)); fill!(uz, zero(T))\n    copyto!(u_profile, u_profile_h)\n\n    bcspec = BCSpec3D(; west = ZouHeVelocity(u_profile),\n                        east = ZouHePressure(T(ρ_out)))\n\n    Fx_sum = 0.0; Fy_sum = 0.0; Fz_sum = 0.0; n_avg = 0\n\n    for step in 1:max_steps\n        fused_trt_libb_v2_step_3d!(f_out, f_in, ρ, ux, uy, uz, is_solid,\n                                    q_wall, uw_x, uw_y, uw_z,\n                                    Nx, Ny, Nz, T(ν))\n        # Pre-collision Zou-He rebuild (modular BC dispatch)\n        apply_bc_rebuild_3d!(f_out, f_in, bcspec, ν, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n\n        if step > max_steps - avg_window\n            drag = compute_drag_libb_3d(f_out, q_wall, Nx, Ny, Nz)\n            Fx_sum += drag.Fx; Fy_sum += drag.Fy; Fz_sum += drag.Fz\n            n_avg += 1\n        end\n\n        f_in, f_out = f_out, f_in\n    end\n    KernelAbstractions.synchronize(backend)\n\n    Fx_avg = Fx_sum / n_avg\n    Fy_avg = Fy_sum / n_avg\n    Fz_avg = Fz_sum / n_avg\n    D = 2 * Float64(radius)\n    A = π * Float64(radius)^2        # cross-section area\n    # Cd reference velocity: for parabolic inlets the convention is\n    # u_mean — for a doubly parabolic duct, u_mean = (4/9)·u_max; for\n    # y-only parabolic, u_mean = (2/3)·u_max.\n    u_ref = inlet === :parabolic   ? (4/9) * Float64(u_in) :\n            inlet === :parabolic_y ? (2/3) * Float64(u_in) :\n                                       Float64(u_in)\n    Cd = 2.0 * Fx_avg / (u_ref^2 * A)\n\n    return (; ρ = Array(ρ), ux = Array(ux), uy = Array(uy), uz = Array(uz),\n             Cd, Fx = Fx_avg, Fy = Fy_avg, Fz = Fz_avg,\n             q_wall = Array(q_wall), is_solid = Array(is_solid),\n             u_ref, D, A)\nend\n```"), (name = :persistent_fused_bgk!, signature = "function persistent_fused_bgk!(f_in, f_out, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid, Nx, Ny, ω, Nt;", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    persistent_fused_bgk!(f_in, f_out, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid, Nx, Ny, ω, Nt;\n                          workgroupsize=nothing)\n\nRun `Nt` fused BGK steps with a single host-side synchronize at the end.\nPing-pongs `f_in`/`f_out` internally; if `Nt` is odd the buffers end up\nswapped relative to the input (caller should swap accordingly).\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    persistent_fused_bgk!(f_in, f_out, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid, Nx, Ny, ω, Nt;\n                          workgroupsize=nothing)\n\nRun `Nt` fused BGK steps with a single host-side synchronize at the end.\nPing-pongs `f_in`/`f_out` internally; if `Nt` is odd the buffers end up\nswapped relative to the input (caller should swap accordingly).\n\"\"\"\nfunction persistent_fused_bgk!(f_in, f_out, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid, Nx, Ny, ω, Nt;\n                                workgroupsize=nothing)\n    backend = KernelAbstractions.get_backend(f_in)\n    ET = eltype(f_in)\n    kernel! = isnothing(workgroupsize) ?\n        fused_bgk_step_kernel!(backend) :\n        fused_bgk_step_kernel!(backend, workgroupsize)\n    a, b = f_in, f_out\n    for t in 1:Nt\n        kernel!(b, a, ρ, ux, uy, is_solid, Nx, Ny, ET(ω); ndrange=(Nx, Ny))\n        a, b = b, a\n    end\n    return a, b\nend\n```"), (name = :persistent_aa_bgk!, signature = "function persistent_aa_bgk!(f, is_solid, Nx, Ny, ω, Nt; workgroupsize=nothing)", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    persistent_aa_bgk!(f, is_solid, Nx, Ny, ω, Nt; workgroupsize=nothing)\n\nRun `Nt` AA-pattern BGK steps (alternating even/odd) with a single\nsynchronize at the end. Optional `workgroupsize` tuple (e.g. `(16,16)`)\nfor block-size tuning.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    persistent_aa_bgk!(f, is_solid, Nx, Ny, ω, Nt; workgroupsize=nothing)\n\nRun `Nt` AA-pattern BGK steps (alternating even/odd) with a single\nsynchronize at the end. Optional `workgroupsize` tuple (e.g. `(16,16)`)\nfor block-size tuning.\n\"\"\"\nfunction persistent_aa_bgk!(f, is_solid, Nx, Ny, ω, Nt; workgroupsize=nothing)\n    backend = KernelAbstractions.get_backend(f)\n    ET = eltype(f)\n    even_k! = isnothing(workgroupsize) ?\n        aa_even_kernel!(backend) :\n        aa_even_kernel!(backend, workgroupsize)\n    odd_k! = isnothing(workgroupsize) ?\n        aa_odd_kernel!(backend) :\n        aa_odd_kernel!(backend, workgroupsize)\n    for t in 1:Nt\n        if iseven(t)\n            even_k!(f, is_solid, Nx, Ny, ET(ω); ndrange=(Nx, Ny))\n        else\n            odd_k!(f, is_solid, Nx, Ny, ET(ω); ndrange=(Nx, Ny))\n        end\n    end\n    return f\nend\n```"), (name = :run_hagen_poiseuille_2d, signature = "function run_hagen_poiseuille_2d(; Nz=4, Nr=32, nu=nothing, ν=0.1, Fz=1e-5, max_steps=10000,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    run_hagen_poiseuille_2d(; Nz=4, Nr=32, ν=0.1, Fz=1e-5, max_steps=10000, backend, T)\n\nHagen-Poiseuille pipe flow (axisymmetric). Validates axisymmetric LBM.\nAnalytical: u_z(r) = Fz/(4ν) * (R² - r²) where R = Nr (the halfway bounce-back\nwall at j=Nr sits half a cell beyond the last fluid node r=Nr-0.5).\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    run_hagen_poiseuille_2d(; Nz=4, Nr=32, ν=0.1, Fz=1e-5, max_steps=10000, backend, T)\n\nHagen-Poiseuille pipe flow (axisymmetric). Validates axisymmetric LBM.\nAnalytical: u_z(r) = Fz/(4ν) * (R² - r²) where R = Nr (the halfway bounce-back\nwall at j=Nr sits half a cell beyond the last fluid node r=Nr-0.5).\n\"\"\"\nfunction run_hagen_poiseuille_2d(; Nz=4, Nr=32, nu=nothing, ν=0.1, Fz=1e-5, max_steps=10000,\n                                  backend=KernelAbstractions.CPU(), FT=Float64)\n    !isnothing(nu) && (ν = nu)\n    Nx, Ny = Nz, Nr\n    config = LBMConfig(D2Q9(); Nx=Nx, Ny=Ny, ν=ν, u_lid=0.0, max_steps=max_steps)\n    state = initialize_2d(config, FT; backend=backend)\n    f_in, f_out = state.f_in, state.f_out\n    ρ, ux, uy = state.ρ, state.ux, state.uy\n    is_solid = state.is_solid\n    ω = FT(omega(config))\n\n    # Axisymmetric approach: standard BGK + Guo forcing with TWO forces:\n    # 1. Body force Fz (drives the flow)\n    # 2. Axisym viscous correction Fz_axi = ν/r · ∂uz/∂r (from macroscopic field)\n    # Plus mass source -ρ·ur/r (negligible for HP since ur≈0)\n    #\n    # The correction is computed from the macroscopic velocity field at each step\n    # using central FD on the (converging) uz field.\n\n    # Pre-allocate force arrays\n    Fz_total = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, FT, Nx, Ny)\n    Fr_total = KernelAbstractions.zeros(backend, FT, Nx, Ny)\n\n    for step in 1:max_steps\n        stream_periodic_x_axisym_2d!(f_out, f_in, Nx, Ny)\n\n        # Compute axisymmetric correction from current macroscopic field\n        # (uses ux from PREVIOUS step — lagged but stable)\n        if step > 1\n            uz_cpu = Array(ux)  # ux = uz in axisym convention\n            Fz_cpu = zeros(FT, Nx, Ny)\n            for j in 2:Ny-1, i in 1:Nx\n                r = FT(j) - FT(0.5)\n                duz_dr = (uz_cpu[i, j+1] - uz_cpu[i, j-1]) / FT(2)\n                Fz_cpu[i, j] = FT(Fz) + FT(ν) / r * duz_dr\n            end\n            # j=1 (near axis, r=0.5): L'Hôpital — lim(r→0) ν/r·∂u/∂r = ν·∂²u/∂r²\n            # By symmetry: u(r=-Δr) = u(r=+Δr) → u(j=0) = u(j=2)\n            # ∂²u/∂r² ≈ (u[j+1] - 2u[j] + u[j-1]) = 2*(u[2] - u[1])\n            for i in 1:Nx\n                d2uz_dr2 = FT(2) * (uz_cpu[i, 2] - uz_cpu[i, 1])\n                Fz_cpu[i, 1] = FT(Fz) + FT(ν) * d2uz_dr2\n            end\n            # j=Ny (wall): just body force\n            for i in 1:Nx\n                Fz_cpu[i, Ny] = FT(Fz)\n            end\n            copyto!(Fz_total, Fz_cpu)\n        else\n            # First step: just body force\n            fill!(Array(Fz_total), FT(Fz))\n            Fz_cpu = fill(FT(Fz), Nx, Ny)\n            copyto!(Fz_total, Fz_cpu)\n        end\n\n        # Collision with per-node Guo force field\n        collide_guo_field_2d!(f_out, is_solid, Fz_total, Fr_total, ω)\n        compute_macroscopic_2d!(ρ, ux, uy, f_out)\n        f_in, f_out = f_out, f_in\n    end\n\n    return (ρ=Array(ρ), uz=Array(ux), ur=Array(uy), config=config)\nend\n```"), (name = :benchmark_mlups, signature = "function benchmark_mlups(; Ns=[64, 128, 256], steps=100,", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    benchmark_mlups(; Ns=[64, 128, 256], steps=100, backend=CPU())\n\nMeasure Million Lattice Updates Per Second for 2D LBM.\nReturns a vector of (N, mlups) tuples.\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    benchmark_mlups(; Ns=[64, 128, 256], steps=100, backend=CPU())\n\nMeasure Million Lattice Updates Per Second for 2D LBM.\nReturns a vector of (N, mlups) tuples.\n\"\"\"\nfunction benchmark_mlups(; Ns=[64, 128, 256], steps=100,\n                          backend=KernelAbstractions.CPU(), FT=Float64)\n    results = Tuple{Int, Float64}[]\n\n    for N in Ns\n        config = LBMConfig(D2Q9(); Nx=N, Ny=N, ν=0.1, u_lid=0.05, max_steps=steps)\n        state = initialize_2d(config, FT; backend=backend)\n        f_in, f_out = state.f_in, state.f_out\n        is_solid = state.is_solid\n        ω = FT(omega(config))\n\n        # Warmup\n        for _ in 1:5\n            stream_2d!(f_out, f_in, N, N)\n            collide_2d!(f_out, is_solid, ω)\n            f_in, f_out = f_out, f_in\n        end\n\n        # Timed run\n        t_start = time_ns()\n        for _ in 1:steps\n            stream_2d!(f_out, f_in, N, N)\n            collide_2d!(f_out, is_solid, ω)\n            f_in, f_out = f_out, f_in\n        end\n        t_elapsed = (time_ns() - t_start) / 1e9  # seconds\n\n        total_updates = N * N * steps\n        mlups = total_updates / t_elapsed / 1e6\n        push!(results, (N, mlups))\n    end\n\n    return results\nend\n```"), (name = :run_simulation, signature = "function run_simulation(filename::String;", docstring = "\"\"\"\n    run_simulation(filename::String; backend=CPU(), T=Float64,\n                   max_steps=nothing, kwargs...) -> NamedTuple\n\nRun an LBM simulation defined by a `.krk` configuration file.\nKeyword arguments override `Define` defaults for parametric studies.\nPass `max_steps` to override the `Run N steps` directive (useful for tests).\n\nReturns a NamedTuple with final fields on CPU: `(ρ, ux, uy, setup)`.\nIf the setup contains `Sensitivity { ... }`, returns the\n`steady_shape_sensitivity` API result instead.\n\n## Dispatch rules\nThe runner selects a backend driver based on `setup.modules`, `setup.lattice`,\n`setup.refinements`, and the `setup.name` (case name):\n\n1. `setup.sensitivity !== nothing` → steady AD shape sensitivity\n2. `:advection_only in modules`  → pure VOF advection (no LBM solve)\n3. `:twophase_vof   in modules`  → two-phase LBM with surface tension\n4. `:axisymmetric   in modules`  → `run_hagen_poiseuille_2d` if the case\n   name contains `hagen_poiseuille`, otherwise an informative error\n5. `!isempty(setup.refinements)` → refined-grid drivers. Only refined\n   natural convection is currently supported via the .krk runner;\n   other refined cases raise an informative error (run them via the\n   Julia API — see `create_refined_domain` / `create_thermal_patch_arrays`).\n6. `:thermal in modules`         → `run_rayleigh_benard_2d`,\n   `run_natural_convection_2d`, or a thermal-conduction fallback\n   depending on the case name\n7. `setup.lattice === :D3Q19`    → `run_cavity_3d` if the case name\n   contains `cavity_3d`, otherwise an informative error\n8. Default (`:D2Q9`, no modules) → generic single-phase LBM loop\n   (existing behavior, compatible with all cavity/Poiseuille/Couette/\n   Taylor-Green/cylinder examples).\n\n# Example\n```julia\nresult = run_simulation(\"examples/cavity.krk\")\nresult = run_simulation(\"examples/cavity.krk\"; Re=400, N=256)\nresult = run_simulation(\"examples/rayleigh_benard.krk\"; max_steps=100)\n```\n\"\"\"", source_excerpt = "```julia\n\"\"\"\n    run_simulation(filename::String; backend=CPU(), T=Float64,\n                   max_steps=nothing, kwargs...) -> NamedTuple\n\nRun an LBM simulation defined by a `.krk` configuration file.\nKeyword arguments override `Define` defaults for parametric studies.\nPass `max_steps` to override the `Run N steps` directive (useful for tests).\n\nReturns a NamedTuple with final fields on CPU: `(ρ, ux, uy, setup)`.\nIf the setup contains `Sensitivity { ... }`, returns the\n`steady_shape_sensitivity` API result instead.\n\n## Dispatch rules\nThe runner selects a backend driver based on `setup.modules`, `setup.lattice`,\n`setup.refinements`, and the `setup.name` (case name):\n\n1. `setup.sensitivity !== nothing` → steady AD shape sensitivity\n2. `:advection_only in modules`  → pure VOF advection (no LBM solve)\n3. `:twophase_vof   in modules`  → two-phase LBM with surface tension\n4. `:axisymmetric   in modules`  → `run_hagen_poiseuille_2d` if the case\n   name contains `hagen_poiseuille`, otherwise an informative error\n5. `!isempty(setup.refinements)` → refined-grid drivers. Only refined\n   natural convection is currently supported via the .krk runner;\n   other refined cases raise an informative error (run them via the\n   Julia API — see `create_refined_domain` / `create_thermal_patch_arrays`).\n6. `:thermal in modules`         → `run_rayleigh_benard_2d`,\n   `run_natural_convection_2d`, or a thermal-conduction fallback\n   depending on the case name\n7. `setup.lattice === :D3Q19`    → `run_cavity_3d` if the case name\n   contains `cavity_3d`, otherwise an informative error\n8. Default (`:D2Q9`, no modules) → generic single-phase LBM loop\n   (existing behavior, compatible with all cavity/Poiseuille/Couette/\n   Taylor-Green/cylinder examples).\n\n# Example\n```julia\nresult = run_simulation(\"examples/cavity.krk\")\nresult = run_simulation(\"examples/cavity.krk\"; Re=400, N=256)\nresult = run_simulation(\"examples/rayleigh_benard.krk\"; max_steps=100)\n```\n\"\"\"\nfunction run_simulation(filename::String;\n                        backend=KernelAbstractions.CPU(), T=Float64,\n                        callback::Union{Nothing,Function}=nothing,\n                        callback_every::Int=100,\n                        max_steps::Union{Nothing,Int}=nothing, kwargs...)\n    setup = load_kraken(filename; kwargs...)\n    if max_steps !== nothing\n        setup = _override_max_steps(setup, max_steps)\n    end\n    return run_simulation(setup; backend=backend, T=T,\n                          callback=callback, callback_every=callback_every)\nend\n```"), (name = :run_conservative_tree_couette_macroflow_2d, signature = "function run_conservative_tree_couette_macroflow_2d(;", docstring = "", source_excerpt = "```julia\nfunction run_conservative_tree_couette_macroflow_2d(;\n        Nx::Int=16,\n        Ny::Int=12,\n        patch_i_range::UnitRange{Int}=6:11,\n
